theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.blocks_antitone
theorems.statement: {n : ℕ} {ξ η : ER n} (h : ξ ≤ η) : blocks η ≤ blocks ξ

theorems.statement: {n : ℕ} {ξ ζ : ER n} (hξ : ξ ≤ ζ) {A B : Quotient ξ} (hAB : A ≠ B) {x y : Fin n} (hx : Quotient.mk ξ x = A) (hy : Quotient.mk ξ y = B) (hrel : ζ.r x y) : merge ξ A B ≤ ζ

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.exists_cover_le_of_lt

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.blocks_of_coalescencePath

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.le_of_coalescencePath
theorems.statement: {n : ℕ} : ∀ (k : ℕ) {ξ η : ER n}, CoalescencePath k ξ η → ξ ≤ η

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.coalescencePath_length_unique
theorems.statement: {n : ℕ} {k k' : ℕ} {ξ η : ER n} (h : CoalescencePath k ξ η) (h' : CoalescencePath k' ξ η) : k = k'

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.exists_coalescencePath
theorems.statement: {n : ℕ} : ∀ (d : ℕ) {ξ η : ER n}, ξ ≤ η → blocks ξ - blocks η = d → CoalescencePath d ξ η

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.exists_coalescencePath_sub
theorems.statement: {n : ℕ} {ξ η : ER n} (hle : ξ ≤ η) : CoalescencePath (blocks ξ - blocks η) ξ η

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.cellIndex_mono
theorems.statement: (V : Finset ℝ) {u w : ℝ} (h : u ≤ w) : cellIndex V u ≤ cellIndex V w

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.filter_sdiff_filter
theorems.statement: (V : Finset ℝ) {u w : ℝ} : (V.filter (fun v ↦ v < w)) \ (V.filter (fun v ↦ v < u)) = V.filter (fun v ↦ u ≤ v ∧ v < w)

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.cellIndex_eq_iff
theorems.statement: (V : Finset ℝ) {u w : ℝ} (h : u ≤ w) : cellIndex V u = cellIndex V w ↔ ∀ v ∈ V, ¬ (u ≤ v ∧ v < w)

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.intervalRel_iff_no_cut_between
theorems.statement: {n : ℕ} (V : Finset ℝ) (U : Fin n → ℝ) {i j : Fin n} (h : U i ≤ U j) : (intervalRel V U).r i j ↔ ∀ v ∈ V, ¬ (U i ≤ v ∧ v < U j)

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.intervalRel_mono
theorems.statement: {n : ℕ} {V W : Finset ℝ} (hVW : V ⊆ W) (U : Fin n → ℝ) : intervalRel W U ≤ intervalRel V U

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.blocks_intervalRel
theorems.statement: {n : ℕ} (V : Finset ℝ) (U : Fin n → ℝ) (hsurj : ∀ c ≤ V.card, ∃ i : Fin n, cellIndex V (U i) = c) (hle : ∀ i : Fin n, cellIndex V (U i) ≤ V.card) : blocks (intervalRel V U) = V.card + 1

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.jumpProb_eq
theorems.statement: {k : ℕ} (hk : 2 ≤ k) : jumpProb k = 2 / ((k : ℝ) * ((k : ℝ) - 1))

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.card_covers_mul_jumpProb
theorems.statement: {n : ℕ} (ξ : ER n) (hk : 2 ≤ blocks ξ) : (Nat.card {η : ER n // Covers ξ η} : ℝ) * jumpProb (blocks ξ) = 1

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.absoluteProb_top
theorems.statement: (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) : absoluteProb n n (Multiset.replicate n 1) = 1

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.jumpCoeff_recursion
theorems.statement: {n k : ℕ} (hk : 2 ≤ k) (hkn : k ≤ n) : jumpCoeff n k * ((n - k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) = 2 * deathRate k * jumpCoeff n (k - 1)

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.split_factorials
theorems.statement: {lam nu : ℕ} (h : nu ≤ lam) : ((lam.choose nu * nu ! * (lam - nu)! : ℕ) : ℝ) = (lam ! : ℕ)

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.inner_split_sum
theorems.statement: (lam : ℕ) (hlam : 1 ≤ lam) : ∑ nu ∈ Finset.Ico 1 lam, ((lam.choose nu * nu ! * (lam - nu)! : ℕ) : ℝ) / 2 = ((lam : ℝ) - 1) * (lam ! : ℕ) / 2

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.sum_map_mul_const
theorems.statement: (s : Multiset ℕ) (f : ℕ → ℝ) (c : ℝ) : (s.map (fun l ↦ f l * c)).sum = (s.map f).sum * c

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.sum_map_sub_one
theorems.statement: (s : Multiset ℕ) : (s.map (fun l : ℕ ↦ (l : ℝ) - 1)).sum = ((s.sum : ℕ) : ℝ) - (Multiset.card s : ℝ)

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.absoluteProb_recursion
theorems.statement: {n k : ℕ} (hk : 2 ≤ k) (hkn : k ≤ n) (lam : Multiset ℕ) (hcard : Multiset.card lam = k - 1) (hsum : lam.sum = n) : jumpProb k * jumpCoeff n k * (lam.map (fun l : ℕ ↦ ((l : ℝ) - 1) * ((((lam.map Nat.factorial).prod : ℕ) : ℝ) / 2))).sum = absoluteProb n (k - 1) lam

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.jumpKernel_apply
theorems.statement: {n : ℕ} (ξ : ER n) : jumpKernel n ξ = (jumpLaw ξ).toMeasure

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.jumpKernel_absorbing
theorems.statement: {n : ℕ} (ξ : ER n) (h : blocks ξ < 2) : jumpKernel n ξ = Measure.dirac ξ

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.jumpLaw_apply_cover
theorems.statement: {n : ℕ} {ξ η : ER n} (hk : 2 ≤ blocks ξ) (h : Covers ξ η) : jumpLaw ξ η = (((blocks ξ).choose 2 : ℕ) : ENNReal)⁻¹

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.jumpKernel_apply_cover
theorems.statement: {n : ℕ} (ξ : ER n) (hk : 2 ≤ blocks ξ) (η : {η : ER n // Covers ξ η}) : ((jumpStep ξ hk) η).toReal = jumpProb (blocks ξ)

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.lambdaCoalescentMergerRate_two_two
theorems.statement: (Λ : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure Λ] : lambdaCoalescentMergerRate Λ 2 2 = 1

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.lambdaCoalescentMergerRate_three_three
theorems.statement: (Λ : Measure ℝ) : lambdaCoalescentMergerRate Λ 3 3 = ∫ x, x ∂Λ

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.lambdaCoalescentMergerRate_dirac_three_three
theorems.statement: (fraction : ℝ) : lambdaCoalescentMergerRate (Measure.dirac fraction) 3 3 = fraction

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.lambdaRate_consistent
theorems.statement: (Λ : Measure ℝ) {b k : ℕ} (hk : 2 ≤ k) (hkb : k ≤ b) (h1 : Integrable (fun x : ℝ ↦ x ^ (k - 2) * (1 - x) ^ (b + 1 - k)) Λ) (h2 : Integrable (fun x : ℝ ↦ x ^ (k + 1 - 2) * (1 - x) ^ (b + 1 - (k + 1))) Λ) : lambdaCoalescentMergerRate Λ b k = lambdaCoalescentMergerRate Λ (b + 1) k + lambdaCoalescentMergerRate Λ (b + 1) (k + 1)

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.kingmanRate_consistent
theorems.statement: : IsConsistentRates kingmanRate

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.lambdaRate_dirac_zero
theorems.statement: {b k : ℕ} (hk : 2 ≤ k) (hkb : k ≤ b) : lambdaCoalescentMergerRate (Measure.dirac 0) b k = kingmanRate b k

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.binaryRate_const_of_consistent
theorems.statement: {lam : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ} (hcons : IsConsistentRates lam) (hbin : ∀ b k, 3 ≤ k → lam b k = 0) {b : ℕ} (hb : 2 ≤ b) : lam b 2 = lam (b + 1) 2

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.binaryRate_eq_base
theorems.statement: {lam : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ} (hcons : IsConsistentRates lam) (hbin : ∀ b k, 3 ≤ k → lam b k = 0) : ∀ b : ℕ, 2 ≤ b → lam b 2 = lam 2 2

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.eq_kingmanRate
theorems.statement: {lam : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ} (hcons : IsConsistentRates lam) (hbin : ∀ b k, 3 ≤ k → lam b k = 0) (hnorm : lam 2 2 = 1) {b k : ℕ} (hk : 2 ≤ k) (hkb : k ≤ b) : lam b k = kingmanRate b k

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.totalRate_kingman
theorems.statement: {b : ℕ} (hb : 2 ≤ b) : totalRate kingmanRate b = deathRate b

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.exp_neg_mul_holdDensity_eq
theorems.statement: {d θ : ℝ} (hdθ : 0 < d + θ) (t : ℝ) : Real.exp (-(θ * t)) * (d * Real.exp (-(d * t))) = (d / (d + θ)) * ((d + θ) * Real.exp (-((d + θ) * t)))

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.integral_exp_neg_mul_holdDensity
theorems.statement: {d θ : ℝ} (hd : 0 < d) (hθ : 0 ≤ θ) : ∫ t in Ioi (0 : ℝ), Real.exp (-(θ * t)) * (d * Real.exp (-(d * t))) = d / (d + θ)

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.integral_exp_neg_mul_holdDensity_zero
theorems.statement: {d : ℝ} (hd : 0 < d) : ∫ t in Ioi (0 : ℝ), Real.exp (-(0 * t)) * (d * Real.exp (-(d * t))) = 1

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.lintegral_exp_neg_holdMeasure
theorems.statement: {d θ : ℝ} (hd : 0 < d) (hθ : 0 ≤ θ) : ∫⁻ t, ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-(θ * t))) ∂(holdMeasure d) = ENNReal.ofReal (d / (d + θ))

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.coalescentLaw_prod
theorems.statement: (n k m : ℕ) (holdLaw : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure holdLaw] (A : Set (List (ER n))) (B : Set (Fin m → ℝ)) : coalescentLaw n k m holdLaw (A ×ˢ B) = (chainLaw n k).toMeasure A * (Measure.pi fun _ : Fin m ↦ holdLaw) B

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.coalescentLaw_chain_marginal
theorems.statement: (n k m : ℕ) (holdLaw : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure holdLaw] (A : Set (List (ER n))) : coalescentLaw n k m holdLaw (A ×ˢ Set.univ) = (chainLaw n k).toMeasure A

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.coalescentLaw_hold_marginal
theorems.statement: (n k m : ℕ) (holdLaw : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure holdLaw] (B : Set (Fin m → ℝ)) : coalescentLaw n k m holdLaw (Set.univ ×ˢ B) = (Measure.pi fun _ : Fin m ↦ holdLaw) B

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.coalescentLaw_finiteDimensional
theorems.statement: (n k m : ℕ) (holdLaw : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure holdLaw] (A : Set (List (ER n))) (t : ℝ) (j : ℕ) : coalescentLaw n k m holdLaw (A ×ˢ {h : Fin m → ℝ | blockCountAt n (extendHold h) t = j}) = (chainLaw n k).toMeasure A * (Measure.pi fun _ : Fin m ↦ holdLaw) {h | blockCountAt n (extendHold h) t = j}

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.coalescentLaw_support_chain'
theorems.statement: (n k m : ℕ) (holdLaw : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure holdLaw] {p : List (ER n) × (Fin m → ℝ)} (hp : p.1 ∈ (chainLaw n k).support) : List.Chain' (fun y x ↦ Covers x y ∨ y = x) p.1

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.lookdownApply_self
theorems.statement: {n : ℕ} {α : Type*} (i j : Fin n) (c : Fin n → α) : lookdownApply i j c j = c i

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.lookdownApply_of_ne
theorems.statement: {n : ℕ} {α : Type*} (i j : Fin n) (c : Fin n → α) {l : Fin n} (h : l ≠ j) : lookdownApply i j c l = c l

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.restrict_lookdownApply
theorems.statement: {m n : ℕ} (h : m ≤ n) {α : Type*} (i j : Fin n) (c : Fin n → α) (hi : (i : ℕ) < m) (hj : (j : ℕ) < m) : (lookdownApply i j c) ∘ Fin.castLE h = lookdownApply (⟨i, hi⟩ : Fin m) ⟨j, hj⟩ (c ∘ Fin.castLE h)

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.restrict_lookdownApply_of_le
theorems.statement: {m n : ℕ} (h : m ≤ n) {α : Type*} (i j : Fin n) (c : Fin n → α) (hj : m ≤ (j : ℕ)) : (lookdownApply i j c) ∘ Fin.castLE h = c ∘ Fin.castLE h

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.restrict_ker_lookdown
theorems.statement: {m n : ℕ} (h : m ≤ n) {α : Type*} (c : Fin n → α) : restrict h (Setoid.ker c) = Setoid.ker (c ∘ Fin.castLE h)

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.lookdown_consistent
theorems.statement: {m n : ℕ} (h : m ≤ n) {α : Type*} (i j : Fin n) (c : Fin n → α) : (∀ hj : (j : ℕ) < m, ∀ hi : (i : ℕ) < m, restrict h (Setoid.ker (lookdownApply i j c)) = Setoid.ker (lookdownApply (⟨i, hi⟩ : Fin m) ⟨j, hj⟩ (c ∘ Fin.castLE h))) ∧ (m ≤ (j : ℕ) → restrict h (Setoid.ker (lookdownApply i j c)) = restrict h (Setoid.ker c))

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.lookdown_survival
theorems.statement: (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ) : ∏ _p : {η : ER n // Covers (Delta n) η}, Real.exp (-t) = Real.exp (-(deathRate n * t))

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.lookdown_clock_factors
theorems.statement: {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) (t : ℝ) : Real.exp (-(deathRate n * t)) = jumpProb n * (deathRate n * Real.exp (-(deathRate n * t)))

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.lookdown_pair_prob
theorems.statement: {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) : jumpProb n = 2 / ((n : ℝ) * ((n : ℝ) - 1))

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.lookdown_pair_prob_normalised
theorems.statement: {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) : ((n.choose 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) * jumpProb n = 1

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.lookdown_driven_by_pair_clocks
theorems.statement: {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) (t : ℝ) : (∏ _p : {η : ER n // Covers (Delta n) η}, Real.exp (-t) = Real.exp (-(deathRate n * t))) ∧ (Real.exp (-(deathRate n * t)) = jumpProb n * (deathRate n * Real.exp (-(deathRate n * t)))) ∧ ((n.choose 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) * jumpProb n = 1

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.blocks_of_covers
theorems.statement: {n : ℕ} {ξ η : ER n} (h : Covers ξ η) : blocks η + 1 = blocks ξ

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.no_cover_of_blocks_ne
theorems.statement: {n : ℕ} {ξ η : ER n} (h : Covers ξ η) {v : ℕ} (hv : v + 1 ≠ blocks ξ) : blocks η ≠ v

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.lumping_criterion
theorems.statement: {n : ℕ} (ξ ξ' : ER n) (h : blocks ξ = blocks ξ') : Nat.card {η : ER n // Covers ξ η} = Nat.card {η : ER n // Covers ξ' η}

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.lumping_rate_eq_deathRate
theorems.statement: {n : ℕ} (ξ : ER n) : (Nat.card {η : ER n // Covers ξ η} : ℝ) = deathRate (blocks ξ)

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.no_covers_of_blocks_le_one
theorems.statement: {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {ξ η : ER n} (h : blocks ξ ≤ 1) : ¬ Covers ξ η

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.commute_idem_smul
theorems.statement: {A G : 𝔸} (hAG : A * G = G) (hGA : G * A = G) (s : ℝ) : Commute A (s • G)

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.idem_mul_exp_pow
theorems.statement: {A G : 𝔸} (hA : A * A = A) (hAG : A * G = G) (hGA : G * A = G) (s : ℝ) (m : ℕ) : (A * exp ℝ (s • G)) ^ (m + 1) = A * exp ℝ (((m + 1 : ℕ) * s) • G)

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.idem_mul_exp_pow_self
theorems.statement: {A G : 𝔸} (hA : A * A = A) (hAG : A * G = G) (hGA : G * A = G) {N : ℕ} (hN : 1 ≤ N) : (A * exp ℝ ((1 / (N : ℝ)) • G)) ^ N = A * exp ℝ G

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.sub_mul_pow_eq_sum
theorems.statement: (Y : ℕ → 𝔸) (D A : 𝔸) (hY0 : Y 0 = A) (m : ℕ) : Y m - A * D ^ m = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range m, (Y (j + 1) - Y j * D) * D ^ (m - 1 - j)

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.norm_sub_mul_pow_le
theorems.statement: {Y : ℕ → 𝔸} {D A : 𝔸} {M eps : ℝ} (hY0 : Y 0 = A) (m : ℕ) (hD : ∀ i, i ≤ m → ‖D ^ i‖ ≤ M) (hrec : ∀ n, n < m → ‖Y (n + 1) - Y n * D‖ ≤ eps) (heps : 0 ≤ eps) : ‖Y m - A * D ^ m‖ ≤ m * eps * M

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.norm_mul_le'
theorems.statement: {x y : 𝔸} {a b : ℝ} (hx : ‖x‖ ≤ a) (hy : ‖y‖ ≤ b) : ‖x * y‖ ≤ a * b

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.mohle_limit
theorems.statement: (A B : 𝔸) (hA : A * A = A) (hAn : ‖A‖ ≤ 1) (C : ℝ) (hC : 0 ≤ C) (P : ℕ → 𝔸) (hP : ∀ N, ‖P N‖ ≤ 1) (hexp : ∀ᶠ N in atTop, ‖P N - (A + (1 / (N : ℝ)) • B)‖ ≤ C / (N : ℝ) ^ 2) : Tendsto (fun N : ℕ ↦ P N ^ N) atTop (nhds (A * exp ℝ (A * B * A)))

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.moranMass_sum
theorems.statement: {N : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N) : ∑ k ∈ range 3, moranMass N k = 1

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.moranMass_moment
theorems.statement: {N : ℕ} (w : ℕ → ℝ) : ∑ k ∈ range 3, w k * moranMass N k = w 1 * (1 - 2 / (N : ℝ)) + (w 0 + w 2) * (1 / (N : ℝ))

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.moranMean
theorems.statement: {N : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N) : ∑ k ∈ range 3, (k : ℝ) * moranMass N k = 1

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.moranSecondMoment
theorems.statement: {N : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N) : ∑ k ∈ range 3, (k : ℝ) ^ 2 * moranMass N k = 1 + 2 / (N : ℝ)

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.moranVariance
theorems.statement: {N : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N) : (∑ k ∈ range 3, (k : ℝ) ^ 2 * moranMass N k) - (∑ k ∈ range 3, (k : ℝ) * moranMass N k) ^ 2 = 2 / (N : ℝ)

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.moranVariance_eq_two_mul_wrightFisherCoalescence
theorems.statement: {N : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N) : (∑ k ∈ range 3, (k : ℝ) ^ 2 * moranMass N k) - (∑ k ∈ range 3, (k : ℝ) * moranMass N k) ^ 2 = 2 * (1 - noCoalescenceProb N 2)

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.moranTimeScale_of_wrightFisherCoalescence
theorems.statement: {N : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N) : (N : ℝ) / (2 * (1 - noCoalescenceProb N 2)) = (N : ℝ) ^ 2 / 2

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.mergeSetMap_of_mem
theorems.statement: {n : ℕ} (ξ : ER n) {S : Finset (Quotient ξ)} {a c : Quotient ξ} (h : c ∈ S) : mergeSetMap ξ S a c = a

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.mergeSetMap_of_not_mem
theorems.statement: {n : ℕ} (ξ : ER n) {S : Finset (Quotient ξ)} {a c : Quotient ξ} (h : c ∉ S) : mergeSetMap ξ S a c = c

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.le_mergeSet
theorems.statement: {n : ℕ} (ξ : ER n) (S : Finset (Quotient ξ)) (a : Quotient ξ) : ξ ≤ mergeSet ξ S a

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.range_mergeSetMap
theorems.statement: {n : ℕ} (ξ : ER n) {S : Finset (Quotient ξ)} {a : Quotient ξ} (ha : a ∈ S) : Set.range (fun x : Fin n ↦ mergeSetMap ξ S a (Quotient.mk ξ x)) = {c | c ∉ S} ∪ {a}

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.blocks_mergeSet
theorems.statement: {n : ℕ} (ξ : ER n) {S : Finset (Quotient ξ)} {a : Quotient ξ} (ha : a ∈ S) : blocks (mergeSet ξ S a) + (S.card - 1) = blocks ξ

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.mergeSet_pair
theorems.statement: {n : ℕ} (ξ : ER n) {a b : Quotient ξ} (hab : a ≠ b) : mergeSet ξ {a, b} a = merge ξ a b

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.blocks_mergeSet_pair
theorems.statement: {n : ℕ} (ξ : ER n) {a b : Quotient ξ} (hab : a ≠ b) : blocks (mergeSet ξ {a, b} a) + 1 = blocks ξ

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.identityByDescent_eq
theorems.statement: {N : ℕ} (hN : 1 ≤ N) {β : ℝ} (hβ0 : 0 < β) (hβ1 : β ≤ 1) : identityByDescent N β = (1 - β) ^ 2 / (1 + ((N : ℝ) - 1) * (2 * β - β ^ 2))

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.tendsto_identityByDescent

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.sum_over_second_merger

theorems.statement: {h gam lamb : ℕ → ℝ} {p : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ} (hpos : ∀ b : ℕ, 2 ≤ b → 0 < gam b) (hmono : ∀ i j : ℕ, 2 ≤ i → i ≤ j → gam i ≤ gam j) (hlamb : ∀ b : ℕ, 2 ≤ b → 0 < lamb b) (hp0 : ∀ b k : ℕ, 0 ≤ p b k) (hp1 : ∀ b : ℕ, 2 ≤ b → ∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 2 b, p b k = 1) (hdrift : ∀ b : ℕ, 2 ≤ b → ∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 2 b, ((k : ℝ) - 1) * p b k = gam b / lamb b) (h1 : h 1 = 0) (hrec : ∀ b : ℕ, 2 ≤ b → h b = 1 / lamb b + ∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 2 b, p b k * h (b - k + 1)) (b : ℕ) (hb : 1 ≤ b) : h b ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 2 b, 1 / gam j

theorems.statement: {n : ℕ} {α : Type*} (u : ℕ → Fin n × Fin n) (c₀ : Fin n → α) (t : ℕ) : voterConfig u c₀ t = c₀ ∘ voterAncestor u t

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.voterConfig_eq_iff
theorems.statement: {n : ℕ} {α : Type*} (u : ℕ → Fin n × Fin n) (c₀ : Fin n → α) (t : ℕ) (x y : Fin n) (hinj : Function.Injective c₀) : voterConfig u c₀ t x = voterConfig u c₀ t y ↔ voterAncestor u t x = voterAncestor u t y

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.voterAncestralRel_zero
theorems.statement: {m n : ℕ} (u : ℕ → Fin n × Fin n) {sample : Fin m → Fin n} (hs : Function.Injective sample) : voterAncestralRel u sample 0 = Delta m

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.voterAncestralRel_le_succ
theorems.statement: {m n : ℕ} (u : ℕ → Fin n × Fin n) (sample : Fin m → Fin n) (s : ℕ) : voterAncestralRel u sample s ≤ voterAncestralRel u sample (s + 1)

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.restrict_voterAncestralRel
theorems.statement: {l m n : ℕ} (h : l ≤ m) (u : ℕ → Fin n × Fin n) (sample : Fin m → Fin n) (s : ℕ) : restrict h (voterAncestralRel u sample s) = voterAncestralRel u (sample ∘ Fin.castLE h) s

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.walk_zero
theorems.statement: (x₀ : ℤ) (step : ℕ → ℤ) : walk x₀ step 0 = x₀

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.walk_succ
theorems.statement: (x₀ : ℤ) (step : ℕ → ℤ) (t : ℕ) : walk x₀ step (t + 1) = walk x₀ step t + step t

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.walk_sub
theorems.statement: (x₀ y₀ : ℤ) (ξ η : ℕ → ℤ) (t : ℕ) : walk x₀ ξ t - walk y₀ η t = walk (x₀ - y₀) (fun s ↦ ξ s - η s) t

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.walk_difference
theorems.statement: (x₀ y₀ : ℤ) (ξ η : ℕ → ℤ) (t : ℕ) : Descent.Core.difference ((walk x₀ ξ t : ℤ) : ℝ) ((walk y₀ η t : ℤ) : ℝ) = ((walk (x₀ - y₀) (fun s ↦ ξ s - η s) t : ℤ) : ℝ)

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.meet_iff_difference_walk_zero
theorems.statement: (x₀ y₀ : ℤ) (ξ η : ℕ → ℤ) (t : ℕ) : walk x₀ ξ t = walk y₀ η t ↔ walk (x₀ - y₀) (fun s ↦ ξ s - η s) t = 0

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.walk_zero_step
theorems.statement: (x₀ : ℤ) (t : ℕ) : walk x₀ (fun _ ↦ 0) t = x₀

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.harmonicSumSq_zero
theorems.statement: : harmonicSumSq 0 = 0

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.harmonicSumSq_succ
theorems.statement: (m : ℕ) : harmonicSumSq (m + 1) = harmonicSumSq m + 1 / ((m : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.harmonicSumSq_nonneg
theorems.statement: (m : ℕ) : 0 ≤ harmonicSumSq m

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.harmonicSumSq_le
theorems.statement: {m : ℕ} (hm : 1 ≤ m) : harmonicSumSq m ≤ 2 - 1 / (m : ℝ)

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.harmonicSumSq_le_two
theorems.statement: (m : ℕ) : harmonicSumSq m ≤ 2

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.varTotalBranchLength_eq
theorems.statement: (n : ℕ) : varTotalBranchLength n = 4 * harmonicSumSq (n - 1)

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.varTotalBranchLength_nonneg
theorems.statement: (n : ℕ) : 0 ≤ varTotalBranchLength n

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.varTotalBranchLength_le_eight
theorems.statement: (n : ℕ) : varTotalBranchLength n ≤ 8

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.varSegregatingSites_eq_totalVariance
theorems.statement: (θ : Descent.Core.Theta) (n : ℕ) : varSegregatingSites θ n = θ.value / 2 * expectedTotalBranchLength n + (θ.value / 2) ^ 2 * varTotalBranchLength n

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.varSegregatingSites_nonneg
theorems.statement: {θ : Descent.Core.Theta} (hθ : 0 ≤ θ.value) (n : ℕ) : 0 ≤ varSegregatingSites θ n

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.varWattersonEstimator_le
theorems.statement: {θ : Descent.Core.Theta} (hθ : 0 ≤ θ.value) {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ harmonicSum (n - 1)) : varWattersonEstimator θ n ≤ (θ.value + 2 * θ.value ^ 2) / harmonicSum (n - 1)

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.exists_varWattersonEstimator_lt
theorems.statement: {θ : Descent.Core.Theta} (hθ : 0 ≤ θ.value) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) : ∃ n : ℕ, varWattersonEstimator θ n < ε

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.varPairwise_two_eq
theorems.statement: (θ : Descent.Core.Theta) : tajimaVarPairwise θ 2 = varSegregatingSites θ 2

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.splitBy_rel_iff
theorems.statement: {n : ℕ} (η : ER n) (S : Finset (Fin n)) (x y : Fin n) : (splitBy η S).r x y ↔ (η.r x y ∧ (x ∈ S ↔ y ∈ S))

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.splitBy_le
theorems.statement: {n : ℕ} (η : ER n) (S : Finset (Fin n)) : splitBy η S ≤ η

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.range_splitMap
theorems.statement: {n : ℕ} (η : ER n) (S : Finset (Fin n)) {a : Fin n} (hSa : ∀ x ∈ S, η.r x a) (hSne : ∃ x, x ∈ S) (hSproper : ∃ x, η.r x a ∧ x ∉ S) : Set.range (fun x : Fin n ↦ (Quotient.mk η x, decide (x ∈ S))) = {p | p.2 = false} ∪ {(Quotient.mk η a, true)}

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.blocks_splitBy
theorems.statement: {n : ℕ} (η : ER n) (S : Finset (Fin n)) {a : Fin n} (hSa : ∀ x ∈ S, η.r x a) (hSne : ∃ x, x ∈ S) (hSproper : ∃ x, η.r x a ∧ x ∉ S) : blocks (splitBy η S) = blocks η + 1

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.splitBy_covers
theorems.statement: {n : ℕ} (η : ER n) (S : Finset (Fin n)) {a : Fin n} (hSa : ∀ x ∈ S, η.r x a) (hSne : ∃ x, x ∈ S) (hSproper : ∃ x, η.r x a ∧ x ∉ S) : Covers (splitBy η S) η

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.eq_splitBy_merge
theorems.statement: {n : ℕ} (ξ : ER n) {a b : Quotient ξ} (hab : a ≠ b) : ξ = splitBy (merge ξ a b) (Finset.univ.filter fun x ↦ Quotient.mk ξ x = a)

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.covers_iff_exists_splitBy
theorems.statement: {n : ℕ} (ξ η : ER n) : Covers ξ η ↔ ∃ S : Finset (Fin n), ξ = splitBy η S ∧ Covers (splitBy η S) η

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.splitBy_compl
theorems.statement: {n : ℕ} (η : ER n) (S : Finset (Fin n)) (a : Fin n) (hSa : ∀ x ∈ S, η.r x a) : splitBy η S = splitBy η ((Finset.univ.filter fun z ↦ η.r z a) \ S)

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.exists_rel_ne_of_ne_bot
theorems.statement: {n : ℕ} {ξ : ER n} (h : ξ ≠ Delta n) : ∃ x y : Fin n, x ≠ y ∧ ξ.r x y

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.exists_covers_of_ne_bot
theorems.statement: {n : ℕ} {ξ : ER n} (h : ξ ≠ Delta n) : ∃ ξ' : ER n, Covers ξ' ξ

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.splitBy_eq_iff
theorems.statement: {n : ℕ} (η : ER n) (S T : Finset (Fin n)) : splitBy η S = splitBy η T ↔ ∀ x y : Fin n, η.r x y → ((x ∈ S ↔ y ∈ S) ↔ (x ∈ T ↔ y ∈ T))

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.quotient_mk_surjective
theorems.statement: {n : ℕ} (ξ : ER n) : Function.Surjective (Quotient.mk ξ)

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.blocks_bot
theorems.statement: (n : ℕ) : blocks (Delta n) = n

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.blocks_top
theorems.statement: (n : ℕ) [NeZero n] : blocks (Theta n) = 1

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.blocks_eq_one_iff
theorems.statement: {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (ξ : ER n) : blocks ξ = 1 ↔ ξ = Theta n

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.blocks_pos
theorems.statement: {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (ξ : ER n) : 0 < blocks ξ

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.blockMap_surjective
theorems.statement: {n : ℕ} {ξ η : ER n} (h : ξ ≤ η) : Function.Surjective (blockMap h)

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.mergeMap_apply_of_ne
theorems.statement: {n : ℕ} (ξ : ER n) (a b c : Quotient ξ) (h : c ≠ b) : mergeMap ξ a b c = c

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.mergeMap_apply_self
theorems.statement: {n : ℕ} (ξ : ER n) (a b : Quotient ξ) : mergeMap ξ a b b = a

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.mergeMap_eq_iff
theorems.statement: {n : ℕ} (ξ : ER n) {a b : Quotient ξ} (hab : a ≠ b) (x y : Quotient ξ) : mergeMap ξ a b x = mergeMap ξ a b y ↔ x = y ∨ (x = a ∧ y = b) ∨ (x = b ∧ y = a)

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.le_merge
theorems.statement: {n : ℕ} (ξ : ER n) (a b : Quotient ξ) : ξ ≤ merge ξ a b

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.merge_rel
theorems.statement: {n : ℕ} (ξ : ER n) (a b : Quotient ξ) {x y : Fin n} (hx : Quotient.mk ξ x = a) (hy : Quotient.mk ξ y = b) : (merge ξ a b).r x y

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.range_mergeMap
theorems.statement: {n : ℕ} (ξ : ER n) {a b : Quotient ξ} (hab : a ≠ b) : Set.range (fun x : Fin n ↦ mergeMap ξ a b (Quotient.mk ξ x)) = {c | c ≠ b}

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.blocks_merge
theorems.statement: {n : ℕ} (ξ : ER n) {a b : Quotient ξ} (hab : a ≠ b) : blocks (merge ξ a b) + 1 = blocks ξ

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.merge_covers
theorems.statement: {n : ℕ} (ξ : ER n) {a b : Quotient ξ} (hab : a ≠ b) : Covers ξ (merge ξ a b)

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.eq_of_le_of_blocks_eq
theorems.statement: {n : ℕ} {ξ η : ER n} (h : ξ ≤ η) (hb : blocks ξ = blocks η) : ξ = η

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.covers_iff_exists_merge
theorems.statement: {n : ℕ} (ξ η : ER n) : Covers ξ η ↔ ∃ a b : Quotient ξ, a ≠ b ∧ η = merge ξ a b

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.merge_comm
theorems.statement: {n : ℕ} (ξ : ER n) {a b : Quotient ξ} (hab : a ≠ b) : merge ξ a b = merge ξ b a

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.merge_eq_merge_iff
theorems.statement: {n : ℕ} (ξ : ER n) {a b c d : Quotient ξ} (hab : a ≠ b) (hcd : c ≠ d) : merge ξ a b = merge ξ c d ↔ ({a, b} : Finset (Quotient ξ)) = {c, d}

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.pair_spec
theorems.statement: {n : ℕ} {ξ : ER n} {s : Finset (Quotient ξ)} (h : s.card = 2) : pairFst h ≠ pairSnd h ∧ s = {pairFst h, pairSnd h}

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.coverOfPair_bijective
theorems.statement: {n : ℕ} (ξ : ER n) : Function.Bijective (coverOfPair ξ)

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.card_covers
theorems.statement: {n : ℕ} (ξ : ER n) : Nat.card {η : ER n // Covers ξ η} = (blocks ξ).choose 2

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.two_mul_choose_two
theorems.statement: (k : ℕ) : 2 * k.choose 2 = k * (k - 1)

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.card_covers_eq_deathRate
theorems.statement: {n : ℕ} (ξ : ER n) : (Nat.card {η : ER n // Covers ξ η} : ℝ) = deathRate (blocks ξ)

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.nonempty_covers
theorems.statement: {n : ℕ} (ξ : ER n) (hk : 2 ≤ blocks ξ) : Nonempty {η : ER n // Covers ξ η}

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.stepLaw_prod
theorems.statement: {n : ℕ} (ξ : ER n) (hk : 2 ≤ blocks ξ) (A : Set {η : ER n // Covers ξ η}) (B : Set ℝ) : stepLaw ξ hk (A ×ˢ B) = (jumpStep ξ hk).toMeasure A * holdMeasure (deathRate (blocks ξ)) B

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.stepLaw_destination_marginal
theorems.statement: {n : ℕ} (ξ : ER n) (hk : 2 ≤ blocks ξ) (A : Set {η : ER n // Covers ξ η}) : stepLaw ξ hk (A ×ˢ Set.univ) = (jumpStep ξ hk).toMeasure A

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.stepLaw_time_marginal
theorems.statement: {n : ℕ} (ξ : ER n) (hk : 2 ≤ blocks ξ) (B : Set ℝ) : stepLaw ξ hk (Set.univ ×ˢ B) = holdMeasure (deathRate (blocks ξ)) B

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.firstStep_same
theorems.statement: {M : ℝ} (hM : 0 < M) : meanTimeSame M = 1 / (1 + M) + (M / (1 + M)) * meanTimeDiff M

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.firstStep_diff
theorems.statement: {M : ℝ} (hM : 0 < M) : meanTimeDiff M = 1 / M + meanTimeSame M

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.meanTimeSame_eq_two
theorems.statement: (M : ℝ) : meanTimeSame M = 2

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.meanTimeSame_eq_two_mul_meanTransitTime
theorems.statement: (M : ℝ) : meanTimeSame M = 2 * meanTransitTime 2

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.fstFromMigration_eq_proportionalReduction
theorems.statement: (M : ℝ) (h : meanTimeDiff M ≠ 0) : fstFromMigration M = Descent.Core.proportionalReduction (meanTimeSame M) (meanTimeDiff M)

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.fstFromMigration_ne_proportionalReduction_at_zero
theorems.statement: (M : ℝ) (h : meanTimeDiff M = 0) : fstFromMigration M = 0 ∧ Descent.Core.proportionalReduction (meanTimeSame M) (meanTimeDiff M) = 1

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.fstFromMigration_eq
theorems.statement: {M : ℝ} (hM : 0 < M) : fstFromMigration M = 1 / (1 + 2 * M)

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.fstFromMigration_antitone
theorems.statement: {M M' : ℝ} (hM : 0 < M) (h : M ≤ M') : fstFromMigration M' ≤ fstFromMigration M

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.tendsto_fstFromMigration
theorems.statement: : Tendsto (fun M : ℝ ↦ fstFromMigration M) atTop (nhds 0)

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.cramerCoordinate_eq_det_ratio
theorems.statement: (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (b : ι → ℝ) (k : ι) : cramerCoordinate A b k = (replaceColumn A b k).det / A.det

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.cramerCoordinate_ratio_eq_replaceColumn_ratio
theorems.statement: (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (b : ι → ℝ) (numerator denominator : ι) (hoperator : A.det ≠ 0) (hdenominator : (replaceColumn A b denominator).det ≠ 0) : cramerCoordinate A b numerator / cramerCoordinate A b denominator = (replaceColumn A b numerator).det / (replaceColumn A b denominator).det

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.cramerCoordinate_at_singular_is_junk
theorems.statement: (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (b : ι → ℝ) (k : ι) (h : A.det = 0) : cramerCoordinate A b k = 0

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.solvedTwoDemeMixedMoment_eq_cramer
theorems.statement: (r : TwoDemeRates) (K i j : ℕ) (hnotzero : ¬ (i = 0 ∧ j = 0)) (hi : i < K + 1) (hj : j < K + 1) (hdegree : i + j ≤ K) : solvedTwoDemeMixedMoment r K i j = cramerCoordinate (twoDemeMomentMatrix r K) (twoDemeMomentForcing r K) (⟨i, hi⟩, ⟨j, hj⟩)

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.solvedTwoDemeJointSampleCount_outside
theorems.statement: (ns nt : ℕ) (system : NonsingularTwoDemeMomentSystem (ns + nt)) (i j : ℕ) (h : ¬ (i ≤ ns ∧ j ≤ nt)) : solvedTwoDemeJointSampleCount ns nt system i j = 0

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.targetCountHeterozygosity_zero
theorems.statement: (sampleSize : ℕ) (domain : 2 ≤ sampleSize) : targetCountHeterozygosity sampleSize 0 domain = 0

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.targetCountHeterozygosity_self
theorems.statement: (sampleSize : ℕ) (domain : 2 ≤ sampleSize) : targetCountHeterozygosity sampleSize sampleSize domain = 0

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.sourcePolymorphicTargetStatisticMass_scaledSub
theorems.statement: (jointCount : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) (ns nt : ℕ) (scale : ℝ) (first second : ℕ → ℝ) : sourcePolymorphicTargetStatisticMass jointCount ns nt (fun count ↦ scale * (first count - second count)) = scale * (sourcePolymorphicTargetStatisticMass jointCount ns nt first - sourcePolymorphicTargetStatisticMass jointCount ns nt second)

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.targetHeterozygosityGivenSourcePolymorphic_eq_factorialMoments
theorems.statement: (jointCount : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) (ns nt : ℕ) (hnt : 2 ≤ nt) : targetHeterozygosityGivenSourcePolymorphic jointCount ns nt = (targetFactorialMomentGivenSourcePolymorphic jointCount ns nt 1).bind fun first ↦ (targetFactorialMomentGivenSourcePolymorphic jointCount ns nt 2).map fun second ↦ 2 * (first - second)

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.matrix_add_metzlerShift_nonneg
theorems.statement: {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (hA : Matrix.IsMetzler A) (row column : ι) : 0 ≤ (A + matrixMetzlerShift A • (1 : Matrix ι ι ℝ)) row column

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.matrix_pow_apply_nonneg_of_nonneg
theorems.statement: {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (hA : ∀ row column, 0 ≤ A row column) : ∀ power row column, 0 ≤ (A ^ power) row column

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.matrixExponential_apply_nonneg_of_nonneg
theorems.statement: {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (hA : ∀ row column, 0 ≤ A row column) (time : ℝ) (time_nonneg : 0 ≤ time) (row column : ι) : 0 ≤ matrixExponential A time row column

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.matrixExponential_eq_normedSpace_exp
theorems.statement: {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (time : ℝ) : matrixExponential A time = NormedSpace.exp ℝ (time • A)

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.matrixExponential_apply_nonneg_of_metzler
theorems.statement: {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (hA : Matrix.IsMetzler A) (time : ℝ) (time_nonneg : 0 ≤ time) (row column : ι) : 0 ≤ matrixExponential A time row column

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.matrixExponential_transpose
theorems.statement: {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (time : ℝ) : matrixExponential A.transpose time = (matrixExponential A time).transpose

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.matrixExponential_samplingDual
theorems.statement: {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (time : ℝ) (probe state : ι → ℝ) : probe ⬝ᵥ (matrixExponential A time).mulVec state = (matrixExponential A.transpose time).mulVec probe ⬝ᵥ state

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.matrixExponentialSeries_summable
theorems.statement: {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (time : ℝ) : Summable (fun power : ℕ ↦ ((power.factorial : ℝ)⁻¹) • ((time • A) ^ power))

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.matrixExponentialSeries_norm_summable
theorems.statement: {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (time : ℝ) : Summable (fun power : ℕ ↦ ‖((power.factorial : ℝ)⁻¹) • ((time • A) ^ power)‖)

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.matrixExponential_eq_partialSum_add_tail
theorems.statement: {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (time : ℝ) (terms : ℕ) : matrixExponential A time = matrixExponentialPartialSum A time terms + ∑' offset : ℕ, (((offset + terms).factorial : ℝ)⁻¹) • ((time • A) ^ (offset + terms))

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.matrixExponentialTailBound_nonneg
theorems.statement: {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (time : ℝ) (terms : ℕ) : 0 ≤ matrixExponentialTailBound A time terms

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.matrixExponentialTailBound_tendsto_zero
theorems.statement: {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (time : ℝ) : Tendsto (fun terms ↦ matrixExponentialTailBound A time terms) atTop (𝓝 0)

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.matrixExponentialPartialSum_tendsto
theorems.statement: {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (time : ℝ) : Tendsto (fun terms ↦ matrixExponentialPartialSum A time terms) atTop (𝓝 (matrixExponential A time))

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.matrixExponential_partialSum_error_le_tailBound
theorems.statement: {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (time : ℝ) (terms : ℕ) : ‖matrixExponential A time - matrixExponentialPartialSum A time terms‖ ≤ matrixExponentialTailBound A time terms

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.matrixExponential_partialSum_mulVec_error_le
theorems.statement: {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (time : ℝ) (terms : ℕ) (vector : ι → ℝ) : ‖(matrixExponential A time).mulVec vector - (matrixExponentialPartialSum A time terms).mulVec vector‖ ≤ matrixExponentialTailBound A time terms * ‖vector‖

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.abs_dotProduct_le_norm_mul_sum_abs
theorems.statement: {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (left right : ι → ℝ) : |left ⬝ᵥ right| ≤ ‖left‖ * ∑ coordinate, |right coordinate|

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.matrix_pow_intertwines
theorems.statement: {ι κ : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq ι] [DecidableEq κ] (projection : Matrix κ ι ℝ) (source : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (target : Matrix κ κ ℝ) (hgenerator : projection * source = target * projection) (power : ℕ) : projection * source ^ power = target ^ power * projection

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.matrixExponential_intertwines
theorems.statement: {ι κ : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq ι] [DecidableEq κ] (projection : Matrix κ ι ℝ) (source : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (target : Matrix κ κ ℝ) (hgenerator : projection * source = target * projection) (time : ℝ) : projection * matrixExponential source time = matrixExponential target time * projection

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.matrixExponential_zero
theorems.statement: {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ) : matrixExponential A 0 = 1

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.matrixExponential_zero_matrix
theorems.statement: {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (time : ℝ) : matrixExponential (0 : Matrix ι ι ℝ) time = 1

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.matrixExponential_mulVec_apply_of_row_zero
theorems.statement: {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (time : ℝ) (state : ι → ℝ) (coordinate : ι) (hrow : ∀ column, A coordinate column = 0) : (matrixExponential A time).mulVec state coordinate = state coordinate

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.twoDemeJointSampleCount_outside
theorems.statement: (law : TwoDemePresentDayLaw) (ns nt i j : ℕ) (h : ¬ (i ≤ ns ∧ j ≤ nt)) : twoDemeJointSampleCount law ns nt i j = 0

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.AffineTwoDemeLDSystem.crossD_eq_det_ratio
theorems.statement: {n : ℕ} (sys : AffineTwoDemeLDSystem n) (rho M : ℝ) : sys.toSystem.crossD rho M = (replaceColumn (sys.drift + rho • sys.recombination + M • sys.migration) (fun i ↦ -(sys.forcingBase i + M * sys.forcingMigration i)) sys.crossSourceTarget).det / (sys.drift + rho • sys.recombination + M • sys.migration).det

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.TwoDemeLDSystem.crossDCorrelation_eq_cramer_numerator_ratio
theorems.statement: {n : ℕ} (sys : TwoDemeLDSystem n) (rho M : ℝ) (hdet : (sys.operator rho M).det ≠ 0) (hwithin : (replaceColumn (sys.operator rho M) (fun i ↦ -sys.forcing M i) sys.withinSource).det ≠ 0) : sys.crossDCorrelation rho M = (replaceColumn (sys.operator rho M) (fun i ↦ -sys.forcing M i) sys.crossSourceTarget).det / (replaceColumn (sys.operator rho M) (fun i ↦ -sys.forcing M i) sys.withinSource).det

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.TwoDemeLDSystem.crossDCorrelation_panmixia
theorems.statement: {n : ℕ} (sys : TwoDemeLDSystem n) (rho M : ℝ) (hwithin : sys.withinD rho M ≠ 0) (hpan : sys.crossD rho M = sys.withinD rho M) : sys.crossDCorrelation rho M = 1

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.incrementExponent_decrementExponent
theorems.statement: {D : ℕ} (exponent : Fin D → ℕ) (deme : Fin D) (positive : 0 < exponent deme) : incrementExponent (decrementExponent exponent deme) deme = exponent

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.sum_incrementExponent
theorems.statement: {D : ℕ} (exponent : Fin D → ℕ) (deme : Fin D) : ∑ d, incrementExponent exponent deme d = (∑ d, exponent d) + 1

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.sum_decrementExponent
theorems.statement: {D : ℕ} (exponent : Fin D → ℕ) (deme : Fin D) (positive : 0 < exponent deme) : ∑ d, decrementExponent exponent deme d = (∑ d, exponent d) - 1

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.sum_decrementExponent_le
theorems.statement: {D : ℕ} (exponent : Fin D → ℕ) (deme : Fin D) : (∑ d, decrementExponent exponent deme d) ≤ ∑ d, exponent d

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.eval_manyDemeBernsteinPolynomial
theorems.statement: {D : ℕ} (frequency : Fin D → ℝ) (derived ancestral : Fin D → ℕ) : MvPolynomial.eval frequency (manyDemeBernsteinPolynomial derived ancestral) = manyDemeBernsteinWeight frequency derived ancestral

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.pderiv_manyDemeBernsteinPolynomialFactor_of_ne
theorems.statement: {D : ℕ} (different deme : Fin D) (derived ancestral : ℕ) (distinct : different ≠ deme) : MvPolynomial.pderiv deme (manyDemeBernsteinPolynomialFactor different derived ancestral) = 0

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.manyDemeBernsteinPolynomial_zeroAncestral_eq_monomial
theorems.statement: {D : ℕ} (exponent : Fin D → ℕ) : manyDemeBernsteinPolynomial exponent (fun _ ↦ 0) = MvPolynomial.monomial (Finsupp.equivFunOnFinite.symm exponent) 1

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.manyDemeBernsteinPolynomialFactor_totalDegree_le
theorems.statement: {D : ℕ} (deme : Fin D) (derived ancestral : ℕ) : (manyDemeBernsteinPolynomialFactor deme derived ancestral).totalDegree ≤ derived + ancestral

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.manyDemeBernsteinPolynomial_totalDegree_le
theorems.statement: {D : ℕ} (derived ancestral : Fin D → ℕ) : (manyDemeBernsteinPolynomial derived ancestral).totalDegree ≤ (∑ deme, derived deme) + ∑ deme, ancestral deme

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.pderiv_manyDemeBernsteinPolynomial_prod_of_not_mem
theorems.statement: {D : ℕ} (deme : Fin D) (derived ancestral : Fin D → ℕ) (demes : Finset (Fin D)) (absent : deme ∉ demes) : MvPolynomial.pderiv deme (∏ different ∈ demes, manyDemeBernsteinPolynomialFactor different (derived different) (ancestral different)) = 0

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.pderiv_manyDemeBernsteinPolynomialFactor_self
theorems.statement: {D : ℕ} (deme : Fin D) (derived ancestral : ℕ) : MvPolynomial.pderiv deme (manyDemeBernsteinPolynomialFactor deme derived ancestral) = MvPolynomial.C (derived : ℝ) * manyDemeBernsteinPolynomialFactor deme (derived - 1) ancestral - MvPolynomial.C (ancestral : ℝ) * manyDemeBernsteinPolynomialFactor deme derived (ancestral - 1)

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.frequency_mul_manyDemeBernsteinWeight_decrementDerived
theorems.statement: {D : ℕ} (frequency : Fin D → ℝ) (derived ancestral : Fin D → ℕ) (deme : Fin D) (positive : 0 < derived deme) : frequency deme * manyDemeBernsteinWeight frequency (decrementExponent derived deme) ancestral = manyDemeBernsteinWeight frequency derived ancestral

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.complement_mul_manyDemeBernsteinWeight_decrementAncestral
theorems.statement: {D : ℕ} (frequency : Fin D → ℝ) (derived ancestral : Fin D → ℕ) (deme : Fin D) (positive : 0 < ancestral deme) : (1 - frequency deme) * manyDemeBernsteinWeight frequency derived (decrementExponent ancestral deme) = manyDemeBernsteinWeight frequency derived ancestral

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.frequency_mul_manyDemeBernsteinWeight_eq_incrementDerived
theorems.statement: {D : ℕ} (frequency : Fin D → ℝ) (derived ancestral : Fin D → ℕ) (deme : Fin D) : frequency deme * manyDemeBernsteinWeight frequency derived ancestral = manyDemeBernsteinWeight frequency (incrementExponent derived deme) ancestral

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.complement_mul_manyDemeBernsteinWeight_eq_incrementAncestral
theorems.statement: {D : ℕ} (frequency : Fin D → ℝ) (derived ancestral : Fin D → ℕ) (deme : Fin D) : (1 - frequency deme) * manyDemeBernsteinWeight frequency derived ancestral = manyDemeBernsteinWeight frequency derived (incrementExponent ancestral deme)

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.manyDemeBernsteinPolynomial_incrementAncestral
theorems.statement: {D : ℕ} (derived ancestral : Fin D → ℕ) (deme : Fin D) : manyDemeBernsteinPolynomial derived (incrementExponent ancestral deme) = manyDemeBernsteinPolynomial derived ancestral - manyDemeBernsteinPolynomial (incrementExponent derived deme) ancestral

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.migrateExponent_eq_increment_decrement
theorems.statement: {D : ℕ} (exponent : Fin D → ℕ) (src dst : Fin D) (distinct : src ≠ dst) : migrateExponent exponent src dst = incrementExponent (decrementExponent exponent src) dst

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.sum_migrateExponent
theorems.statement: {D : ℕ} (exponent : Fin D → ℕ) (src dst : Fin D) (distinct : src ≠ dst) (positive : 0 < exponent src) : ∑ d, migrateExponent exponent src dst d = ∑ d, exponent d

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.frequency_mul_manyDemeBernsteinWeight_decrementDerived_eq_migrate
theorems.statement: {D : ℕ} (frequency : Fin D → ℝ) (derived ancestral : Fin D → ℕ) (src dst : Fin D) (distinct : src ≠ dst) : frequency dst * manyDemeBernsteinWeight frequency (decrementExponent derived src) ancestral = manyDemeBernsteinWeight frequency (migrateExponent derived src dst) ancestral

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.complement_mul_manyDemeBernsteinWeight_decrementAncestral_eq_migrate
theorems.statement: {D : ℕ} (frequency : Fin D → ℝ) (derived ancestral : Fin D → ℕ) (src dst : Fin D) (distinct : src ≠ dst) : (1 - frequency dst) * manyDemeBernsteinWeight frequency derived (decrementExponent ancestral src) = manyDemeBernsteinWeight frequency derived (migrateExponent ancestral src dst)

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.pderiv_manyDemeBernsteinPolynomial
theorems.statement: {D : ℕ} (derived ancestral : Fin D → ℕ) (deme : Fin D) : MvPolynomial.pderiv deme (manyDemeBernsteinPolynomial derived ancestral) = manyDemeBernsteinFirstDerivativePolynomial derived ancestral deme

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.pderiv_pderiv_manyDemeBernsteinPolynomial
theorems.statement: {D : ℕ} (derived ancestral : Fin D → ℕ) (deme : Fin D) : MvPolynomial.pderiv deme (MvPolynomial.pderiv deme (manyDemeBernsteinPolynomial derived ancestral)) = manyDemeBernsteinSecondDerivativePolynomial derived ancestral deme

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.eval_manyDemeBernsteinFirstDerivativePolynomial
theorems.statement: {D : ℕ} (frequency : Fin D → ℝ) (derived ancestral : Fin D → ℕ) (deme : Fin D) : MvPolynomial.eval frequency (manyDemeBernsteinFirstDerivativePolynomial derived ancestral deme) = manyDemeBernsteinFirstDerivative frequency derived ancestral deme

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.eval_manyDemeBernsteinSecondDerivativePolynomial
theorems.statement: {D : ℕ} (frequency : Fin D → ℝ) (derived ancestral : Fin D → ℕ) (deme : Fin D) : MvPolynomial.eval frequency (manyDemeBernsteinSecondDerivativePolynomial derived ancestral deme) = manyDemeBernsteinSecondDerivative frequency derived ancestral deme

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.bernsteinWeight_derivedCoalescence_identity
theorems.statement: {D : ℕ} (frequency : Fin D → ℝ) (derived ancestral : Fin D → ℕ) (deme : Fin D) : ((derived deme * (derived deme - 1) : ℕ) : ℝ) * frequency deme * (1 - frequency deme) * manyDemeBernsteinWeight frequency (decrementExponent (decrementExponent derived deme) deme) ancestral = ((derived deme * (derived deme - 1) : ℕ) : ℝ) * (manyDemeBernsteinWeight frequency (decrementExponent derived deme) ancestral - manyDemeBernsteinWeight frequency derived ancestral)

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.bernsteinWeight_ancestralCoalescence_identity
theorems.statement: {D : ℕ} (frequency : Fin D → ℝ) (derived ancestral : Fin D → ℕ) (deme : Fin D) : ((ancestral deme * (ancestral deme - 1) : ℕ) : ℝ) * frequency deme * (1 - frequency deme) * manyDemeBernsteinWeight frequency derived (decrementExponent (decrementExponent ancestral deme) deme) = ((ancestral deme * (ancestral deme - 1) : ℕ) : ℝ) * (manyDemeBernsteinWeight frequency derived (decrementExponent ancestral deme) - manyDemeBernsteinWeight frequency derived ancestral)

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.bernsteinWeight_oppositeCoalescence_identity
theorems.statement: {D : ℕ} (frequency : Fin D → ℝ) (derived ancestral : Fin D → ℕ) (deme : Fin D) : (derived deme * ancestral deme : ℕ) * frequency deme * (1 - frequency deme) * manyDemeBernsteinWeight frequency (decrementExponent derived deme) (decrementExponent ancestral deme) = (derived deme * ancestral deme : ℕ) * manyDemeBernsteinWeight frequency derived ancestral

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.bernsteinWeight_derivedMigration_identity
theorems.statement: {D : ℕ} (rates : ManyDemeRates D) (frequency : Fin D → ℝ) (derived ancestral : Fin D → ℕ) (src dst : Fin D) : rates.migration src dst * derived src * (frequency dst - frequency src) * manyDemeBernsteinWeight frequency (decrementExponent derived src) ancestral = rates.migration src dst * derived src * (manyDemeBernsteinWeight frequency (migrateExponent derived src dst) ancestral - manyDemeBernsteinWeight frequency derived ancestral)

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.bernsteinWeight_ancestralMigration_identity
theorems.statement: {D : ℕ} (rates : ManyDemeRates D) (frequency : Fin D → ℝ) (derived ancestral : Fin D → ℕ) (src dst : Fin D) : -(rates.migration src dst * ancestral src * (frequency dst - frequency src) * manyDemeBernsteinWeight frequency derived (decrementExponent ancestral src)) = rates.migration src dst * ancestral src * (manyDemeBernsteinWeight frequency derived (migrateExponent ancestral src dst) - manyDemeBernsteinWeight frequency derived ancestral)

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.bernsteinWeight_derivedMutation_identity
theorems.statement: {D : ℕ} (frequency : Fin D → ℝ) (derived ancestral : Fin D → ℕ) (deme : Fin D) : derived deme * (1 - 2 * frequency deme) * manyDemeBernsteinWeight frequency (decrementExponent derived deme) ancestral = derived deme * (manyDemeBernsteinWeight frequency (decrementExponent derived deme) (incrementExponent ancestral deme) - manyDemeBernsteinWeight frequency derived ancestral)

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.bernsteinWeight_ancestralMutation_identity
theorems.statement: {D : ℕ} (frequency : Fin D → ℝ) (derived ancestral : Fin D → ℕ) (deme : Fin D) : -(ancestral deme * (1 - 2 * frequency deme) * manyDemeBernsteinWeight frequency derived (decrementExponent ancestral deme)) = ancestral deme * (manyDemeBernsteinWeight frequency (incrementExponent derived deme) (decrementExponent ancestral deme) - manyDemeBernsteinWeight frequency derived ancestral)

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.bernsteinWeight_coalescenceChannel_identity
theorems.statement: {D : ℕ} (rates : ManyDemeRates D) (frequency : Fin D → ℝ) (derived ancestral : Fin D → ℕ) (deme : Fin D) : rates.coalescence deme / 2 * frequency deme * (1 - frequency deme) * manyDemeBernsteinSecondDerivative frequency derived ancestral deme = rates.coalescence deme * ((derived deme * (derived deme - 1) : ℕ) : ℝ) / 2 * (manyDemeBernsteinWeight frequency (decrementExponent derived deme) ancestral - manyDemeBernsteinWeight frequency derived ancestral) + rates.coalescence deme * ((ancestral deme * (ancestral deme - 1) : ℕ) : ℝ) / 2 * (manyDemeBernsteinWeight frequency derived (decrementExponent ancestral deme) - manyDemeBernsteinWeight frequency derived ancestral) - rates.coalescence deme * derived deme * ancestral deme * manyDemeBernsteinWeight frequency derived ancestral

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.bernsteinWeight_migrationChannel_identity
theorems.statement: {D : ℕ} (rates : ManyDemeRates D) (frequency : Fin D → ℝ) (derived ancestral : Fin D → ℕ) (src dst : Fin D) : rates.migration src dst * (frequency dst - frequency src) * manyDemeBernsteinFirstDerivative frequency derived ancestral src = rates.migration src dst * derived src * (manyDemeBernsteinWeight frequency (migrateExponent derived src dst) ancestral - manyDemeBernsteinWeight frequency derived ancestral) + rates.migration src dst * ancestral src * (manyDemeBernsteinWeight frequency derived (migrateExponent ancestral src dst) - manyDemeBernsteinWeight frequency derived ancestral)

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.bernsteinWeight_symmetricMutationChannel_identity
theorems.statement: {D : ℕ} (rates : ManyDemeRates D) (frequency : Fin D → ℝ) (derived ancestral : Fin D → ℕ) (deme : Fin D) (symmetric : rates.backwardMutation deme = rates.forwardMutation deme) : (rates.forwardMutation deme * (1 - frequency deme) - rates.backwardMutation deme * frequency deme) * manyDemeBernsteinFirstDerivative frequency derived ancestral deme = rates.forwardMutation deme * derived deme * (manyDemeBernsteinWeight frequency (decrementExponent derived deme) (incrementExponent ancestral deme) - manyDemeBernsteinWeight frequency derived ancestral) + rates.forwardMutation deme * ancestral deme * (manyDemeBernsteinWeight frequency (incrementExponent derived deme) (decrementExponent ancestral deme) - manyDemeBernsteinWeight frequency derived ancestral)

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.manyDemeBernsteinAnalyticGenerator_eq_killedDual
theorems.statement: {D : ℕ} (rates : ManyDemeRates D) (frequency : Fin D → ℝ) (derived ancestral : Fin D → ℕ) (symmetric : ∀ deme, rates.backwardMutation deme = rates.forwardMutation deme) : manyDemeBernsteinAnalyticGenerator rates frequency derived ancestral = manyDemeKilledDualGenerator rates (manyDemeBernsteinWeight frequency) derived ancestral

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.manyDemeDiffusionPolynomialGenerator_bernstein
theorems.statement: {D : ℕ} (rates : ManyDemeRates D) (derived ancestral : Fin D → ℕ) : manyDemeDiffusionPolynomialGenerator rates (manyDemeBernsteinPolynomial derived ancestral) = manyDemeBernsteinAnalyticGeneratorPolynomial rates derived ancestral

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.eval_manyDemeBernsteinAnalyticGeneratorPolynomial
theorems.statement: {D : ℕ} (rates : ManyDemeRates D) (frequency : Fin D → ℝ) (derived ancestral : Fin D → ℕ) : MvPolynomial.eval frequency (manyDemeBernsteinAnalyticGeneratorPolynomial rates derived ancestral) = manyDemeBernsteinAnalyticGenerator rates frequency derived ancestral

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.eval_manyDemeKilledDualGeneratorPolynomial
theorems.statement: {D : ℕ} (rates : ManyDemeRates D) (frequency : Fin D → ℝ) (derived ancestral : Fin D → ℕ) : MvPolynomial.eval frequency (manyDemeKilledDualGeneratorPolynomial rates derived ancestral) = manyDemeKilledDualGenerator rates (manyDemeBernsteinWeight frequency) derived ancestral

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.manyDemeBernsteinAnalyticGeneratorPolynomial_eq_killedDual
theorems.statement: {D : ℕ} (rates : ManyDemeRates D) (derived ancestral : Fin D → ℕ) (symmetric : ∀ deme, rates.backwardMutation deme = rates.forwardMutation deme) : manyDemeBernsteinAnalyticGeneratorPolynomial rates derived ancestral = manyDemeKilledDualGeneratorPolynomial rates derived ancestral

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.manyDemePolynomialMomentFunctional_eq_sum
theorems.statement: {D : ℕ} (moment : (Fin D → ℕ) → ℝ) (polynomial : MvPolynomial (Fin D) ℝ) : manyDemePolynomialMomentFunctional moment polynomial = polynomial.sum fun exponent coefficient ↦ coefficient * moment (fun deme ↦ exponent deme)

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.manyDemePolynomialMomentFunctional_congr_of_totalDegree_le
theorems.statement: {D K : ℕ} (left right : (Fin D → ℕ) → ℝ) (polynomial : MvPolynomial (Fin D) ℝ) (degree_le : polynomial.totalDegree ≤ K) (agree : ∀ exponent, (∑ deme, exponent deme) ≤ K → left exponent = right exponent) : manyDemePolynomialMomentFunctional left polynomial = manyDemePolynomialMomentFunctional right polynomial

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.manyDemeBernsteinGenerator_momentFunctional_eq_killedDual
theorems.statement: {D : ℕ} (rates : ManyDemeRates D) (moment : (Fin D → ℕ) → ℝ) (derived ancestral : Fin D → ℕ) (symmetric : ∀ deme, rates.backwardMutation deme = rates.forwardMutation deme) : manyDemePolynomialMomentFunctional moment (manyDemeBernsteinAnalyticGeneratorPolynomial rates derived ancestral) = manyDemePolynomialMomentFunctional moment (manyDemeKilledDualGeneratorPolynomial rates derived ancestral)

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.manyDemePolynomialMomentFunctional_killedGenerator
theorems.statement: {D : ℕ} (rates : ManyDemeRates D) (moment : (Fin D → ℕ) → ℝ) (derived ancestral : Fin D → ℕ) : manyDemePolynomialMomentFunctional moment (manyDemeKilledDualGeneratorPolynomial rates derived ancestral) = manyDemeKilledDualGenerator rates (fun a b ↦ manyDemePolynomialMomentFunctional moment (manyDemeBernsteinPolynomial a b)) derived ancestral

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.manyDemePolynomialMomentFunctional_monomial_one
theorems.statement: {D : ℕ} (moment : (Fin D → ℕ) → ℝ) (exponent : Fin D → ℕ) : manyDemePolynomialMomentFunctional moment (MvPolynomial.monomial (Finsupp.equivFunOnFinite.symm exponent) 1) = moment exponent

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.manyDemePolynomialMomentFunctional_zeroAncestral
theorems.statement: {D : ℕ} (moment : (Fin D → ℕ) → ℝ) (exponent : Fin D → ℕ) : manyDemePolynomialMomentFunctional moment (manyDemeBernsteinPolynomial exponent (fun _ ↦ 0)) = moment exponent

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.manyDemePolynomialMomentFunctional_prod_X_pow
theorems.statement: {D : ℕ} (moment : (Fin D → ℕ) → ℝ) (exponent : Fin D → ℕ) : manyDemePolynomialMomentFunctional moment (∏ deme, MvPolynomial.X deme ^ exponent deme) = moment exponent

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.manyDemePolynomialMomentFunctional_singleAncestralFlip
theorems.statement: {D : ℕ} (moment : (Fin D → ℕ) → ℝ) (exponent : Fin D → ℕ) (deme : Fin D) (positive : 0 < exponent deme) : manyDemePolynomialMomentFunctional moment (manyDemeBernsteinPolynomial (decrementExponent exponent deme) (incrementExponent (fun _ ↦ 0) deme)) = moment (decrementExponent exponent deme) - moment exponent

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.manyDemePolynomialMomentFunctional_diffusion_monomial
theorems.statement: {D : ℕ} (rates : ManyDemeRates D) (moment : (Fin D → ℕ) → ℝ) (exponent : Fin D → ℕ) (symmetric : ∀ deme, rates.backwardMutation deme = rates.forwardMutation deme) : manyDemePolynomialMomentFunctional moment (manyDemeDiffusionPolynomialGenerator rates (MvPolynomial.monomial (Finsupp.equivFunOnFinite.symm exponent) 1)) = manyDemeMomentGenerator rates moment exponent

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.manyDemePolynomialMomentFunctional_diffusion
theorems.statement: {D : ℕ} (rates : ManyDemeRates D) (moment : (Fin D → ℕ) → ℝ) (polynomial : MvPolynomial (Fin D) ℝ) (symmetric : ∀ deme, rates.backwardMutation deme = rates.forwardMutation deme) : manyDemePolynomialMomentFunctional (manyDemeMomentGenerator rates moment) polynomial = manyDemePolynomialMomentFunctional moment (manyDemeDiffusionPolynomialGenerator rates polynomial)

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.manyDemeMomentGenerator_bernstein_intertwines
theorems.statement: {D : ℕ} (rates : ManyDemeRates D) (moment : (Fin D → ℕ) → ℝ) (derived ancestral : Fin D → ℕ) (symmetric : ∀ deme, rates.backwardMutation deme = rates.forwardMutation deme) : manyDemePolynomialMomentFunctional (manyDemeMomentGenerator rates moment) (manyDemeBernsteinPolynomial derived ancestral) = manyDemeKilledDualGenerator rates (fun a b ↦ manyDemePolynomialMomentFunctional moment (manyDemeBernsteinPolynomial a b)) derived ancestral

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.manyDemeKilledDualKillingRate_nonneg
theorems.statement: {D : ℕ} (rates : ManyDemeRates D) (derived ancestral : Fin D → ℕ) : 0 ≤ manyDemeKilledDualKillingRate rates derived ancestral

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.manyDemeKilledDualGenerator_eq_jump_sub_killing
theorems.statement: {D : ℕ} (rates : ManyDemeRates D) (value : (Fin D → ℕ) → (Fin D → ℕ) → ℝ) (derived ancestral : Fin D → ℕ) : manyDemeKilledDualGenerator rates value derived ancestral = manyDemeKilledDualJumpGenerator rates value derived ancestral - manyDemeKilledDualKillingRate rates derived ancestral * value derived ancestral

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.manyDemeKilledDualGenerator_nonneg_of_nonneg_of_current_eq_zero
theorems.statement: {D : ℕ} (rates : ManyDemeRates D) (value : (Fin D → ℕ) → (Fin D → ℕ) → ℝ) (derived ancestral : Fin D → ℕ) (value_nonneg : ∀ a b, 0 ≤ value a b) (current_zero : value derived ancestral = 0) : 0 ≤ manyDemeKilledDualGenerator rates value derived ancestral

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.decrementExponent_lt_of_fin
theorems.statement: {D K : ℕ} (exponent : Fin D → Fin (K + 1)) (deme : Fin D) : ∀ other, decrementExponent (fun d ↦ (exponent d).val) deme other < K + 1

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.migrateExponent_lt_of_sum_le
theorems.statement: {D K : ℕ} (exponent other : Fin D → Fin (K + 1)) (src dst : Fin D) (degree_le : (∑ deme, (exponent deme).val) + ∑ deme, (other deme).val ≤ K) (positive : 0 < (exponent src).val) : ∀ deme, migrateExponent (fun d ↦ (exponent d).val) src dst deme < K + 1

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.incrementExponent_lt_of_other_positive_sum_le
theorems.statement: {D K : ℕ} (incremented other : Fin D → Fin (K + 1)) (deme : Fin D) (degree_le : (∑ d, (other d).val) + ∑ d, (incremented d).val ≤ K) (positive : 0 < (other deme).val) : ∀ target, incrementExponent (fun d ↦ (incremented d).val) deme target < K + 1

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.ManyDemeKilledDualCoordinate.derivedMigration_closed

theorems.statement: {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] (E : ExpFunctional Ω) (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → Ω → ℝ) : E (Finset.sum s f) = Finset.sum s (fun i ↦ E (f i))

theorems.name: Descent.Foundations.eval_centered_zero
theorems.statement: (E : ExpFunctional Ω) (Z : Ω → ℝ) : E (fun ω ↦ Z ω - E Z) = 0

theorems.name: Descent.Foundations.variance_eq_expect_sq_sub_sq_mean
theorems.statement: (E : ExpFunctional Ω) (Z : Ω → ℝ) : variance E Z = E (fun ω ↦ Z ω ^ 2) - (E Z) ^ 2

theorems.name: Descent.Foundations.covariance_eq_expect_mul_sub_means
theorems.statement: (E : ExpFunctional Ω) (X Y : Ω → ℝ) : covariance E X Y = E (fun ω ↦ X ω * Y ω) - (E X) * (E Y)

theorems.name: Descent.Foundations.mse_eq_variance_add_variance_sub_two_cov_add_bias_sq
theorems.statement: (E : ExpFunctional Ω) (Y S : Ω → ℝ) : expMse E Y S = variance E Y + variance E S - 2 * covariance E Y S + (bias E Y S) ^ 2

theorems.name: Descent.Foundations.covariance_add_right
theorems.statement: (E : ExpFunctional Ω) (X Y Z : Ω → ℝ) : covariance E X (fun ω ↦ Y ω + Z ω) = covariance E X Y + covariance E X Z

theorems.name: Descent.Foundations.covariance_smul_right
theorems.statement: (E : ExpFunctional Ω) (X Y : Ω → ℝ) (c : ℝ) : covariance E X (c • Y) = c * covariance E X Y

theorems.name: Descent.Foundations.covariance_finset_sum_right
theorems.statement: {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] (E : ExpFunctional Ω) (X : Ω → ℝ) (s : Finset ι) (Y : ι → Ω → ℝ) : covariance E X (fun ω ↦ Finset.sum s (fun i ↦ Y i ω)) = Finset.sum s (fun i ↦ covariance E X (Y i))

theorems.name: Descent.Foundations.covariance_comm_exp
theorems.statement: (E : ExpFunctional Ω) (X Y : Ω → ℝ) : covariance E X Y = covariance E Y X

theorems.name: Descent.Foundations.covariance_add_left_exp
theorems.statement: (E : ExpFunctional Ω) (X Y Z : Ω → ℝ) : covariance E (fun ω ↦ X ω + Y ω) Z = covariance E X Z + covariance E Y Z

theorems.name: Descent.Foundations.covariance_smul_left_exp
theorems.statement: (E : ExpFunctional Ω) (X Y : Ω → ℝ) (c : ℝ) : covariance E (c • X) Y = c * covariance E X Y

theorems.name: Descent.Foundations.variance_eq_covariance_self
theorems.statement: (E : ExpFunctional Ω) (Z : Ω → ℝ) : variance E Z = covariance E Z Z

theorems.name: Descent.Foundations.variance_add_exp
theorems.statement: (E : ExpFunctional Ω) (X Y : Ω → ℝ) : variance E (fun ω ↦ X ω + Y ω) = variance E X + 2 * covariance E X Y + variance E Y

theorems.name: Descent.Foundations.eval_affine
theorems.statement: (E : ExpFunctional Ω) (a b : ℝ) (Z : Ω → ℝ) : E (fun ω ↦ a + b * Z ω) = a + b * E Z

theorems.name: Descent.Foundations.variance_affine
theorems.statement: (E : ExpFunctional Ω) (a b : ℝ) (Z : Ω → ℝ) : variance E (fun ω ↦ a + b * Z ω) = b ^ 2 * variance E Z

theorems.name: Descent.Foundations.covariance_affine_right
theorems.statement: (E : ExpFunctional Ω) (a b : ℝ) (Y Z : Ω → ℝ) : covariance E Y (fun ω ↦ a + b * Z ω) = b * covariance E Y Z

theorems.name: Descent.Foundations.dot_add_left
theorems.statement: (x y z : ι → ℝ) : dot (fun i ↦ x i + y i) z = dot x z + dot y z

theorems.name: Descent.Foundations.dot_sub_left
theorems.statement: (x y z : ι → ℝ) : dot (fun i ↦ x i - y i) z = dot x z - dot y z

theorems.name: Descent.Foundations.dot_add_right
theorems.statement: (x y z : ι → ℝ) : dot x (y + z) = dot x y + dot x z

theorems.name: Descent.Foundations.dot_sub_right
theorems.statement: (x y z : ι → ℝ) : dot x (fun i ↦ y i - z i) = dot x y - dot x z

theorems.name: Descent.Foundations.dot_sub_right'
theorems.statement: (x y z : ι → ℝ) : dot x (y - z) = dot x y - dot x z

theorems.name: Descent.Foundations.normal_equations_orthogonality
theorems.statement: (E : ExpFunctional Ω) (X : Ω → ι → ℝ) (Y : Ω → ℝ) (wStar u : ι → ℝ) (hnormal : ∀ i, E (fun ω ↦ X ω i * (Y ω - dot wStar (X ω))) = 0) : E (fun ω ↦ (Y ω - dot wStar (X ω)) * dot u (X ω)) = 0

theorems.name: Descent.Foundations.mse_transport_decomposition
theorems.statement: (E : ExpFunctional Ω) (X : Ω → ι → ℝ) (Y : Ω → ℝ) (wStar u : ι → ℝ) (hnormal : ∀ i, E (fun ω ↦ X ω i * (Y ω - dot wStar (X ω))) = 0) : E (fun ω ↦ (Y ω - dot (fun i ↦ wStar i + u i) (X ω)) ^ 2) = E (fun ω ↦ (Y ω - dot wStar (X ω)) ^ 2) + E (fun ω ↦ (dot u (X ω)) ^ 2)

theorems.name: Descent.Foundations.mse_transport_decomposition_general
theorems.statement: (E : ExpFunctional Ω) (X : Ω → ι → ℝ) (Y : Ω → ℝ) (wStar w : ι → ℝ) (hnormal : ∀ i, E (fun ω ↦ X ω i * (Y ω - dot wStar (X ω))) = 0) : E (fun ω ↦ (Y ω - dot w (X ω)) ^ 2) = E (fun ω ↦ (Y ω - dot wStar (X ω)) ^ 2) + E (fun ω ↦ (dot (fun i ↦ w i - wStar i) (X ω)) ^ 2)

theorems.name: Descent.Foundations.matrix_mulVec_add
theorems.statement: (A : Matrix J J ℝ) (x y : J → ℝ) : A.mulVec (fun i ↦ x i + y i) = A.mulVec x + A.mulVec y

theorems.name: Descent.Foundations.covariance_with_causal_signal
theorems.statement: (E : ExpFunctional Ω) (Xj : Ω → ℝ) (C : Ω → L → ℝ) (β : L → ℝ) : covariance E Xj (causalSignal β C) = dot (fun l ↦ covariance E Xj (fun ω ↦ C ω l)) β

theorems.name: Descent.Foundations.crossCovVector_decomposition
theorems.statement: (E : ExpFunctional Ω) (X : Ω → J → ℝ) (C : Ω → L → ℝ) (β : L → ℝ) (h : Ω → ℝ) : crossCovVector E X (fun ω ↦ causalSignal β C ω + h ω) = (predictorCausalCovariance E X C).mulVec β + contextCrossCovVector E X h

theorems.name: Descent.Foundations.optimalWeightsFromMoments_decomposition
theorems.statement: (sigmaInv : Matrix J J ℝ) (E : ExpFunctional Ω) (X : Ω → J → ℝ) (C : Ω → L → ℝ) (β : L → ℝ) (h : Ω → ℝ) : optimalWeightsFromMoments sigmaInv E X (fun ω ↦ causalSignal β C ω + h ω) = sigmaInv.mulVec ((predictorCausalCovariance E X C).mulVec β) + sigmaInv.mulVec (contextCrossCovVector E X h)

theorems.name: Descent.Foundations.secondMoment_quadratic_form
theorems.statement: (E : ExpFunctional Ω) (X : Ω → J → ℝ) (u : J → ℝ) : E (fun ω ↦ (dot u (X ω)) ^ 2) = dot u ((secondMomentMatrix E X).mulVec u)

theorems.name: Descent.Foundations.secondMoment_eq_covariance_of_centered
theorems.statement: (E : ExpFunctional Ω) (X : Ω → J → ℝ) (hcentered : ∀ i, E (fun ω ↦ X ω i) = 0) : secondMomentMatrix E X = covarianceMatrix E X

theorems.name: Descent.Foundations.master_transport_identity
theorems.statement: (E : ExpFunctional Ω) (X : Ω → J → ℝ) (Y : Ω → ℝ) (wStar w : J → ℝ) (hnormal : ∀ i, E (fun ω ↦ X ω i * (Y ω - dot wStar (X ω))) = 0) (hcentered : ∀ i, E (fun ω ↦ X ω i) = 0) : expMse E Y (linScore w X) = expMse E Y (linScore wStar X) + dot (fun i ↦ w i - wStar i) ((covarianceMatrix E X).mulVec (fun i ↦ w i - wStar i))

theorems.name: Descent.Foundations.expected_coordinate_dot_eq_covariance_mulVec
theorems.statement: (E : ExpFunctional Ω) (X : Ω → J → ℝ) (w : J → ℝ) (i : J) (hcentered : ∀ j, E (fun ω ↦ X ω j) = 0) : E (fun ω ↦ X ω i * dot w (X ω)) = ((covarianceMatrix E X).mulVec w) i

theorems.name: Descent.Foundations.optimalWeightsFromMoments_normal_equations
theorems.statement: (sigmaInv : Matrix J J ℝ) (E : ExpFunctional Ω) (X : Ω → J → ℝ) (Y : Ω → ℝ) (hcentered : ∀ i, E (fun ω ↦ X ω i) = 0) (hsigmaInv : covarianceMatrix E X * sigmaInv = 1) : ∀ i, E (fun ω ↦ X ω i * (Y ω - dot (optimalWeightsFromMoments sigmaInv E X Y) (X ω))) = 0

theorems.name: Descent.Foundations.master_transport_identity_closed_form
theorems.statement: (sigmaInv : Matrix J J ℝ) (E : ExpFunctional Ω) (X : Ω → J → ℝ) (Y : Ω → ℝ) (w : J → ℝ) (hcentered : ∀ i, E (fun ω ↦ X ω i) = 0) (hsigmaInv : covarianceMatrix E X * sigmaInv = 1) : expMse E Y (linScore w X) = expMse E Y (linScore (optimalWeightsFromMoments sigmaInv E X Y) X) + dot (fun i ↦ w i - optimalWeightsFromMoments sigmaInv E X Y i) ((covarianceMatrix E X).mulVec (fun i ↦ w i - optimalWeightsFromMoments sigmaInv E X Y i))

theorems.name: Descent.Foundations.eval_linScore
theorems.statement: (E : ExpFunctional Ω) (X : Ω → J → ℝ) (w : J → ℝ) : E (linScore w X) = dot w (fun j ↦ E (fun ω ↦ X ω j))

theorems.name: Descent.Foundations.covariance_linScore_left
theorems.statement: (E : ExpFunctional Ω) (X : Ω → J → ℝ) (w : J → ℝ) (Z : Ω → ℝ) : covariance E (linScore w X) Z = ∑ j, w j * covariance E (fun ω ↦ X ω j) Z

theorems.name: Descent.Foundations.covariance_linScore_linScore
theorems.statement: (E : ExpFunctional Ω) (X : Ω → J → ℝ) (w v : J → ℝ) : covariance E (linScore w X) (linScore v X) = dot w ((covarianceMatrix E X).mulVec v)

theorems.name: Descent.Foundations.variance_linScore
theorems.statement: (E : ExpFunctional Ω) (X : Ω → J → ℝ) (w : J → ℝ) : variance E (linScore w X) = dot w ((covarianceMatrix E X).mulVec w)

theorems.name: Descent.Foundations.covariance_linScore_eq_dot_crossCov
theorems.statement: (E : ExpFunctional Ω) (X : Ω → J → ℝ) (w : J → ℝ) (Z : Ω → ℝ) : covariance E (linScore w X) Z = dot w (contextCrossCovVector E X Z)

theorems.name: Descent.Foundations.scalar_summary_insufficient_linear
theorems.statement: (f A : V →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) (h : ∃ η : V, f η = 0 ∧ A η ≠ 0) : ∀ θ : V, ∃ θ' : V, f θ' = f θ ∧ A θ' ≠ A θ

theorems.name: Descent.Foundations.scalar_summary_factorization_of_kernel_inclusion
theorems.statement: (f A : V →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) (hker : ∀ η : V, f η = 0 → A η = 0) : ∃ c : ℝ, A = c • f

theorems.name: Descent.Foundations.exists_kernel_witness_of_not_scalar_factorization
theorems.statement: (f A : V →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) (hnot : ¬ ∃ c : ℝ, A = c • f) : ∃ η : V, f η = 0 ∧ A η ≠ 0

theorems.name: Descent.Foundations.scalar_summary_insufficient_of_not_scalar_factorization
theorems.statement: (f A : V →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) (hnot : ¬ ∃ c : ℝ, A = c • f) : ∀ θ : V, ∃ θ' : V, f θ' = f θ ∧ A θ' ≠ A θ

theorems.name: Descent.Foundations.transported_covariance_decomposes
theorems.statement: (w : J → ℝ) (K : J → L → ℝ) (β : L → ℝ) : transportedCovariance w K β = ∑ l, locusTerm w K β l

theorems.name: Descent.Foundations.normalized_transport_as_weighted_average
theorems.statement: (aT τ : L → ℝ) : (∑ l, aT l * τ l) / (∑ l, aT l) = ∑ l, (aT l / (∑ m, aT m)) * τ l

theorems.name: Descent.Foundations.baselineWeight_zero_total_is_junk
theorems.statement: {L : Type*} [Fintype L] (l : L) : baselineWeight (fun _ ↦ (0 : ℝ)) l = 0

theorems.name: Descent.Foundations.transportFactor_zero_target_is_junk
theorems.statement: {L : Type*} (aQ : L → ℝ) (l : L) : transportFactor aQ (fun _ ↦ 0) l = 0

theorems.name: Descent.Foundations.normalized_transport_from_factors
theorems.statement: (aQ aT : L → ℝ) (hbase : ∀ l, aT l ≠ 0) : (∑ l, aQ l) / (∑ l, aT l) = ∑ l, baselineWeight aT l * transportFactor aQ aT l

theorems.name: Descent.Foundations.normalized_transport_constant_factor
theorems.statement: (aT τ : L → ℝ) (φ : ℝ) (hden : ∑ m, aT m ≠ 0) (hτ : ∀ l, τ l = φ) : (∑ l, aT l * τ l) / (∑ l, aT l) = φ

theorems.name: Descent.Foundations.explainableFraction_zero_total_is_junk
theorems.statement: (between : ℝ) : explainableFraction between 0 = 0

theorems.name: Descent.Foundations.explainableFraction_eq_complement_within
theorems.statement: (between within : ℝ) (h : Descent.Core.sum between within ≠ 0) : explainableFraction between (Descent.Core.sum between within) = Descent.Core.complement (explainableFraction within (Descent.Core.sum between within))

theorems.name: Descent.Foundations.explainable_fraction_bound_of_noise_floor
theorems.statement: (between total within noiseFloor : ℝ) (htotal : total = between + within) (htotal_pos : 0 < total) (hbetween_nonneg : 0 ≤ between) (hnoise_nonneg : 0 ≤ noiseFloor) (hnoise_le : noiseFloor ≤ within) : explainableFraction between total ≤ between / (between + noiseFloor)

theorems.name: Descent.Foundations.explainable_fraction_bound_of_gaussian_floor
theorems.statement: (between total within sigma4 : ℝ) (htotal : total = between + within) (htotal_pos : 0 < total) (hbetween_nonneg : 0 ≤ between) (hsigma4_nonneg : 0 ≤ sigma4) (hgauss_floor : 2 * sigma4 ≤ within) : explainableFraction between total ≤ between / (between + 2 * sigma4)

theorems.name: Descent.Foundations.total_variance_decomposition_subsigma
theorems.statement: (hm : m ≤ mΩ) {L : Ω → ℝ} (hL : MemLp L 2 μ) : Var[L; μ] = (∫ ω, conditionalVariance μ m L ω ∂μ) + Var[conditionalMean μ m L; μ]

theorems.name: Descent.Foundations.explainable_fraction_bound_of_conditional_noise_floor
theorems.statement: (hm : m ≤ mΩ) {L noiseFloor : Ω → ℝ} (hL : MemLp L 2 μ) (hVar_pos : 0 < Var[L; μ]) (hNoise_int : Integrable noiseFloor μ) (hNoise_nonneg : 0 ≤ μ[noiseFloor]) (hNoise_le : noiseFloor ≤ᵐ[μ] conditionalVariance μ m L) : explainableFraction (Var[conditionalMean μ m L; μ]) (Var[L; μ]) ≤ Var[conditionalMean μ m L; μ] / (Var[conditionalMean μ m L; μ] + μ[noiseFloor])

theorems.name: Descent.Foundations.explainable_fraction_bound_of_conditional_gaussian_floor
theorems.statement: (hm : m ≤ mΩ) {L sigma4 : Ω → ℝ} (hL : MemLp L 2 μ) (hVar_pos : 0 < Var[L; μ]) (hsigma4_int : Integrable sigma4 μ) (hsigma4_nonneg : 0 ≤ μ[sigma4]) (hGaussianFloor : (fun ω ↦ (2 : ℝ) * sigma4 ω) ≤ᵐ[μ] conditionalVariance μ m L) : explainableFraction (Var[conditionalMean μ m L; μ]) (Var[L; μ]) ≤ Var[conditionalMean μ m L; μ] / (Var[conditionalMean μ m L; μ] + 2 * μ[sigma4])

theorems.name: Descent.Foundations.mse_from_variance_ratio_corr_bias
theorems.statement: (E : ExpFunctional Ω) (Y S : Ω → ℝ) (ρ lam : ℝ) (hlam : variance E S = variance E Y * lam) (hρ : covariance E Y S = ρ * variance E Y * Real.sqrt lam) : expMse E Y S = variance E Y * (1 + lam - 2 * ρ * Real.sqrt lam) + (bias E Y S) ^ 2

theorems.name: Descent.Foundations.ConfusionMatrix.recallRate_at_zero_denominator_is_junk
theorems.statement: (c : ConfusionMatrix) (hzero : (c.tp + c.fn) = 0) : recallRate c = 0

theorems.name: Descent.Foundations.ConfusionMatrix.fpr_at_zero_denominator_is_junk
theorems.statement: (c : ConfusionMatrix) (hzero : (c.fp + c.tn) = 0) : fpr c = 0

theorems.name: Descent.Foundations.ConfusionMatrix.precision_at_zero_denominator_is_junk
theorems.statement: (c : ConfusionMatrix) (hzero : (c.tp + c.fp) = 0) : precision c = 0

theorems.name: Descent.Foundations.ConfusionMatrix.one_sub_prevalence
theorems.statement: (c : ConfusionMatrix) : 1 - prevalence c = c.fp + c.tn

theorems.name: Descent.Foundations.ConfusionMatrix.fpr_mul_actualNegative
theorems.statement: (c : ConfusionMatrix) (h : c.fp + c.tn ≠ 0) : fpr c * (c.fp + c.tn) = c.fp

theorems.name: Descent.Foundations.ConfusionMatrix.precision_mul_predictedPositive
theorems.statement: (c : ConfusionMatrix) (h : c.tp + c.fp ≠ 0) : precision c * (c.tp + c.fp) = c.tp

theorems.name: Descent.Foundations.ConfusionMatrix.prevalence_mul_recall
theorems.statement: (c : ConfusionMatrix) : prevalence c * recallRate c = c.tp

theorems.name: Descent.Foundations.ConfusionMatrix.one_sub_prevalence_mul_fpr
theorems.statement: (c : ConfusionMatrix) : (1 - prevalence c) * fpr c = c.fp

theorems.name: Descent.Foundations.ConfusionMatrix.precision_eq_prevalence_recall_fpr
theorems.statement: (c : ConfusionMatrix) : precision c = (prevalence c * recallRate c) / (prevalence c * recallRate c + (1 - prevalence c) * fpr c)

theorems.name: Descent.Pangenome.Linkage.fiber_eq_singleton_of_injective
theorems.statement: {s : ι → ι} (hs : Function.Injective s) (h : ι) : fiber s h = {h}

theorems.name: Descent.Pangenome.Linkage.mosaicsFrom_eq_singleton_of_forall_injective
theorems.statement: : ∀ (c : Chain ι) (h : ι), (∀ s ∈ c, Function.Injective s) → mosaicsFrom c h = {List.replicate (c.length + 1) h} | [], h, _ => by simp [mosaicsFrom] | s :: c, h, hinj => by have hs : Function.Injective s

theorems.name: Descent.Pangenome.Linkage.mosaics_eq_diagonals_of_forall_injective
theorems.statement: (c : Chain ι) (hinj : ∀ s ∈ c, Function.Injective s) : mosaics c = diagonals c

theorems.name: Descent.Pangenome.Linkage.phantoms_eq_empty_of_forall_injective
theorems.statement: (c : Chain ι) (hinj : ∀ s ∈ c, Function.Injective s) : phantoms c = ∅

theorems.name: Descent.Pangenome.Linkage.exists_noninjective_of_phantoms_nonempty
theorems.statement: (c : Chain ι) (hphantom : (phantoms c).Nonempty) : ∃ s ∈ c, ¬ Function.Injective s

theorems.name: Descent.Pangenome.Linkage.phantoms_singleton_eq_empty_of_injective
theorems.statement: (s : ι → ι) (hs : Function.Injective s) : phantoms [s] = ∅

theorems.name: Descent.Pangenome.Linkage.mem_diagonals_iff
theorems.statement: {c : Chain ι} {derivation : List ι} : derivation ∈ diagonals c ↔ ∃ donor : ι, derivation = List.replicate (c.length + 1) donor

theorems.name: Descent.Pangenome.Linkage.phantoms_nonempty_of_exists_not_injective
theorems.statement: : ∀ (c : Chain ι), (∃ s ∈ c, ¬ Function.Injective s) → (phantoms c).Nonempty | [], hbad => by simp at hbad | s :: rest, hbad => by by_cases hs : Function.Injective s · obtain ⟨t, ht, hnot⟩

theorems.name: Descent.Pangenome.Linkage.phantoms_eq_empty_iff_forall_injective
theorems.statement: (c : Chain ι) : phantoms c = ∅ ↔ ∀ s ∈ c, Function.Injective s

theorems.name: Descent.Pangenome.ChartMap.sourceDefectMass_symm
theorems.statement: (f : ChartMap X Y) : sourceDefectMass f.symm = targetDefectMass f

theorems.name: Descent.Pangenome.ChartMap.targetDefectMass_symm
theorems.statement: (f : ChartMap X Y) : targetDefectMass f.symm = sourceDefectMass f

theorems.name: Descent.Pangenome.ChartMap.twoSidedMassDisagreement_comm
theorems.statement: (f g : ChartMap X Y) : twoSidedMassDisagreement f g = twoSidedMassDisagreement g f

theorems.name: Descent.Pangenome.ChartMap.twoSidedMassDisagreement_counting
theorems.statement: (A B : FiniteModel) (f g : ChartMap (PangenomeChart.counting A) (PangenomeChart.counting B)) : twoSidedMassDisagreement f g = f.twoSidedDisagreement g

theorems.name: Descent.Pangenome.wattersonEstimator_three
theorems.statement: (Shat : ℝ) : Coalescent.wattersonEstimator Shat 3 = 2 / 3 * Shat

theorems.name: Descent.Pangenome.thetaW6_eq_watterson
theorems.statement: (t : RefTree) (sample : List Hap) : (thetaW6 t sample : ℝ) = 6 * Coalescent.wattersonEstimator (S t sample : ℝ) 3

theorems.name: Descent.Pangenome.tajimaNum6_eq_six_mul
theorems.statement: (t : RefTree) (sample : List Hap) : (tajimaNum6 t sample : ℝ) = 6 * subsampleTajimaNumerator t sample

theorems.name: Descent.Pangenome.wattersonEstimator_gauge_defect
theorems.statement: {E : Type u} (edges : List E) (T₁ T₂ : Gauge.Tree E) (sample : List (Gauge.Walk E)) (n : ℕ) (hsize : Gauge.variantCount edges T₁ = Gauge.variantCount edges T₂) : Coalescent.wattersonEstimator (Gauge.segregatingCount edges T₁ sample : ℝ) n - Coalescent.wattersonEstimator (Gauge.segregatingCount edges T₂ sample : ℝ) n = ((Gauge.hiddenCount edges T₂ sample : ℝ) - (Gauge.hiddenCount edges T₁ sample : ℝ)) / Coalescent.harmonicSum (n - 1)

theorems.name: Descent.Pangenome.tajimaNumerator_gauge_defect
theorems.statement: {E : Type u} (edges : List E) (T₁ T₂ : Gauge.Tree E) (sample : List (Gauge.Walk E)) (n : ℕ) (piHat : ℝ) (hsize : Gauge.variantCount edges T₁ = Gauge.variantCount edges T₂) : (piHat - Coalescent.wattersonEstimator (Gauge.segregatingCount edges T₁ sample : ℝ) n) - (piHat - Coalescent.wattersonEstimator (Gauge.segregatingCount edges T₂ sample : ℝ) n) = ((Gauge.hiddenCount edges T₁ sample : ℝ) - (Gauge.hiddenCount edges T₂ sample : ℝ)) / Coalescent.harmonicSum (n - 1)

theorems.name: Descent.Pangenome.wattersonEstimator_gauge_invariant_of_allPolymorphic
theorems.statement: {E : Type u} (edges : List E) (T₁ T₂ : Gauge.Tree E) (sample : List (Gauge.Walk E)) (n : ℕ) (hpoly : ∀ e, e ∈ edges → Gauge.polymorphic sample e = true) (hsize : Gauge.variantCount edges T₁ = Gauge.variantCount edges T₂) : Coalescent.wattersonEstimator (Gauge.segregatingCount edges T₁ sample : ℝ) n = Coalescent.wattersonEstimator (Gauge.segregatingCount edges T₂ sample : ℝ) n

theorems.name: Descent.Pangenome.subsampleTajimaNumerator_A
theorems.statement: : subsampleTajimaNumerator Allele.A subsample = 0

theorems.name: Descent.Pangenome.subsampleTajimaNumerator_G
theorems.statement: : subsampleTajimaNumerator Allele.G subsample = -(2 / 3)
