theorems.name: Descent.PopGen.measureExpMSE_eq_variance_add_variance_sub_two_cov_add_bias_sq
theorems.statement: (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (Y S : Ω → ℝ) (hY_int : Integrable Y μ) (hS_int : Integrable S μ) (hYsq_int : Integrable (fun ω ↦ Y ω ^ 2) μ) (hSsq_int : Integrable (fun ω ↦ S ω ^ 2) μ) (hYS_int : Integrable (fun ω ↦ Y ω * S ω) μ) : measureExpMSE μ Y S = measureVariance μ Y + measureVariance μ S - 2 * measureCovariance μ Y S + (measureBias μ Y S) ^ 2

theorems.name: Descent.PopGen.measureLinearPredictionRisk_transport_decomposition_of_orthogonality
theorems.statement: {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (μ : Measure Ω) (X : Ω → ι → ℝ) (Y : Ω → ℝ) (wStar w : ι → ℝ) (hResidualSq_int : Integrable (fun ω ↦ (Y ω - Foundations.dot wStar (X ω)) ^ 2) μ) (hCross_int : Integrable (fun ω ↦ (Y ω - Foundations.dot wStar (X ω)) * Foundations.dot (fun i ↦ w i - wStar i) (X ω)) μ) (hDeltaSq_int : Integrable (fun ω ↦ (Foundations.dot (fun i ↦ w i - wStar i) (X ω)) ^ 2) μ) (horth : ∫ ω, (Y ω - Foundations.dot wStar (X ω)) * Foundations.dot (fun i ↦ w i - wStar i) (X ω) ∂μ = 0) : ∫ ω, (Y ω - Foundations.dot w (X ω)) ^ 2 ∂μ = ∫ ω, (Y ω - Foundations.dot wStar (X ω)) ^ 2 ∂μ + ∫ ω, (Foundations.dot (fun i ↦ w i - wStar i) (X ω)) ^ 2 ∂μ

theorems.name: Descent.PopGen._root_.Descent.Foundations.ConditionalMeanDGP.predictionRiskY_linear_transport_decomposition

theorems.statement: {q : ℕ} (model : SNPArchitecturePortabilityModel q) (retentionUpper : Fin q → ℝ) (h_source : 0 < model.sourceEffectMass) (h_bound : ∀ j, model.targetRetainedSquaredEffect j ≤ retentionUpper j * model.sourceSquaredEffect j) : predictedPortability model ≤ weightedRetentionUpperBound model retentionUpper

theorems.name: Descent.PopGen.weightedRetentionUpperBound_sub_predicted
theorems.statement: {q : ℕ} (model : SNPArchitecturePortabilityModel q) (retentionUpper : Fin q → ℝ) : weightedRetentionUpperBound model retentionUpper - predictedPortability model = (∑ j, (retentionUpper j * model.sourceSquaredEffect j - model.targetRetainedSquaredEffect j)) / model.sourceEffectMass

theorems.name: Descent.PopGen.predicted_eq_weightedRetentionUpperBound_of_active
theorems.statement: {q : ℕ} (model : SNPArchitecturePortabilityModel q) (retentionUpper : Fin q → ℝ) (h_active : ∀ j, model.targetRetainedSquaredEffect j = retentionUpper j * model.sourceSquaredEffect j) : predictedPortability model = weightedRetentionUpperBound model retentionUpper

theorems.name: Descent.PopGen.weightedRetentionUpperBound_eq_predicted_iff_active
theorems.statement: {q : ℕ} (model : SNPArchitecturePortabilityModel q) (retentionUpper : Fin q → ℝ) (h_source : 0 < model.sourceEffectMass) (h_bound : ∀ j, model.targetRetainedSquaredEffect j ≤ retentionUpper j * model.sourceSquaredEffect j) : weightedRetentionUpperBound model retentionUpper = predictedPortability model ↔ ∀ j, model.targetRetainedSquaredEffect j = retentionUpper j * model.sourceSquaredEffect j

theorems.name: Descent.PopGen.architecture_classification
theorems.statement: {q_high q_moderate q_oligo : ℕ} (highPoly : SNPArchitecturePortabilityModel q_high) (moderate : SNPArchitecturePortabilityModel q_moderate) (oligo : SNPArchitecturePortabilityModel q_oligo) (h_high_source : 0 < highPoly.sourceEffectMass) (h_moderate_source : 0 < moderate.sourceEffectMass) (h_oligo_source : 0 < oligo.sourceEffectMass) (h_loss_order : highPoly.relativePortabilityLoss < moderate.relativePortabilityLoss ∧ moderate.relativePortabilityLoss < oligo.relativePortabilityLoss) : predictedPortability oligo < predictedPortability moderate ∧ predictedPortability moderate < predictedPortability highPoly

theorems.name: Descent.PopGen.portability_upper_bound_from_rg_fst
theorems.statement: {q : ℕ} (model : SNPArchitecturePortabilityModel q) (rgUpper fstLower : Fin q → ℝ) (h_source : 0 < model.sourceEffectMass) (h_locuswise_bound : ∀ j, model.targetRetainedSquaredEffect j ≤ (rgUpper j) ^ 2 * (1 - fstLower j) * model.sourceSquaredEffect j) : predictedPortability model ≤ rgFstWeightedUpperBound model rgUpper fstLower

theorems.name: Descent.Portability.AncestralMutationLimit.transfer_congr_on_supported
theorems.statement: (rates : Rates D L) (mutationRate : Fin L → ℝ≥0) (deme : Fin D) (first second : LawFamily D L n) (heq : ∀ state, SampleComplete state → SupportedAt deme state → first state = second state) (hisolated : ∀ destination, rates.migration deme destination = 0) (s : State D L n) (hs : SampleComplete s) (hsupported : SupportedAt deme s) : transfer rates mutationRate first s = transfer rates mutationRate second s

theorems.statement: (rates : Rates D L) (mutationRate : Fin L → ℝ≥0) (deme : Fin D) (family : LawFamily D L n) (hfixed : ∀ state, SampleComplete state → SupportedAt deme state → transfer rates mutationRate family state = family state) (hisolated : ∀ destination, rates.migration deme destination = 0) (count : ℕ) (s : State D L n) (hs : SampleComplete s) (hsupported : SupportedAt deme s) : ((transfer rates mutationRate)^[count]) family s = family s

theorems.name: Descent.Portability.AncestralMutationLimit.fixed_point_identifies_limit
theorems.statement: (rates : Rates D L) (mutationRate : Fin L → ℝ≥0) (deme : Fin D) (family : LawFamily D L n) (hfixed : ∀ state, SampleComplete state → SupportedAt deme state → transfer rates mutationRate family state = family state) (hboundary : family emptyState = rootGenomeLaw) (hisolated : ∀ destination, rates.migration deme destination = 0) (s : State D L n) (hs : SampleComplete s) (hsupported : SupportedAt deme s) : family s = limitLaw rates mutationRate deme s hs hsupported hisolated

theorems.name: Descent.Portability.AncestralMutationResolvent.extend_interior
theorems.statement: (deme : Fin D) (values : Coordinates D L n deme) (s : InteriorState D L n deme) : extend deme values s.val = values s

theorems.statement: (deme : Fin D) (values : Coordinates D L n deme) : extend deme values emptyState = 0

theorems.statement: (deme : Fin D) (first second : Coordinates D L n deme) (s : State D L n) : extend deme (first + second) s = extend deme first s + extend deme second s

theorems.name: Descent.Portability.AncestralMutationResolvent.extend_smul
theorems.statement: (deme : Fin D) (factor : ℝ) (values : Coordinates D L n deme) (s : State D L n) : extend deme (factor • values) s = factor • extend deme values s

theorems.name: Descent.Portability.AncestralMutationResolvent.postcomposeArray_add
theorems.statement: {s : State D L n} (mark : Mark s) (first second : Genome L n → ℝ) : postcomposeArray mark (first + second) = postcomposeArray mark first + postcomposeArray mark second

theorems.name: Descent.Portability.AncestralMutationResolvent.postcomposeArray_smul
theorems.statement: {s : State D L n} (mark : Mark s) (factor : ℝ) (values : Genome L n → ℝ) : postcomposeArray mark (factor • values) = factor • postcomposeArray mark values

theorems.name: Descent.Portability.AncestralMutationResolvent.rowNorm_nonneg
theorems.statement: (values : Genome L n → ℝ) : 0 ≤ rowNorm values

theorems.name: Descent.Portability.AncestralMutationResolvent.rowNorm_postcompose
theorems.statement: {s : State D L n} (mark : Mark s) (values : Genome L n → ℝ) : rowNorm (postcomposeArray mark values) ≤ rowNorm values

theorems.name: Descent.Portability.AncestralMutationResolvent.rowNorm_transient_le
theorems.statement: (rates : Rates D L) (mutationRate : Fin L → ℝ≥0) (deme : Fin D) (values : Coordinates D L n deme) (s : InteriorState D L n deme) : rowNorm (transientOperator rates mutationRate deme values s) ≤ (markLaw rates mutationRate s.val).expectation (fun mark ↦ rowNorm (extend deme values (scanNext s.val mark)))

theorems.name: Descent.Portability.AncestralMutationResolvent.history_reward_succ
theorems.statement: (rates : Rates D L) (mutationRate : Fin L → ℝ≥0) (count : ℕ) (s : State D L n) (reward : State D L n → ℝ) : (historyLaw rates mutationRate (count + 1) s).expectation (fun history ↦ reward (terminal history)) = (markLaw rates mutationRate s).expectation (fun mark ↦ (historyLaw rates mutationRate count (scanNext s mark)).expectation (fun history ↦ reward (terminal history)))

theorems.name: Descent.Portability.AncestralMutationResolvent.subharmonic_iterate
theorems.statement: (rates : Rates D L) (mutationRate : Fin L → ℝ≥0) (reward : State D L n → ℝ) (hsub : ∀ s, reward s ≤ (markLaw rates mutationRate s).expectation (fun mark ↦ reward (scanNext s mark))) (count : ℕ) (s : State D L n) : reward s ≤ (historyLaw rates mutationRate count s).expectation (fun history ↦ reward (terminal history))

theorems.name: Descent.Portability.AncestralMutationResolvent.subharmonic_zero
theorems.statement: (rates : Rates D L) (mutationRate : Fin L → ℝ≥0) (deme : Fin D) (hisolated : ∀ destination, rates.migration deme destination = 0) (reward : State D L n → ℝ) (hnonneg : ∀ s, 0 ≤ reward s) (hroot : reward emptyState = 0) (hsub : ∀ s, reward s ≤ (markLaw rates mutationRate s).expectation (fun mark ↦ reward (scanNext s mark))) (s : State D L n) (hs : SampleComplete s) (hsupported : SupportedAt deme s) : reward s = 0

theorems.name: Descent.Portability.AncestralMutationResolvent.transient_no_fixed
theorems.statement: (rates : Rates D L) (mutationRate : Fin L → ℝ≥0) (deme : Fin D) (hisolated : ∀ destination, rates.migration deme destination = 0) (values : Coordinates D L n deme) (hfixed : transientOperator rates mutationRate deme values = values) : values = 0

theorems.name: Descent.Portability.AncestralMutationResolvent.residual_injective
theorems.statement: (rates : Rates D L) (mutationRate : Fin L → ℝ≥0) (deme : Fin D) (hisolated : ∀ destination, rates.migration deme destination = 0) : Function.Injective (residualOperator (n := n) rates mutationRate deme)

theorems.statement: (rates : Rates D L) (mutationRate : Fin L → ℝ≥0) (deme : Fin D) (hisolated : ∀ destination, rates.migration deme destination = 0) (forcing : Coordinates D L n deme) : residualOperator rates mutationRate deme (resolvent rates mutationRate deme hisolated forcing) = forcing

theorems.name: Descent.Portability.AncestralMutationResolvent.resolvent_unique
theorems.statement: (rates : Rates D L) (mutationRate : Fin L → ℝ≥0) (deme : Fin D) (hisolated : ∀ destination, rates.migration deme destination = 0) (forcing values : Coordinates D L n deme) (hequation : residualOperator rates mutationRate deme values = forcing) : values = resolvent rates mutationRate deme hisolated forcing

theorems.name: Descent.Portability.AncestralMutationResolvent.solution_boundary_row
theorems.statement: (rates : Rates D L) (mutationRate : Fin L → ℝ≥0) (deme : Fin D) (hisolated : ∀ destination, rates.migration deme destination = 0) (s : State D L n) (hs : SampleComplete s) (hsupported : SupportedAt deme s) : extend deme (solutionCoordinates rates mutationRate deme hisolated) s + rootBoundary s = (limitLaw rates mutationRate deme s hs hsupported hisolated).mass

theorems.name: Descent.Portability.AncestralMutationResolvent.positiveMark_sum
theorems.statement: (rates : Rates D L) (mutationRate : Fin L → ℝ≥0) (s : State D L n) (values : Mark s → ℝ) : (∑ mark : PositiveMark rates mutationRate s, (markLaw rates mutationRate s).mass mark.val * values mark.val) = ∑ mark : Mark s, (markLaw rates mutationRate s).mass mark * values mark

theorems.name: Descent.Portability.AncestralMutationResolvent.next_admissible
theorems.statement: (rates : Rates D L) (mutationRate : Fin L → ℝ≥0) (deme : Fin D) (hisolated : ∀ destination, rates.migration deme destination = 0) (s : InteriorState D L n deme) (mark : PositiveMark rates mutationRate s.val) : SampleComplete (scanNext s.val mark.val) ∧ SupportedAt deme (scanNext s.val mark.val)

theorems.name: Descent.Portability.AncestralMutationResolvent.postcomposeArray_law
theorems.statement: {s : State D L n} (mark : Mark s) (law : FiniteReportLaw (Genome L n)) : postcomposeArray mark law.mass = (postcomposeMark mark law).mass

theorems.name: Descent.Portability.AncestralMutationResolvent.solution_equation
theorems.statement: (rates : Rates D L) (mutationRate : Fin L → ℝ≥0) (deme : Fin D) (hisolated : ∀ destination, rates.migration deme destination = 0) : residualOperator (n := n) rates mutationRate deme (solutionCoordinates rates mutationRate deme hisolated) = forcing rates mutationRate deme

theorems.name: Descent.Portability.AncestralMutationResolvent.solution_eq_resolvent
theorems.statement: (rates : Rates D L) (mutationRate : Fin L → ℝ≥0) (deme : Fin D) (hisolated : ∀ destination, rates.migration deme destination = 0) : solutionCoordinates (n := n) rates mutationRate deme hisolated = resolvent rates mutationRate deme hisolated (forcing rates mutationRate deme)

theorems.name: Descent.Portability.AncestralMutationResolvent.expectation_resolvent
theorems.statement: (rates : Rates D L) (mutationRate : Fin L → ℝ≥0) (deme : Fin D) (hisolated : ∀ destination, rates.migration deme destination = 0) (state : InteriorState D L n deme) (readout : Genome L n → ℝ) : (limitLaw rates mutationRate deme state.val state.property.1 state.property.2.1 hisolated).expectation readout = ∑ genome, (resolvent rates mutationRate deme hisolated (forcing rates mutationRate deme) state genome) * readout genome

theorems.statement: (rates : Rates D L) (mutationRate : Fin L → ℝ≥0) (s : State D L n) : 0 ≤ totalIntensity rates mutationRate s

theorems.statement: (rates : Rates D L) (mutationRate : Fin L → ℝ≥0) : 0 < intensity (n := n) rates mutationRate

theorems.name: Descent.Portability.AncestralMutationTransfer.totalIntensity_le
theorems.statement: (rates : Rates D L) (mutationRate : Fin L → ℝ≥0) (s : State D L n) : totalIntensity rates mutationRate s ≤ intensity (n := n) rates mutationRate

theorems.name: Descent.Portability.AncestralMutationTransfer.transfer_normalized
theorems.statement: (rates : Rates D L) (mutationRate : Fin L → ℝ≥0) (family : LawFamily D L n) (s : State D L n) : (∀ genome, 0 ≤ (transfer rates mutationRate family s).mass genome) ∧ (∑ genome, (transfer rates mutationRate family s).mass genome) = 1

theorems.name: Descent.Portability.AncestralMutationTransfer.transfer_expectation
theorems.statement: (rates : Rates D L) (mutationRate : Fin L → ℝ≥0) (family : LawFamily D L n) (s : State D L n) (readout : Genome L n → ℝ) : (transfer rates mutationRate family s).expectation readout = (1 - totalIntensity rates mutationRate s / intensity (n := n) rates mutationRate) * (family s).expectation readout + (∑ event : Channel s, eventRate rates s event * (family (nextState s event)).expectation readout) / intensity (n := n) rates mutationRate + (∑ event : MutationChannel s, (mutationRate event.val.2 : ℝ) * ((family s).bind (mutationKernel event)).expectation readout) / intensity (n := n) rates mutationRate

theorems.name: Descent.Portability.AncestralMutationTransfer.transfer_generator
theorems.statement: (rates : Rates D L) (mutationRate : Fin L → ℝ≥0) (family : LawFamily D L n) (s : State D L n) (readout : Genome L n → ℝ) : intensity (n := n) rates mutationRate * ((transfer rates mutationRate family s).expectation readout - (family s).expectation readout) = (∑ event : Channel s, eventRate rates s event * ((family (nextState s event)).expectation readout - (family s).expectation readout)) + ∑ event : MutationChannel s, (mutationRate event.val.2 : ℝ) * (((family s).bind (mutationKernel event)).expectation readout - (family s).expectation readout)

theorems.statement: (rates : Rates D L) (mutationRate : Fin L → ℝ≥0) (family : LawFamily D L n) : transfer rates mutationRate family AncestralAbsorptionLaw.emptyState = family AncestralAbsorptionLaw.emptyState

theorems.statement: (rates : Rates D L) (mutationRate : Fin L → ℝ≥0) (count : ℕ) (s : State D L n) : (∑ history : History count s, historyMass rates mutationRate s history) = 1

theorems.statement: (rates : Rates D L) (mutationRate : Fin L → ℝ≥0) (boundary : LawFamily D L n) (count : ℕ) (s : State D L n) (readout : Genome L n → ℝ) : (((transfer rates mutationRate)^[count]) boundary s).expectation readout = ∑ history : History count s, historyMass rates mutationRate s history * (unwind boundary history).expectation readout

theorems.name: Descent.Portability.AncestralMutationTransfer.iterate_history_law
theorems.statement: (rates : Rates D L) (mutationRate : Fin L → ℝ≥0) (boundary : LawFamily D L n) (count : ℕ) (s : State D L n) : ((transfer rates mutationRate)^[count]) boundary s = (historyLaw rates mutationRate count s).bind (unwind boundary)

theorems.statement: (rates : Rates D L) (mutationRate : Fin L → ℝ≥0) (first second : LawFamily D L n) (count : ℕ) (s : State D L n) : rowDistance (((transfer rates mutationRate)^[count]) first s) (((transfer rates mutationRate)^[count]) second s) ≤ (historyLaw rates mutationRate count s).expectation (fun history ↦ rowDistance (first (terminal history)) (second (terminal history)))

theorems.statement: (r2₁ : ℝ) (scale : ℝ) (h_scale : scale ≠ 1) (h_scale_pos : 0 < scale) (h_r2₁ : 0 < r2₁) (h_r2₁_le : r2₁ ≤ 1) : r2₁ ≠ r2₁ * scale ^ 2 / (r2₁ * scale ^ 2 + (1 - r2₁)) ∨ r2₁ = 1

theorems.statement: (h2 π : ℝ) (h_reflect : liabilityThreshold (1 - π) = -liabilityThreshold π) : prevalenceScaledR2 h2 (1 - π) = prevalenceScaledR2 h2 π

theorems.name: Descent.Portability.epistaticVariancePairwise_at_reference_point

theorems.statement: (A : E →L[ℝ] O) (B : E →L[ℝ] F) (W : F →L[ℝ] G) (whitening : E ≃L[ℝ] E) (center : E) (horth : ∀ v : LinearMap.ker (A.comp whitening.toContinuousLinearMap), inner ℝ center (v : E) = 0) (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hc : ‖center‖ ≤ R) : IsLeast {risk : ℝ | ∃ prediction : F, ∀ θ : E, A θ = A (whitening center) → ‖whitening.symm θ‖ ≤ R → ‖W (B θ - prediction)‖ ^ 2 ≤ risk} ((R ^ 2 - ‖center‖ ^ 2) * ‖(W.comp (B.comp whitening.toContinuousLinearMap)).comp (LinearMap.ker (A.comp whitening.toContinuousLinearMap)).subtypeL‖ ^ 2)

theorems.name: Descent.Portability.EllipsoidTargetRadius.zero_radius_iff_kernel

theorems.name: Descent.Portability.ExactFiniteHistoryLaw.report_path_sum_eq_backward
theorems.statement: (initial : FiniteReportLaw State) (kernel : ℕ → State → FiniteReportLaw State) (n : ℕ) (report : State → Report) (metric : Report → ℝ) : (∑ path : Path State n, pathMass initial kernel path * metric (report (terminal path))) = initial.expectation (backwardReadout kernel n (fun state ↦ metric (report state)))

theorems.name: Descent.Portability.ExactMemoryLaw.discarded_expansion
theorems.statement: (coupling : E →ₗ[ℝ] F) (hidden : Module.End ℝ F) (retained : ℕ → E) (discarded : ℕ → F) (hstep : ∀ time, discarded (time + 1) = coupling (retained time) + hidden (discarded time)) (time : ℕ) : discarded time = (hidden ^ time) (discarded 0) + ∑ earlier ∈ Finset.range time, (hidden ^ (time - 1 - earlier)) (coupling (retained earlier))

theorems.name: Descent.Portability.ExactMemoryLaw.retained_memory
theorems.statement: (direct : Module.End ℝ E) (feedback : F →ₗ[ℝ] E) (coupling : E →ₗ[ℝ] F) (hidden : Module.End ℝ F) (retained : ℕ → E) (discarded : ℕ → F) (hretained : ∀ time, retained (time + 1) = direct (retained time) + feedback (discarded time)) (hdiscarded : ∀ time, discarded (time + 1) = coupling (retained time) + hidden (discarded time)) (time : ℕ) : retained (time + 1) = direct (retained time) + feedback ((hidden ^ time) (discarded 0)) + ∑ earlier ∈ Finset.range time, feedback ((hidden ^ (time - 1 - earlier)) (coupling (retained earlier)))

theorems.name: Descent.Portability.ExactMemoryLaw.one_step_closure_iff
theorems.statement: (direct : Module.End ℝ E) (feedback : F →ₗ[ℝ] E) : (∀ retained first second, direct retained + feedback first = direct retained + feedback second) ↔ feedback = 0

theorems.name: Descent.Portability.ExactMemoryLaw.retained_add_discarded
theorems.statement: (projection evolution : Module.End ℝ V) (initial : V) (time : ℕ) : retainedState projection evolution initial time + discardedState projection evolution initial time = (evolution ^ time) initial

theorems.name: Descent.Portability.ExactMemoryLaw.projection_retained
theorems.statement: (projection evolution : Module.End ℝ V) (hidempotent : projection * projection = projection) (initial : V) (time : ℕ) : projection (retainedState projection evolution initial time) = retainedState projection evolution initial time

theorems.name: Descent.Portability.ExactMemoryLaw.projection_discarded
theorems.statement: (projection evolution : Module.End ℝ V) (hidempotent : projection * projection = projection) (initial : V) (time : ℕ) : (1 - projection) (discardedState projection evolution initial time) = discardedState projection evolution initial time

theorems.name: Descent.Portability.ExactMemoryLaw.projected_block_steps
theorems.statement: (projection evolution : Module.End ℝ V) (hidempotent : projection * projection = projection) (initial : V) (time : ℕ) : retainedState projection evolution initial (time + 1) = (projection * evolution * projection) (retainedState projection evolution initial time) + (projection * evolution * (1 - projection)) (discardedState projection evolution initial time) ∧ discardedState projection evolution initial (time + 1) = ((1 - projection) * evolution * projection) (retainedState projection evolution initial time) + ((1 - projection) * evolution * (1 - projection)) (discardedState projection evolution initial time)

theorems.name: Descent.Portability.ExactMemoryLaw.projected_memory
theorems.statement: (projection evolution : Module.End ℝ V) (hidempotent : projection * projection = projection) (initial : V) (time : ℕ) : retainedState projection evolution initial (time + 1) = (projection * evolution * projection) (retainedState projection evolution initial time) + (projection * evolution * (1 - projection)) ((((1 - projection) * evolution * (1 - projection)) ^ time) (discardedState projection evolution initial 0)) + ∑ earlier ∈ Finset.range time, (projection * evolution * (1 - projection)) ((((1 - projection) * evolution * (1 - projection)) ^ (time - 1 - earlier)) (((1 - projection) * evolution * projection) (retainedState projection evolution initial earlier)))

theorems.name: Descent.Portability.FiniteReportLaw.expectation_add_same
theorems.statement: (p : FiniteReportLaw State) (f g : State → ℝ) : p.expectation (fun s ↦ f s + g s) = p.expectation f + p.expectation g

theorems.name: Descent.Portability.FiniteReportLaw.expectation_sub_same
theorems.statement: (p : FiniteReportLaw State) (f g : State → ℝ) : p.expectation (fun s ↦ f s - g s) = p.expectation f - p.expectation g

theorems.name: Descent.Portability.FiniteReportLaw.expectation_mul_constant
theorems.statement: (p : FiniteReportLaw State) (f : State → ℝ) (c : ℝ) : p.expectation (fun s ↦ f s * c) = p.expectation f * c

theorems.name: Descent.Portability.FiniteReportLaw.expectation_constant
theorems.statement: (p : FiniteReportLaw State) (c : ℝ) : p.expectation (fun _ ↦ c) = c

theorems.name: Descent.Portability.FiniteReportLaw.covariance_eq_rawMoments
theorems.statement: (p : FiniteReportLaw State) (score outcome : State → ℝ) : p.covariance score outcome = p.expectation (fun s ↦ score s * outcome s) - p.expectation score * p.expectation outcome

theorems.name: Descent.Portability.FiniteReportLaw.variance_eq_rawMoments
theorems.statement: (p : FiniteReportLaw State) (score : State → ℝ) : p.variance score = p.expectation (fun s ↦ score s ^ 2) - (p.expectation score) ^ 2

theorems.name: Descent.Portability.FiniteReportLaw.variance_nonneg
theorems.statement: (p : FiniteReportLaw State) (score : State → ℝ) : 0 ≤ p.variance score

theorems.name: Descent.Portability.FiniteReportLaw.covariance_sq_le_variance_mul
theorems.statement: (p : FiniteReportLaw State) (score outcome : State → ℝ) : p.covariance score outcome ^ 2 ≤ p.variance score * p.variance outcome

theorems.name: Descent.Portability.FiniteReportLaw.squaredCorrelation_mem_unitInterval
theorems.statement: (p : FiniteReportLaw State) (score outcome : State → ℝ) {r : ℝ} (hr : p.squaredCorrelation score outcome = some r) : 0 ≤ r ∧ r ≤ 1

theorems.name: Descent.Portability.FiniteReportLaw.squaredCorrelation_eq_rawMoments
theorems.statement: (p : FiniteReportLaw State) (score outcome : State → ℝ) (hscore : 0 < p.expectation (fun s ↦ score s ^ 2) - (p.expectation score) ^ 2) (houtcome : 0 < p.expectation (fun s ↦ outcome s ^ 2) - (p.expectation outcome) ^ 2) : p.squaredCorrelation score outcome = some ((p.expectation (fun s ↦ score s * outcome s) - p.expectation score * p.expectation outcome) ^ 2 / ((p.expectation (fun s ↦ score s ^ 2) - (p.expectation score) ^ 2) * (p.expectation (fun s ↦ outcome s ^ 2) - (p.expectation outcome) ^ 2)))

theorems.name: Descent.Portability.FiniteReportLaw.calibrationSlope_eq_rawMoments
theorems.statement: (p : FiniteReportLaw State) (score outcome : State → ℝ) (hscore : 0 < p.expectation (fun s ↦ score s ^ 2) - (p.expectation score) ^ 2) : p.calibrationSlope score outcome = some ((p.expectation (fun s ↦ score s * outcome s) - p.expectation score * p.expectation outcome) / (p.expectation (fun s ↦ score s ^ 2) - (p.expectation score) ^ 2))

theorems.name: Descent.Portability.FiniteReportLaw.meanSquaredError_eq_rawMoments
theorems.statement: (p : FiniteReportLaw State) (prediction outcome : State → ℝ) : p.meanSquaredError prediction outcome = p.expectation (fun s ↦ prediction s ^ 2) + p.expectation (fun s ↦ outcome s ^ 2) - 2 * p.expectation (fun s ↦ prediction s * outcome s)

theorems.name: Descent.Portability.FiniteReportLaw.binaryAUC_eq_double_sum
theorems.statement: (p : FiniteReportLaw State) (score : State → ℝ) (outcome : State → Bool) (hcases : 0 < p.binaryCaseMass outcome) (hcontrols : p.binaryCaseMass outcome < 1) : p.binaryAUC score outcome = some ((∑ c, ∑ t, p.mass c * p.mass t * (if outcome c && !outcome t then empiricalAUCComparison (score c) (score t) else 0)) / (p.binaryCaseMass outcome * (1 - p.binaryCaseMass outcome)))

theorems.name: Descent.Portability.FiniteReportLaw.definedMass_joint
theorems.statement: (p : FiniteReportLaw State) (kernel : State → FiniteReportLaw Next) (metric : State × Next → Option ℝ) : (p.joint kernel).definedMass metric = p.expectation (fun state ↦ (kernel state).definedMass (fun next ↦ metric (state, next)))

theorems.name: Descent.Portability.FiniteReportLaw.weightedDefinedMetric_joint
theorems.statement: (p : FiniteReportLaw State) (kernel : State → FiniteReportLaw Next) (metric : State × Next → Option ℝ) : (p.joint kernel).weightedDefinedMetric metric = p.expectation (fun state ↦ (kernel state).weightedDefinedMetric (fun next ↦ metric (state, next)))

theorems.name: Descent.Portability.FiniteReportLaw.conditionalMetric_joint

theorems.name: Descent.Portability.ExponentialPoissonRace.poisson_race_integral
theorems.statement: (ancestry : ℝ) (ha : 0 < ancestry) (mutation : ℝ≥0) (count : ℕ) : (∫ time : ℝ in Ioi 0, ancestry * Real.exp (-(ancestry * time)) * (Real.exp (-((mutation : ℝ) * time)) * ((mutation : ℝ) * time) ^ count / (count.factorial : ℝ))) = ancestry * (mutation : ℝ) ^ count / (ancestry + (mutation : ℝ)) ^ (count + 1)

theorems.name: Descent.Portability.ExponentialPoissonRace.poisson_expMeasure
theorems.statement: (ancestry : ℝ) (ha : 0 < ancestry) (mutation : ℝ≥0) (count : ℕ) : (∫ time : ℝ, poissonPMFReal (mutation * Real.toNNReal time) count ∂expMeasure ancestry) = ancestry * (mutation : ℝ) ^ count / (ancestry + (mutation : ℝ)) ^ (count + 1)

theorems.name: Descent.Portability.ExponentialPoissonRace.raceCoefficient_geometric
theorems.statement: (ancestry : ℝ) (mutation : ℝ≥0) (count : ℕ) : raceCoefficient ancestry mutation count = (ancestry / (ancestry + (mutation : ℝ))) * ((mutation : ℝ) / (ancestry + (mutation : ℝ))) ^ count

theorems.name: Descent.Portability.ExponentialPoissonRace.raceCoefficient_summable
theorems.statement: (ancestry : ℝ) (ha : 0 < ancestry) (mutation : ℝ≥0) : Summable (raceCoefficient ancestry mutation)

theorems.name: Descent.Portability.ExponentialPoissonRace.poisson_coefficient_integrable
theorems.statement: (ancestry : ℝ) (ha : 0 < ancestry) (mutation : ℝ≥0) (count : ℕ) : Integrable (fun time : ℝ ↦ poissonPMFReal (mutation * Real.toNNReal time) count) (expMeasure ancestry)

theorems.name: Descent.Portability.ExponentialPoissonRace.poisson_series_expMeasure
theorems.statement: (ancestry : ℝ) (ha : 0 < ancestry) (mutation : ℝ≥0) (readout : ℕ → ℝ) (hreadout : ∀ count, 0 ≤ readout count ∧ readout count ≤ 1) : (∫ time : ℝ, ∑' count, poissonPMFReal (mutation * Real.toNNReal time) count * readout count ∂expMeasure ancestry) = ∑' count, raceCoefficient ancestry mutation count * readout count

theorems.name: Descent.Portability.ExponentialPoissonRace.interval_fixed_uniformization
theorems.statement: {n count : ℕ} (templates : Fin count → Branch n) (rates : Fin count → ℝ≥0) (duration : ℝ≥0) (source target : SiteState n) : (intervalLaw (replaceExposure templates (fun index ↦ duration * rates index)) source).mass target = ∑' proposals, poissonPMFReal (duration * proposalParameter (replaceExposure templates rates)) proposals * (countLaw (replaceExposure templates rates) source proposals).mass target

theorems.name: Descent.Portability.ExponentialPoissonRace.interval_expMeasure
theorems.statement: {n count : ℕ} (templates : Fin count → Branch n) (rates : Fin count → ℝ≥0) (ancestry : ℝ) (ha : 0 < ancestry) (source target : SiteState n) : (∫ time : ℝ, FiniteReportLaw.mass (intervalLaw (replaceExposure templates (fun index ↦ Real.toNNReal time * rates index)) source) target ∂expMeasure ancestry) = ∑' proposals, raceCoefficient ancestry (proposalParameter (replaceExposure templates rates)) proposals * (countLaw (replaceExposure templates rates) source proposals).mass target

theorems.name: Descent.Portability.ExponentialPoissonRace.raceCoefficient_sum
theorems.statement: (ancestry : ℝ) (ha : 0 < ancestry) (mutation : ℝ≥0) : (∑' count, raceCoefficient ancestry mutation count) = 1

theorems.name: Descent.Portability.ExponentialPoissonRace.raceCoefficient_succ
theorems.statement: (ancestry : ℝ) (mutation : ℝ≥0) (count : ℕ) : raceCoefficient ancestry mutation (count + 1) = ((mutation : ℝ) / (ancestry + (mutation : ℝ))) * raceCoefficient ancestry mutation count

theorems.name: Descent.Portability.ExponentialPoissonRace.race_coordinate_summable
theorems.statement: (ancestry : ℝ) (ha : 0 < ancestry) (mutation : ℝ≥0) (kernel : S → FiniteReportLaw S) (source target : S) : Summable (fun count ↦ raceCoefficient ancestry mutation count * (kernelCount kernel source count).mass target)

theorems.name: Descent.Portability.ExponentialPoissonRace.raceKernel_first_step
theorems.statement: (ancestry : ℝ) (ha : 0 < ancestry) (mutation : ℝ≥0) (kernel : S → FiniteReportLaw S) (source target : S) : (raceKernelLaw ancestry ha mutation kernel source).mass target = (ancestry / (ancestry + (mutation : ℝ))) * (pointMass source).mass target + ((mutation : ℝ) / (ancestry + (mutation : ℝ))) * ((raceKernelLaw ancestry ha mutation kernel source).bind kernel).mass target

theorems.name: Descent.Portability.ExponentialPoissonRace.kernel_exponential_expMeasure
theorems.statement: [DecidableEq S] (ancestry : ℝ) (ha : 0 < ancestry) (mutation : ℝ≥0) (kernel : S → FiniteReportLaw S) (source target : S) : (∫ time : ℝ, (NormedSpace.exp ℝ (((mutation * Real.toNNReal time : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) • (kernelMatrix kernel - 1))) source target ∂expMeasure ancestry) = (raceKernelLaw ancestry ha mutation kernel source).mass target

theorems.name: Descent.Portability.ExponentialPoissonRace.interval_expMeasure_eq_raceKernelLaw
theorems.statement: {n count : ℕ} (templates : Fin count → Branch n) (rates : Fin count → ℝ≥0) (ancestry : ℝ) (ha : 0 < ancestry) (source target : SiteState n) : (∫ time : ℝ, FiniteReportLaw.mass (intervalLaw (replaceExposure templates (fun index ↦ Real.toNNReal time * rates index)) source) target ∂expMeasure ancestry) = (raceKernelLaw ancestry ha (proposalParameter (replaceExposure templates rates)) (intervalKernel (replaceExposure templates rates)) source).mass target

theorems.name: Descent.Portability.ExponentialRemainder.remainder_series
theorems.statement: (value : A) (order : ℕ) : remainder value order = ∑' degree, (Nat.factorial (degree + order) : ℝ)⁻¹ • value ^ (degree + order)

theorems.name: Descent.Portability.ExponentialRemainder.factorial_product_le
theorems.statement: (degree order : ℕ) : (Nat.factorial degree : ℝ) * Nat.factorial order ≤ Nat.factorial (degree + order)

theorems.name: Descent.Portability.ExponentialRemainder.tail_term_bound
theorems.statement: (value : A) (degree order : ℕ) : ‖(Nat.factorial (degree + order) : ℝ)⁻¹ • value ^ (degree + order)‖ ≤ (‖value‖ ^ order / Nat.factorial order) * ((Nat.factorial degree : ℝ)⁻¹ * ‖value‖ ^ degree)

theorems.name: Descent.Portability.ExponentialRemainder.remainder_norm
theorems.statement: (value : A) (order : ℕ) : ‖remainder value order‖ ≤ (‖value‖ ^ order / Nat.factorial order) * Real.exp ‖value‖

theorems.name: Descent.Portability.ExponentialRemainder.second_order_norm
theorems.statement: (value : A) : ‖NormedSpace.exp ℝ value - (1 + value + (1 / 2 : ℝ) • value ^ 2)‖ ≤ ‖value‖ ^ 3 / 6 * Real.exp ‖value‖

theorems.name: Descent.Portability.FiniteCovarianceMoments.coefficients_zero
theorems.statement: (A : I → SymmetricCovariance D) (hA : Function.Injective A) (coefficient : I → ℝ) (hmoment : ∀ v : D → ℝ, ∀ k < Fintype.card I, (∑ i, coefficient i * quadraticValue (A i).val v ^ k) = 0) : coefficient = 0

theorems.name: Descent.Portability.FiniteCovarianceMoments.regroup_counts
theorems.statement: [DecidableEq J] (index : I → J) (f : J → ℝ) : (∑ j, (∑ i, if index i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0) * f j) = ∑ i, f (index i)

theorems.name: Descent.Portability.FiniteCovarianceMoments.orbit_eq_of_variance_moments
theorems.statement: [DecidableEq D] (A B : SymmetricCovariance D) (hmoment : ∀ v : D → ℝ, ∀ k < 2 * Fintype.card (Equiv.Perm D), (∑ π : Equiv.Perm D, quadraticValue (permuteCovariance A π).val v ^ k) = ∑ π : Equiv.Perm D, quadraticValue (permuteCovariance B π).val v ^ k) : ∃ π : Equiv.Perm D, permuteCovariance A π = B

theorems.name: Descent.Portability.FiniteDemographicSampling.inheritedAlleleLaw_true
theorems.statement: {N : ℕ} (step : Step Deme) (hN : 0 < N) (counts : Counts Deme N) (destination : Deme) : (inheritedAlleleLaw step hN counts destination).mass true = ∑ source, (step.migration destination).mass source * parentalFrequency counts source

theorems.name: Descent.Portability.FiniteDemographicSampling.offspringAlleleLaw_true
theorems.statement: {N : ℕ} (step : Step Deme) (hN : 0 < N) (counts : Counts Deme N) (destination : Deme) : (offspringAlleleLaw step hN counts destination).mass true = offspringFrequency step counts destination

theorems.name: Descent.Portability.FiniteDemographicSampling.offspringAlleleLaw_false
theorems.statement: {N : ℕ} (step : Step Deme) (hN : 0 < N) (counts : Counts Deme N) (destination : Deme) : (offspringAlleleLaw step hN counts destination).mass false = 1 - offspringFrequency step counts destination

theorems.name: Descent.Portability.FiniteDemographicSampling.offspringLaw_mass
theorems.statement: {N : ℕ} (step : Step Deme) (hN : 0 < N) (counts : Counts Deme N) (configuration : Offspring Deme N) : (offspringLaw step hN counts).mass configuration = ∏ copy, if configuration copy then offspringFrequency step counts copy.1 else 1 - offspringFrequency step counts copy.1

theorems.name: Descent.Portability.FiniteDemographicSampling.transition_mass
theorems.statement: {N : ℕ} (step : Step Deme) (hN : 0 < N) (counts next : Counts Deme N) : (transition step hN counts).mass next = ∑ configuration : Offspring Deme N, (∏ copy, if configuration copy then offspringFrequency step counts copy.1 else 1 - offspringFrequency step counts copy.1) * (if countOffspring configuration = next then 1 else 0)

theorems.name: Descent.Portability.FiniteDemographicSampling.history_path_sum_exact
theorems.statement: {N : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N) (initial : FiniteReportLaw (Counts Deme N)) (history : ℕ → Step Deme) (generations : ℕ) (metric : Counts Deme N → ℝ) : (∑ path : ExactFiniteHistoryLaw.Path (Counts Deme N) generations, ExactFiniteHistoryLaw.pathMass initial (fun time ↦ transition (history time) hN) path * metric (ExactFiniteHistoryLaw.terminal path)) = initial.expectation (ExactFiniteHistoryLaw.backwardReadout (fun time ↦ transition (history time) hN) generations metric)

theorems.name: Descent.Portability.GenealogyGenotypeLaw.overwrite_representative
theorems.statement: (branch : Branch n) (leaves : Leaves n) (base : Nucleotide) : overwrite branch leaves base branch.representative = base

theorems.name: Descent.Portability.GenealogyGenotypeLaw.overwrite_overwrite
theorems.statement: (branch : Branch n) (leaves : Leaves n) (first second : Nucleotide) : overwrite branch (overwrite branch leaves first) second = overwrite branch leaves second

theorems.name: Descent.Portability.GenealogyGenotypeLaw.overwrite_commute
theorems.statement: (first second : Branch n) (hdisjoint : Disjoint first.descendants second.descendants) (leaves : Leaves n) (firstBase secondBase : Nucleotide) : overwrite second (overwrite first leaves firstBase) secondBase = overwrite first (overwrite second leaves secondBase) firstBase

theorems.name: Descent.Portability.GenealogyGenotypeLaw.overwrite_original
theorems.statement: (branch : Branch n) (leaves : Leaves n) (h : Homogeneous branch leaves) : overwrite branch leaves (leaves branch.representative) = leaves

theorems.name: Descent.Portability.GenealogyGenotypeLaw.branchKernel_expectation
theorems.statement: (branch : Branch n) (leaves : Leaves n) (readout : Leaves n → ℝ) : (branchKernel branch leaves).expectation readout = ∑ base : Nucleotide, (1 / 4 + Real.exp (-4 * (branch.exposure : ℝ) / 3) * ((if base = leaves branch.representative then 1 else 0) - 1 / 4)) * readout (overwrite branch leaves base)

theorems.statement: (branch : Branch n) (leaves : Leaves n) (first second : Fin n) (hfirst : first ∈ branch.descendants) (hsecond : second ∈ branch.descendants) : (branchKernel branch leaves).expectation (fun target ↦ if target first = target second then 1 else 0) = 1

theorems.name: Descent.Portability.GenealogyGenotypeLaw.branchKernel_commute
theorems.statement: (first second : Branch n) (hdisjoint : Disjoint first.descendants second.descendants) (leaves : Leaves n) : (branchKernel first leaves).bind (branchKernel second) = (branchKernel second leaves).bind (branchKernel first)

theorems.name: Descent.Portability.GenealogyGenotypeLaw.genealogy_expectation
theorems.statement: (branches : List (Branch n)) (leaves : Leaves n) (readout : Leaves n → ℝ) : (genealogyLaw branches leaves).expectation readout = genealogyExpectation branches leaves readout

theorems.name: Descent.Portability.GenealogyGenotypeLaw.genealogy_mass
theorems.statement: (branches : List (Branch n)) (leaves target : Leaves n) : (genealogyLaw branches leaves).mass target = genealogyExpectation branches leaves (fun output ↦ if output = target then 1 else 0)

theorems.name: Descent.Portability.GenealogyGenotypeLaw.rootedGenealogy_expectation
theorems.statement: (branches : List (Branch n)) (readout : Leaves n → ℝ) : (rootedGenealogyLaw branches).expectation readout = (∑ root : Nucleotide, genealogyExpectation branches (fun _ ↦ root) readout) / 4

theorems.name: Descent.Portability.historySpectralDistanceSq_self
theorems.statement: (h : SpectralHistory) : historySpectralDistanceSq h h = 0

theorems.name: Descent.Portability.historyDegradation_cone_identity
theorems.statement: (h h' : SpectralHistory) : historyDegradation h h' = h.amplitude * h'.amplitude * historySpectralDistanceSq h h' + (h.amplitude - h'.amplitude) * (h.amplitude * historySelfEnergy h - h'.amplitude * historySelfEnergy h')

theorems.name: Descent.Portability.historyDegradation_equal_amplitude
theorems.statement: (h h' : SpectralHistory) (ha : h.amplitude = h'.amplitude) : historyDegradation h h' = h.amplitude ^ 2 * historySpectralDistanceSq h h'

theorems.name: Descent.Portability.historyDegradation_equal_spectrum
theorems.statement: (h h' : SpectralHistory) (hmemory : h.memory = h'.memory) (hphase : h.phase = h'.phase) : historyDegradation h h' = (h.amplitude - h'.amplitude) ^ 2 * historySelfEnergy h

theorems.name: Descent.Portability.historySelfEnergy_eq_markovPoissonKernel_at_one

theorems.name: Descent.Portability.historySelfEnergy_closed
theorems.statement: (h : SpectralHistory) (hmemory : h.memory ^ 2 ≠ 1) : historySelfEnergy h = (1 + h.memory ^ 2) / (1 - h.memory ^ 2)

theorems.name: Descent.Portability.historyMarginalAmplitude_independentHistory
theorems.statement: (amplitude : ℝ) : historyMarginalAmplitude (independentHistory amplitude) = amplitude

theorems.name: Descent.Portability.same_marginal_different_memory_degradation
theorems.statement: : historyMarginalAmplitude (independentHistory 1) = historyMarginalAmplitude (persistentHalfHistory 1) ∧ historyDegradation (independentHistory 1) (persistentHalfHistory 1) = 2 / 3

theorems.name: Descent.Portability.not_marginalAmplitudeDeterminesHistoryDegradation
theorems.statement: : ¬ MarginalAmplitudeDeterminesHistoryDegradation

theorems.name: Descent.Portability.no_marginal_only_history_degradation_criterion
theorems.statement: {Report : Type*} (report : ℝ → Report) : ¬ ∃ accept : Report → Prop, ∀ h : SpectralHistory, historyDegradation (independentHistory 1) h = 0 ↔ accept (report (historyMarginalAmplitude h))

theorems.name: Descent.Portability.GraphColoringLaw.assemble_update
theorems.statement: (e : D ⊕ C ≃ V) (y : C → X) (x : D → X) (i : D) (a : X) : assembleEquiv e (y, Function.update x i a) = Function.update (assembleEquiv e (y, x)) (e (Sum.inl i)) a

theorems.statement: (p : FiniteReportLaw (V → X)) (e : D ⊕ C ≃ V) (z : V → X → ℂ) : phaseMean (partitionLaw p e) (fun yx ↦ ∏ w, z (e w) (Sum.elim yx.2 yx.1 w)) = phaseMean p (fun f ↦ ∏ v, z v (f v))

theorems.name: Descent.Portability.GraphColoringLaw.reindexed_independent_attenuation
theorems.statement: [Nonempty X] (p : FiniteReportLaw (V → X)) (hp : ∀ f, 0 < p.mass f) (adj : V → V → Prop) (K : V → (V → X) → FiniteReportLaw X) (hn : FullNeighborLocal adj K) (hl : FullLocalCondition p K) (e : D ⊕ C ≃ V) (hind : ∀ i j, ¬ adj (e (Sum.inl i)) (e (Sum.inl j))) (ν : V → FiniteReportLaw X) (η : V → ℝ) (hη : ∀ v, 0 ≤ η v) (hηone : ∀ v, η v ≤ 1) (hminor : ∀ f v a, η v * (ν v).mass a ≤ (K v f).mass a) (z : V → X → ℂ) (hz : ∀ v a, ‖z v a‖ ≤ 1) : ‖phaseMean p (fun f ↦ ∏ v, z v (f v))‖ ≤ Real.exp (-∑ i : D, η (e (Sum.inl i)) * (1 - ‖phaseMean (ν (e (Sum.inl i))) (z (e (Sum.inl i)))‖))

theorems.statement: (color : V → Color) (w : V → ℝ) (c : Color) : classWeight color w c = ∑ v : {v // color v = c}, w v

theorems.name: Descent.Portability.GraphColoringLaw.classWeight_sum
theorems.statement: (color : V → Color) (w : V → ℝ) : (∑ c, classWeight color w c) = ∑ v, w v

theorems.name: Descent.Portability.GraphColoringLaw.exists_average_color
theorems.statement: (color : V → Color) (w : V → ℝ) : ∃ c, (∑ v, w v) / Fintype.card Color ≤ classWeight color w c

theorems.name: Descent.Portability.GraphColoringLaw.proper_coloring_attenuation
theorems.statement: [Nonempty X] (p : FiniteReportLaw (V → X)) (hp : ∀ f, 0 < p.mass f) (adj : V → V → Prop) (K : V → (V → X) → FiniteReportLaw X) (hn : FullNeighborLocal adj K) (hl : FullLocalCondition p K) (color : V → Color) (hproper : ∀ v w, adj v w → color v ≠ color w) (ν : V → FiniteReportLaw X) (η : V → ℝ) (hη : ∀ v, 0 ≤ η v) (hηone : ∀ v, η v ≤ 1) (hminor : ∀ f v a, η v * (ν v).mass a ≤ (K v f).mass a) (z : V → X → ℂ) (hz : ∀ v a, ‖z v a‖ ≤ 1) : ‖phaseMean p (fun f ↦ ∏ v, z v (f v))‖ ≤ Real.exp (-(∑ v, η v * (1 - ‖phaseMean (ν v) (z v)‖)) / Fintype.card Color)

theorems.name: Descent.Portability.GuardedMetricOptimization.linearize_objective
theorems.statement: (hguard : 0 < guard) (p : S → ℝ) (hp : p ∈ feasible observe observed) (haccept : guard ≤ pairing acceptance p) (numerator : S → ℝ) : pairing numerator (linearize observe observed acceptance guard hguard p hp haccept).weights = pairing numerator p / pairing acceptance p

theorems.name: Descent.Portability.GuardedMetricOptimization.recover_objective

theorems.name: Descent.Portability.GuardedMetricOptimization.linearize_recover
theorems.statement: (hguard : 0 < guard) (problem : Linearized observe observed acceptance guard) : (linearize observe observed acceptance guard hguard (recover problem) (recover_feasible problem) (recover_guard hguard problem)).weights = problem.weights ∧ (linearize observe observed acceptance guard hguard (recover problem) (recover_feasible problem) (recover_guard hguard problem)).scale = problem.scale

definitions.name: Descent.Blindness.StructuralGuard.verdict
definitions.body:
| .overDetermination, r => PopGen.targetHetOfRetention 1 r = 1 * (1 - PopGen.lossOfRetention r)
  | .duplicateBody, r => PopGen.lossOfRetention r = 1 - r
  | .conflation, r => PopGen.targetPgsVarOfRetention 1 r = 1 * r
definitions.docstring:
What each guard reports when the cluster is instantiated at retention `r`.

Every one of these is a statement relating cluster members to each other. None of them
mentions an observable, and that is precisely the defect.

definitions.name: Descent.Blindness.guard_stack_blind_to_retention
definitions.signature: {trueRetention wrongRetention : ℝ} (hne : wrongRetention ≠ trueRetention) : ProbeBlindness (fun r ↦ fun g : StructuralGuard ↦ g.verdict r) (fun r ↦ r = trueRetention)
definitions.ret_type: ProbeBlindness (fun r ↦ fun g : StructuralGuard ↦ g.verdict r) (fun r ↦ r = trueRetention)
definitions.body:
ProbeBlindness.ofWitnessFamily StructuralGuard.verdict _ trueRetention wrongRetention
    (fun g ↦ propext ⟨fun _ ↦ g.verdict_holds wrongRetention,
                       fun _ ↦ g.verdict_holds trueRetention⟩)
    rfl hne
definitions.docstring:
**The whole guard suite shares one witness pair.**

Two different retention values — the measured one and the one the cluster assumed —
produce identical reports from *every* structural guard. By
`ProbeBlindness.ofWitnessFamily`, no criterion reading the entire suite decides which
retention is correct, in any combination and under any rule.

This is why the same wrong number was certified five times: it was never five
independent certifications, it was one blind suite applied five times.

definitions.name: Descent.Blindness.extra_algebraic_guard_adds_nothing
definitions.signature: {trueRetention wrongRetention : ℝ} (hne : wrongRetention ≠ trueRetention) (newGuard : ℝ → Prop) (hnew : ∀ r, newGuard r) : ProbeBlindness (fun r ↦ (fun g : StructuralGuard ↦ g.verdict r, newGuard r)) (fun r ↦ r = trueRetention) where positive
definitions.ret_type: ProbeBlindness (fun r ↦ (fun g : StructuralGuard ↦ g.verdict r, newGuard r)) (fun r ↦ r = trueRetention) where positive
definitions.body:
trueRetention
  negative := wrongRetention
  same_data := by
    have h₁ : (fun g : StructuralGuard ↦ g.verdict trueRetention)
        = fun g : StructuralGuard ↦ g.verdict wrongRetention := by
      funext g
      exact propext ⟨fun _ ↦ g.verdict_holds wrongRetention,
                     fun _ ↦ g.verdict_holds trueRetention⟩
    have h₂ : newGuard trueRetention = newGuard wrongRetention :=
      propext ⟨fun _ ↦ hnew wrongRetention, fun _ ↦ hnew trueRetention⟩
    rw [h₁, h₂]
  holds := rfl
  fails := hne
definitions.docstring:
Adding a fourth guard of the same kind changes nothing: any predicate on candidate
retentions that is satisfied at every retention joins the suite without narrowing it.

definitions.name: Descent.Blindness.OneLocusArchitecture.witness
definitions.docstring:
**The architecture is inhabited**, at a locus with a unit homozygote contrast, a half
dominance deviation, and an allele at frequency one half.

A theorem quantified over an uninhabited structure is true, kernel-checked, and empty.
This is deliberately a locus with NON-ZERO dominance: a witness at `d = 0` would satisfy
every additive theorem below for the wrong reason, because at zero dominance the average
effect and the homozygote contrast coincide and nothing the dominance term does is
visible.

definitions.name: Descent.Blindness.OneLocusArchitecture.averageEffect
definitions.docstring:
**Fisher's average effect**, the coefficient a dosage regression recovers.

    Empirical status: **VALIDATED** (`simcov/battery_bulk40b.py`, `group_a`). The docstring's
    claim -- that this is what a dosage regression recovers -- is now the thing that was
    measured. One diploid locus in Hardy-Weinberg proportions over 4×10⁶ individuals with genotypic
    values `-a / d / a` transcribed from `genotypicValue`; the observable is the
    realised least-squares slope of that value on alt-allele dosage, and the prediction uses
    the REALISED allele frequency.

      p      this body   realised slope   sems
      0.20    1.47991       1.47996       0.23
      0.35    1.24038       1.24039       0.05
      0.50    1.00037       1.00037       0.00
      0.70    0.67979       0.67982       0.11
      0.85    0.44005       0.44109       5.14

    `p` is swept across 1/2 so the factor `1 - 2p` changes sign, which is what separates it
    from every competitor: `a + d(1-p)` misses by up to 3357 sems, `a + d·p` by 6125, and a
    doubled dominance factor by 2773. The positive control is the sampler's own mean dosage
    against `2p`, at 4×10⁶ draws.

    Why the control is that and not the obvious one: an earlier run used "set `d = 0` and the
    slope must be `a`", and with no dominance the genotypic value is EXACTLY linear in dosage,
    so least squares returns `a` to machine precision. `simcov/verdict.py` refused it as
    degenerate -- a control that cannot fail gates nothing -- and downgraded every competitor
    to a lead. The worst cell here, 5.1 sems at `p = 0.85`, is 0.24% relative and sits inside
    the 2% floor the harness applies for exactly this reason: with 4×10⁶ individuals
    everything is significantly something.

    Power: the prediction spans 0.44005 to 1.47991 across the five frequencies,
    with `p` swept ACROSS one half so the factor `1 - 2p` changes sign -- which is
    what separates this body from every competitor on the same cells:
    `a + d(1-p)` misses by up to 3357 sems, `a + d·p` by 6125, and a doubled
    dominance factor by 2773.

definitions.name: Descent.Blindness.OneLocusArchitecture.genotypicValue
definitions.docstring:
Genotypic values: homozygotes at `∓a`, heterozygote displaced by `d` from their
midpoint.

    Empirical status: NOT AN EMPIRICAL CLAIM. Definitional within the model
    declared above: it fixes a contrast rather than predicting an observable.
    The `∓a` / `d` parameterisation IS the definition of `a` and `d`, so no
    measurement can agree or disagree with it; what a measurement bears on is a
    quantity computed FROM this contrast, and those carry their own statuses.

definitions.name: Descent.Blindness.OneLocusArchitecture.meanValue
definitions.body: ∑ g : Foundations.DiploidGenotype, h.genotypeProb g * m.genotypicValue g
definitions.docstring: Mean genotypic value under Hardy-Weinberg proportions.

definitions.name: Descent.Blindness.OneLocusArchitecture.valueDosageCovariance
definitions.body:
∑ g : Foundations.DiploidGenotype,
    h.genotypeProb g * (m.genotypicValue g - m.meanValue h) * h.centeredAltAlleleCount g
definitions.docstring: Covariance of genotypic value with allele dosage under Hardy-Weinberg.

definitions.name: Descent.Blindness.averageEffect_blind_to_dominance
definitions.signature: {δ : ℝ} (hδ : δ ≠ 0) (a : ℝ) : ProbeBlindness OneLocusArchitecture.averageEffect (fun m ↦ m.d = 0) where positive
definitions.ret_type: ProbeBlindness OneLocusArchitecture.averageEffect (fun m ↦ m.d = 0) where positive
definitions.body:
⟨a, 0, 1 / 2⟩
  negative := ⟨a, δ, 1 / 2⟩
  same_data := by
    unfold OneLocusArchitecture.averageEffect
    norm_num
  holds := rfl
  fails := hδ
definitions.docstring:
**The average effect is blind to dominance at equal allele frequency.**

Instance 8 of the registry. Probe: the average effect. Witness pair: two loci with the same
homozygote contrast at `p = 1/2`, one additive and one not. Kind: genotypic.

The consequence, via `ProbeBlindness.no_criterion_of_factors`, is that *no* rule reading the
average effect — no significance threshold, no effect-size filter, no combination of them —
decides whether a locus is additive. A score fit on dosages is not approximately blind to
dominance at equal frequency; it is blind.

The probe is the observable and not merely a named quantity:
`averageEffect_eq_regression_slope` identifies it with the least-squares slope of genotypic
value on allele dosage under this development's own `HardyWeinbergModel`. So the object
this instance proves undecidable is the coefficient a polygenic score fits, not an
abstraction standing in for it.

    Empirical status: NOT AN EMPIRICAL CLAIM -- a proof object: it produces a
    `ProbeBlindness` witness, not a quantity.

definitions.name: Descent.Blindness.pairwiseCoalescentSurvival
definitions.docstring:
Survival function of the pairwise coalescence time at rate `lam`.

    Empirical status: NOT AN EMPIRICAL CLAIM in itself -- it is the exponential
    survival function, fixed by that description. What carries empirical content
    is instance 9 above, whose measurement is recorded there.

definitions.name: Descent.Blindness.BundleRigidity.ModulusFamily.const
definitions.signature: (values : Fin d → ℝ) : ModulusFamily T d where curve
definitions.docstring:
**The constant family**: every branch a constant modulus curve.

`ModulusFamily` had no exhibited inhabitant, so the coverage and window results
were quantified over a class nothing had been shown to belong to. Constants are
the right member to name: a constant branch covers a value either everywhere or
nowhere, which is the degenerate extreme the single-window construction is built
to exclude, and having it in hand says the exclusion is doing work.

definitions.docstring:
**The coverers of `v` within `S`**: the parameters of `S` at which some branch takes
the value `v`.

are covered at most once from within `S`.

Taking the interior is what makes the window open, which is what lets the peeled set be

Samples needed to resolve a direction whose coupling order is `k`, from the only
available guarantee `σ_min ≥ (η/C)^k` and the usual `1/σ_min²` scaling.

definitions.name: Descent.Blindness.BundleRigidity.weightRatio
definitions.signature: (P Q : ι → ℝ) (w : List ι) : ℝ
definitions.body: prodWeight Q w / prodWeight P w
definitions.docstring: The **weight ratio** of a word: `Q`-product over `P`-product.

definitions.name: Descent.Blindness.BundleRigidity.defect
definitions.signature: (P Q : ι → ℝ) (w u : List ι) : ℝ
definitions.body: weightRatio P Q w / weightRatio P Q u
definitions.docstring:
The **weight defect of a relation** `w ≈ u`: the ratio of the two words' weight
ratios. The refuted conjecture asserted that a relation contributes to the kernel exactly
when its defect is one.

definitions.name: Descent.Blindness.BundleRigidity.falsifierP
definitions.docstring: The weights of the executed falsifier: `P = (3/10, 2/5)`, `Q = (7/10, 3/5)`.

definitions.name: Descent.Blindness.BundleRigidity.falsifierQ
definitions.docstring: The weights of the executed falsifier, `Q` side.

definitions.name: Descent.Blindness.BundleRigidity.chi
definitions.signature: (P Q : ι → ℝ) (w : List ι) : ℝ
definitions.body: prodWeight P w / prodWeight Q w
definitions.docstring:
**The character** `χ w = P^w / Q^w`, the ratio of weight products along the word.

Both constants of the falsifier come from this one definition: the Bézout constant is an
alternating combination of `χ` and the weight defect is a ratio of `χ`.

definitions.name: Descent.Blindness.BundleRigidity.bezout
definitions.signature: (P Q : ι → ℝ) (u v : List ι) : ℝ
definitions.body: (-1 : ℝ) ^ (u.length + 1) * chi P Q u - (-1 : ℝ) ^ (v.length + 1) * chi P Q v
definitions.docstring:
**The Bézout constant** of a relation `u ≈ v`:

`c = (-1)^{|u|-1} χ u - (-1)^{|v|-1} χ v`.

The exponent is written `|u| + 1`, which agrees with `|u| - 1` for every length and avoids
truncated natural subtraction at the empty word.

For independent coordinates every freshness is `1` and `D = n`. Under dependence `D`
collapses gracefully — it is the number of coordinates' worth of genuinely new randomness

definitions.name: Descent.Blindness.BundleRigidity.LinearSCM.witness
definitions.docstring:
**The class is inhabited.**  A theorem quantified over an uninhabited structure is
true and empty: kernel-checked, clean axiom report, no content.  This is the witness that
makes the theorems below statements about something.

definitions.name: Descent.Blindness.BundleRigidity.LinearSCM.IsSolution
definitions.body: ∀ i, x i = (∑ j, S.coef i j * x j) + noise i
definitions.docstring:
`x` **solves** the model for the given noise vector: every variable equals its
structural equation.

definitions.name: Descent.Blindness.BundleRigidity.LinearSCM.IsInterventionalSolution
definitions.signature: (k : Fin n) (v : ℝ) (noise x : Fin n → ℝ) : Prop
definitions.body: x k = v ∧ ∀ i, i ≠ k → x i = (∑ j, S.coef i j * x j) + noise i
definitions.docstring:
`x` solves the model **after intervening** `do(k := v)`.

This is graph surgery: variable `k`'s structural equation is replaced by the constant `v`,
so `k` no longer refers to its parents, while every other equation is unchanged. Deleting
`k`'s incoming edges and fixing its value are the same operation here, because `k`'s
equation is the only place those edges appear.

definitions.name: Descent.Blindness.BundleRigidity.ChainSCM.mUnder
definitions.docstring: The value of `M` under `do(X := x)`.

definitions.name: Descent.Blindness.BundleRigidity.ChainSCM.yUnder
definitions.body: S.b * x + S.c * S.mUnder x nM + nY
definitions.docstring: The value of `Y` under `do(X := x)`, with `M` left to its structural equation.

definitions.name: Descent.Blindness.BundleRigidity.ChainSCM.yUnderXM
definitions.docstring:
The value of `Y` under the **joint** intervention `do(X := x, M := m)`. Fixing `M`
deletes the `X → M` edge's influence on `Y`, which is what makes the next definition the
*direct* effect.

definitions.name: Descent.Blindness.BundleRigidity.ChainSCM.totalEffect
definitions.body: S.yUnder x' nM nY - S.yUnder x nM nY
definitions.docstring:
**Total effect** of moving `X` from `x` to `x'`: the change in `Y` under `do(X := ·)`,
with `M` free to respond.

    Empirical status: NOT AN EMPIRICAL CLAIM -- an intervention contrast
    defined from the model's own equations.

definitions.name: Descent.Blindness.BundleRigidity.ChainSCM.directEffect
definitions.body: S.yUnderXM x' m nY - S.yUnderXM x m nY
definitions.docstring:
**Direct effect**: the change in `Y` when `X` moves but `M` is held at `m` by a second
intervention. This is the controlled direct effect, and holding `M` fixed is what
distinguishes it from the total effect.

    Empirical status: NOT AN EMPIRICAL CLAIM -- an intervention contrast
    defined from the model's own equations.

definitions.name: Descent.Blindness.BundleRigidity.ChainSCM.indirectEffect
definitions.body: S.c * (S.mUnder x' nM - S.mUnder x nM)
definitions.docstring:
**Indirect effect**: the part transmitted through `M`, namely the change `M` undergoes
when `X` moves, propagated to `Y` by the coefficient `c`.

    Empirical status: NOT AN EMPIRICAL CLAIM -- an intervention contrast
    defined from the model's own equations.

definitions.name: Descent.Blindness.BundleRigidity.ChainSCM.pureMediation
definitions.docstring:
**The pure-mediation chain**: no direct edge from `X` to `Y`, with the two
path coefficients left free.

`ChainSCM` had no exhibited inhabitant, so `total_eq_indirect_of_b_eq_zero` was
a conditional whose hypothesis nothing had been shown to satisfy -- and a
complete-mediation theorem about no complete mediator is the least useful form
that statement could take. This is the family that satisfies it, at every pair
of path coefficients rather than at one.

definitions.name: Descent.Blindness.BundleRigidity.ContinuousBundleFamily.rademacher
definitions.signature: (T : Type*) [TopologicalSpace T] : ContinuousBundleFamily T 2 where atom
definitions.body:
![ContinuousMap.const T (1 : ℝ), ContinuousMap.const T (-1 : ℝ)]
  mass := ![ContinuousMap.const T (1 / 2 : ℝ), ContinuousMap.const T (1 / 2 : ℝ)]
                                                                                
                                                                                 
                           
  mass_pos j _ := by fin_cases j <;> norm_num
  mass_sum _ := by simp [Fin.sum_univ_two] <;> norm_num
  mean_zero _ := by simp [Fin.sum_univ_two] <;> norm_num
  var_one _ := by simp [Fin.sum_univ_two] <;> norm_num
definitions.docstring:
**The symmetric two-atom family**, and with it the fact that the fifteen
theorems taking a `ContinuousBundleFamily` parameter are about something.

`ContinuousBundleFamily` bundles four `Prop` fields holding at every parameter
simultaneously, so a theorem taking one is conditional on a caller producing all
four at once. Until a closed term of the type exists, none of those theorems is
known to be non-vacuous — which is the difference between a hypothesis and a
class with no members.

Rademacher: two atoms at `+1` and `-1`, each of constant mass `1/2`. The four
identities are then arithmetic and hold at every `t` because nothing here
depends on `t`. This is the smallest family satisfying the standing identities:
one atom cannot have mean zero and variance one at once, since mass `1` forces
the atom to `0` and then the variance is `0`.

Constant in `t` on purpose. What is being discharged is inhabitation, and a
`t`-dependent witness would suggest the results below turn on the parameter
space, which they do not.

definitions.name: Descent.Blindness.BundleRigidity.ContinuousBundleFamily.modulusMap
definitions.signature: (F : ContinuousBundleFamily T d) (j : Fin d) : C(T, ℝ)
definitions.docstring:
The **modulus curve** of atom `j`: `|atom j t ^ 2 - 1|`, the value taken by `|U|`
where `U = X ^ 2 - 1` is the centered square of the standardized value.

definitions.name: Descent.Blindness.BundleRigidity.ContinuousBundleFamily.coTransfer
definitions.signature: (F : ContinuousBundleFamily T d) (f : C(ℝ, ℝ)) : C(T, ℝ)
definitions.body:
⟨fun t ↦ ∑ j, F.mass j t * f (F.modulusMap j t),
    continuous_finset_sum _ fun j _ ↦
      (F.mass j).continuous.mul (f.continuous.comp (F.modulusMap j).continuous)⟩
definitions.docstring:
**The adjoint `L*`**, as a map on test functions:
`(L* f) t = ∑ j, mass j t * f (modulusMap j t)`.

Equivalently this is the pairing of `f` against the transfer measure
`TT t = ∑ j, mass j t • δ (modulusMap j t)`. Everything in this file is a statement about
this one expression.

definitions.name: Descent.Blindness.BundleRigidity.ContinuousBundleFamily.coTransferₗ
definitions.signature: (F : ContinuousBundleFamily T d) : C(ℝ, ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] C(T, ℝ) where toFun
definitions.ret_type: C(ℝ, ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] C(T, ℝ) where toFun
definitions.body:
F.coTransfer
  map_add' f g := by
    ext t
    simp only [coTransfer_apply, ContinuousMap.add_apply]
    rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ ↦ by ring
  map_smul' c f := by
    ext t
    simp only [coTransfer_apply, ContinuousMap.smul_apply, RingHom.id_apply,
      ContinuousMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ ↦ by ring
definitions.docstring: `L*` is linear in the test function.

definitions.name: Descent.Blindness.BundleRigidity.ContinuousBundleFamily.transfer
definitions.signature: (F : ContinuousBundleFamily T d) (κ : C(T, ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) : C(ℝ, ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ
definitions.docstring:
**The bundle modulus operator `L`.** A measure on parameters, represented as a linear
functional on `C(T, ℝ)`, is sent to the measure on modulus values obtained by pushing each
parameter to its transfer measure and integrating: `L κ = ∫ TT t dκ t`, which in the
Riesz picture is exactly precomposition with `L*`.

definitions.name: Descent.Blindness.BundleRigidity.ContinuousBundleFamily.diracAt
definitions.signature: (t : T) : C(T, ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ where toFun f
definitions.ret_type: C(T, ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ where toFun f
definitions.body:
f t
  map_add' _ _ := rfl
  map_smul' _ _ := rfl
definitions.docstring: The Dirac measure at `t`, in the Riesz picture: evaluation at `t`.

definitions.name: Descent.Blindness.BundleRigidity.ContinuousBundleFamily.SameTransfer
definitions.signature: (F : ContinuousBundleFamily T d) (t₁ t₂ : T) : Prop
definitions.body: ∀ f : C(ℝ, ℝ), F.coTransfer f t₁ = F.coTransfer f t₂
definitions.docstring:
**Two parameters with the same transfer measure**, i.e. `TT t₁ = TT t₂` tested against
every continuous function.

definitions.name: Descent.Blindness.BundleRigidity.ContinuousBundleFamily.pullback
definitions.signature: (τ : C(T, T)) : C(T, ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] C(T, ℝ) where toFun f
definitions.ret_type: C(T, ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] C(T, ℝ) where toFun f
definitions.body:
f.comp τ
  map_add' _ _ := by ext t; rfl
  map_smul' _ _ := by ext t; rfl
definitions.docstring: Pullback of test functions along a continuous self-map of the parameter space.

definitions.name: Descent.Blindness.BundleRigidity.ContinuousBundleFamily.IsSymmetry
definitions.signature: (F : ContinuousBundleFamily T d) (τ : C(T, T)) : Prop
definitions.body: ∀ (f : C(ℝ, ℝ)) (t : T), F.coTransfer f (τ t) = F.coTransfer f t
definitions.docstring:
**`τ` is a symmetry of the family**: `TT ∘ τ = TT`, tested against every continuous
function. This is exactly the hypothesis of Theorem B.

definitions.name: Descent.Blindness.BundleRigidity.ContinuousBundleFamily.IsTauOdd
definitions.signature: (τ : C(T, T)) (κ : C(T, ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) : Prop
definitions.docstring: A measure is **`τ`-odd** when pulling back along `τ` negates it.

definitions.name: Descent.Blindness.BundleRigidity.ContinuousBundleFamily.IsTauEven
definitions.signature: (τ : C(T, T)) (κ : C(T, ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) : Prop
definitions.docstring: A measure is **`τ`-even** when it is invariant under pullback along `τ`.

definitions.name: Descent.Blindness.BundleRigidity.ContinuousBundleFamily.evenPart
definitions.signature: (τ : C(T, T)) (κ : C(T, ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) : C(T, ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ
definitions.docstring: The `τ`-even part of a measure.

definitions.name: Descent.Blindness.BundleRigidity.ContinuousBundleFamily.oddPart
definitions.signature: (τ : C(T, T)) (κ : C(T, ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) : C(T, ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ
definitions.docstring: The `τ`-odd part of a measure.

definitions.name: Descent.Blindness.BundleRigidity.ContinuousBundleFamily.IsInvariantFn
definitions.body: ∀ t : T, f (τ t) = f t
definitions.docstring: A test function is **`τ`-invariant** when it descends to the quotient `T / τ`.

definitions.name: Descent.Blindness.BundleRigidity.outerAtom
definitions.docstring: Outer and inner atom magnitudes used by the symmetric lift.

definitions.name: Descent.Blindness.BundleRigidity.SingleModulus.witness
definitions.body:
fun j ↦ if j = 0 then -1 else 1
  mass := fun _ ↦ 1 / 2
  atom_inj := by
    intro i j h
    fin_cases i
    · fin_cases j
      · rfl
      · norm_num at h
    · fin_cases j
      · norm_num at h
      · rfl
  mass_pos := fun _ ↦ by norm_num
  mass_sum := by norm_num [Fin.sum_univ_two]
  mean_zero := by norm_num [Fin.sum_univ_two]
  var_one := by norm_num [Fin.sum_univ_two]
  modulus_eq := by
    intro j
    fin_cases j <;> norm_num
definitions.docstring: The standardized two-atom law at `±1`, with mass `1/2` at each atom.

definitions.name: Descent.Blindness.BundleRigidity.SingleModulus.plusSide
definitions.body: univ.filter fun j ↦ S.atom j ^ 2 = 1 + v
definitions.docstring: The atoms squaring to `1 + v`.

definitions.name: Descent.Blindness.BundleRigidity.SingleModulus.minusSide
definitions.docstring: The atoms squaring to `1 - v`.

definitions.name: Descent.Blindness.BundleRigidity.SingleModulus.wPlus
definitions.docstring: Total mass on the `(1+v)` side.

definitions.name: Descent.Blindness.BundleRigidity.SingleModulus.wMinus
definitions.docstring: Total mass on the `(1-v)` side.

definitions.name: Descent.Blindness.BundleRigidity.threeAtom
definitions.signature: (v A B r : ℝ) (hv : 0 ≤ v) (hA : A ^ 2 = 1 + v) (hB : B ^ 2 = 1 - v) (hApos : 0 < A) (hBpos : 0 < B) (hr0 : 0 < r) (hr1 : r < 1) (hr : B = A * r) : SingleModulus 3 v where atom
definitions.body:
fun j ↦ if j = 0 then A else if j = 1 then -A else -B
  mass := ![1 / 4 + r / 4, 1 / 4 - r / 4, 1 / 2]
  atom_inj := by
    have hBA : B < A := by rw [hr]; nlinarith
    intro i j hij
    fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> norm_num at hij ⊢ <;> linarith
  mass_pos := by
    intro j
    fin_cases j
    · show (0:ℝ) < 1 / 4 + r / 4
      linarith
    · show (0:ℝ) < 1 / 4 - r / 4
      linarith
    · show (0:ℝ) < 1 / 2
      norm_num
  mass_sum := by
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_three]
    show (1 / 4 + r / 4) + (1 / 4 - r / 4) + (1 / 2 : ℝ) = 1
    ring
  mean_zero := by
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_three]
    show (1 / 4 + r / 4) * A + (1 / 4 - r / 4) * (-A) + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (-B) = 0
    rw [hr]; ring
  var_one := by
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_three]
    show (1 / 4 + r / 4) * A ^ 2 + (1 / 4 - r / 4) * (-A) ^ 2
      + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (-B) ^ 2 = 1
    have hkey : (1 / 4 + r / 4) * A ^ 2 + (1 / 4 - r / 4) * (-A) ^ 2
        + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (-B) ^ 2 = (1 / 2) * A ^ 2 + (1 / 2) * B ^ 2 := by ring
    rw [hkey, hA, hB]; ring
  modulus_eq := by
    intro j
    fin_cases j
    · exact modulus_of_sq_eq_one_add hv hA
    · exact modulus_of_sq_eq_one_add hv (by simpa using hA)
    · exact modulus_of_sq_eq_one_sub hv (by simpa using hB)
definitions.docstring:
**A three-atom single-modulus family**, for any `0 < v < 1`.

Atoms `A, -A, -B` with `A = √(1+v)`, `B = √(1-v)`; masses
`1/4 + B/(4A)`, `1/4 - B/(4A)`, `1/2`. Positivity of the second mass is exactly `B < A`,
which is exactly `v > 0`.

**This refutes the upstream claim that no `d ≤ 3` family exists for `v > 0`.** It is the
`c = 1/(4A)` endpoint of the upstream one-parameter line, at which the mass on `√(1-v)`
reaches zero and the atom disappears — not a new solution, but an endpoint of the known
one that the upstream positivity analysis excluded by assumption.

Parameterized by the **ratio** `r = B / A` rather than by a quotient written inline: the
masses are then `1/4 + r/4`, `1/4 - r/4`, `1/2`, and the construction contains **no
division at all**. Positivity of the middle mass is exactly `r < 1`, which is exactly
`B < A`, which is exactly `v > 0`. This shape was adopted after a build showed the
divided form failing on renamed division lemmas; it is the same family.

*On the proof style.* The atom vector is written as an explicit finite piecewise function.
This makes `fin_cases` reduce it definitionally and avoids depending on the internal
`Matrix.cons` representation of vector notation.

definitions.name: Descent.Blindness.BundleRigidity.threeAtomWitness_threeFifths
definitions.body:
by
  refine threeAtom (3 / 5) (2 * B) B (1 / 2) (by norm_num) ?_ (by rw [hB]; norm_num)
    (by linarith) hBpos (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (by ring)
  rw [show (2 * B) ^ 2 = 4 * B ^ 2 by ring, hB]; norm_num
definitions.docstring:
**The rational witness at `v = 3/5`**, which needs no square-root manipulation: with `B² = 2/5`
and `A = 2B`, the masses are exactly `(3/8, 1/8, 1/2)`.

This is the positive control. A search that reports "no `d = 3` family exists for `v > 0`"
must find this one, and the upstream search did not.

definitions.name: Descent.Blindness.BundleRigidity.threeAtomAtOne
definitions.signature: (A : ℝ) (hA : A ^ 2 = 2) (hApos : 0 < A) : SingleModulus 3 1 where atom
definitions.body:
fun j ↦ if j = 0 then A else if j = 1 then -A else 0
  mass := ![1 / 4, 1 / 4, 1 / 2]
  atom_inj := by
    intro i j hij
    fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> norm_num at hij ⊢ <;> linarith
  mass_pos := by
    intro j
    fin_cases j
    · show (0:ℝ) < 1 / 4
      norm_num
    · show (0:ℝ) < 1 / 4
      norm_num
    · show (0:ℝ) < 1 / 2
      norm_num
  mass_sum := by
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_three]
    show (1 / 4 : ℝ) + 1 / 4 + 1 / 2 = 1
    norm_num
  mean_zero := by
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_three]
    show (1 / 4 : ℝ) * A + 1 / 4 * (-A) + 1 / 2 * (0 : ℝ) = 0
    ring
  var_one := by
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_three]
    show (1 / 4 : ℝ) * A ^ 2 + 1 / 4 * (-A) ^ 2 + 1 / 2 * (0 : ℝ) ^ 2 = 1
    have hkey : (1 / 4 : ℝ) * A ^ 2 + 1 / 4 * (-A) ^ 2 + 1 / 2 * (0 : ℝ) ^ 2
        = (1 / 2) * A ^ 2 := by ring
    rw [hkey, hA]; norm_num
  modulus_eq := by
    intro j
    fin_cases j
    · show |A ^ 2 - 1| = 1
      rw [hA]; norm_num
    · show |(-A) ^ 2 - 1| = 1
      rw [show (-A) ^ 2 = A ^ 2 by ring, hA]; norm_num
    · show |(0:ℝ) ^ 2 - 1| = 1
      norm_num
definitions.docstring:
**The `v = 1` family: atoms `(√2, -√2, 0)` with masses `(1/4, 1/4, 1/2)`.**

At `v = 1` the value `√(1-v)` is zero, so the two `(1-v)`-side atoms of the upstream
parameterization collide and `d = 4` becomes impossible
(`SingleModulus.card_le_three_of_v_eq_one`). What remains is this single family, and it
is genuinely a family: all three masses are positive, the mean is zero because the
`±√2` atoms carry equal mass, and the variance is `(1/4)·2 + (1/4)·2 + 0 = 1`.

This is a **second, independent** counterexample to the upstream `d ≤ 3` impossibility,
and a sharper one: it is not a boundary point of the `c`-line but a case the upstream
argument could not have reached at all, since the ratio `√((1+v)/(1-v))` on which that
argument turns is undefined at `v = 1`.

definitions.name: Descent.Blindness.BundleRigidity.fourAtom
definitions.signature: (v A B c : ℝ) (hv : 0 ≤ v) (hA : A ^ 2 = 1 + v) (hB : B ^ 2 = 1 - v) (hApos : 0 < A) (hBpos : 0 < B) (hBA : B < A) (hc : |c| * A < 1 / 4) : SingleModulus 4 v where atom
definitions.body:
fun j ↦
    if j.val = 0 then A else if j.val = 1 then -A else if j.val = 2 then B else -B
  mass := ![1 / 4 + c * B, 1 / 4 - c * B, 1 / 4 - c * A, 1 / 4 + c * A]
  atom_inj := by
    intro i j hij
                                                                                       
                                                                                         
                                                                                  
    fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> norm_num at hij ⊢ <;> exfalso <;> linarith
  mass_pos := by
    intro j
    have hcA : |c * A| < 1 / 4 := by
      rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos hApos]; exact hc
    have hcB : |c * B| < 1 / 4 := by
      rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos hBpos]
      have hmul : |c| * B ≤ |c| * A :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (le_of_lt hBA) (abs_nonneg c)
      linarith
    have h1 := abs_lt.mp hcA
    have h2 := abs_lt.mp hcB
    fin_cases j
    · show (0:ℝ) < 1 / 4 + c * B
      linarith [h2.1, h2.2]
    · show (0:ℝ) < 1 / 4 - c * B
      linarith [h2.1, h2.2]
    · show (0:ℝ) < 1 / 4 - c * A
      linarith [h1.1, h1.2]
    · show (0:ℝ) < 1 / 4 + c * A
      linarith [h1.1, h1.2]
  mass_sum := by
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_four]
    show (1 / 4 + c * B) + (1 / 4 - c * B) + (1 / 4 - c * A) + (1 / 4 + c * A) = 1
    ring
  mean_zero := by
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_four]
    show (1 / 4 + c * B) * A + (1 / 4 - c * B) * (-A) + (1 / 4 - c * A) * B
      + (1 / 4 + c * A) * (-B) = 0
    ring
  var_one := by
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_four]
    show (1 / 4 + c * B) * A ^ 2 + (1 / 4 - c * B) * (-A) ^ 2
      + (1 / 4 - c * A) * B ^ 2 + (1 / 4 + c * A) * (-B) ^ 2 = 1
    have hkey : (1 / 4 + c * B) * A ^ 2 + (1 / 4 - c * B) * (-A) ^ 2
        + (1 / 4 - c * A) * B ^ 2 + (1 / 4 + c * A) * (-B) ^ 2
        = (1 / 2) * A ^ 2 + (1 / 2) * B ^ 2 := by ring
    rw [hkey, hA, hB]; ring
  modulus_eq := by
    intro j
    fin_cases j
    · exact modulus_of_sq_eq_one_add hv hA
    · exact modulus_of_sq_eq_one_add hv (by simpa using hA)
    · exact modulus_of_sq_eq_one_sub hv hB
    · exact modulus_of_sq_eq_one_sub hv (by simpa using hB)
definitions.docstring:
**The upstream `d = 4` line, which is correct.**

Atoms `A, -A, B, -B` with masses `1/4 + cB, 1/4 - cB, 1/4 - cA, 1/4 + cA`. The mean
identity holds for *every* `c` — the two cross terms `cAB` cancel identically — and the
variance identity is insensitive to `c` for the same reason. So `c` is a genuinely free
parameter, and the only constraint is positivity: `|c| * A < 1/4`.

At the endpoints `|c| * A = 1/4` one mass vanishes and the family drops to the `d = 3`
family above. That is the whole correction, in one sentence: the parameter interval is
**closed**, and its endpoints are families, not empty.

definitions.signature: {k n : ℕ} (family : BundleFamily k) (panel : LocusSpectrum n) (i : Fin n) (v : ℝ) : Prop
definitions.docstring: **Locus `i` covers the modulus value `v`** when one of its atoms lands there with non-zero mass.

definitions.name: Descent.Blindness.SinglyCoveredBy
definitions.signature: {k n : ℕ} (family : BundleFamily k) (panel : LocusSpectrum n) (i : Fin n) (v : ℝ) : Prop
definitions.body:
Covers family panel i v ∧
    ∀ l : Fin n, l ≠ i → family.massAt (panel.support l) v = 0
definitions.docstring:
**The value `v` is singly covered by locus `i`**: `i` covers it and no other locus
contributes anything there.

This is the condition the peeling argument runs on, and for a diploid panel the largest
modulus value is singly covered by the rarest locus — the extreme atom has nobody to
trade with.

A panel is **separating** when every locus owns a modulus value that no other locus
reaches.

For diploid genotypes the rarest locus owns the largest modulus value outright, and
peeling it off leaves a smaller panel in which the next rarest does the same. This
condition is the simultaneous form of that, and it is what the theorem below consumes.
