definitions.name: Descent.Coalescent.TwoDemeMomentEpoch.witness
definitions.docstring:
Inhabitation for one epoch, at a positive duration.  A zero-duration epoch has the
identity propagator, so it would satisfy the class without propagating anything.

definitions.name: Descent.Coalescent.PairwiseCoalescenceTimes.witness
definitions.body:
fun _ ↦ 1
  between := fun i j ↦ if i = j then 1 else 2
  within_pos := by intro d; norm_num
  between_pos := by intro i j; split <;> norm_num
  between_symmetric := by
    intro i j
    by_cases h : i = j
    · subst h; rfl
    · simp [h, Ne.symm h]
  between_self := by intro i; simp
definitions.docstring:
Inhabitation for the pairwise coalescence times, on two demes and with the between-deme
time strictly exceeding the within-deme one -- the ordering that makes `hudsonFst` positive
rather than zero.

definitions.name: Descent.Coalescent.DemographicTwoLocusMoments.witness
definitions.docstring:
Inhabitation for the two-locus moment interface.  The moments are constant in the
recombination coordinate here, which is all the class asks: its two hypotheses are the index
symmetries, and a constant family satisfies them without pretending to a decay law the
interface deliberately does not fix.

definitions.name: Descent.Coalescent.sharedPath3
definitions.signature: (c p q : Fin 3) (t₃ t₂ : ℝ) : ℝ
definitions.body: if c = p ∨ c = q then t₃ else t₃ + 2 * t₂
definitions.docstring:
The length of the tree shared by the paths of two pairs `p ≠ q` that meet in a lineage,
in a three-sample whose first merger is the pair `c`.

If either pair is the one that merges first, the shared part is the single branch below their
common ancestor, of length `τ₃`.  If not -- the two long pairs -- the shared part is the edge
above the first cherry and the branch down to the odd leaf, `τ₃ + 2τ₂`.

Empirical status: NOT AN EMPIRICAL CLAIM.  It reads the tree off the jump chain and the
clock, as `pairTime` does.

definitions.name: Descent.Coalescent.sharedPath4
definitions.body: if d = 0 then 0 else if s = 0 then t₃ + 2 * t₂ else t₃
definitions.docstring:
The shared length of two DISJOINT pairs in a four-sample whose first merger is `01` and
whose second merger is `s`, for the pairing `d` (`0` is `(01,23)`, `1` is `(02,13)`, `2` is
`(03,12)`).

The pairing that respects the first cherry shares nothing.  The other two traverse the edge
above the first cherry; in the balanced tree they also traverse the edge above the second, so
they share `τ₃ + 2τ₂` rather than `τ₃`.

Empirical status: NOT AN EMPIRICAL CLAIM, for the reason `sharedPath3` carries.

definitions.name: Descent.Coalescent.pairCount
definitions.docstring: `C(n,2)`, the number of pairs.

definitions.name: Descent.Coalescent.sharingCount
definitions.docstring:
The number of unordered pairs-of-pairs sharing exactly one lineage: choose the shared
lineage, then two others.

definitions.name: Descent.Coalescent.disjointCount
definitions.docstring:
The number of unordered pairs-of-pairs that are disjoint: choose four lineages, then one
of the three ways to split them.

definitions.name: Descent.Coalescent.varPairwiseFromTree
definitions.body:
(pairCount n + sharingCount n + (2 / 3) * disjointCount n) / pairCount n ^ 2 * θ.value
    + (pairCount n + 2 * (sharingCount n / 3 + (2 / 9) * disjointCount n))
        / pairCount n ^ 2 * θ.value ^ 2
definitions.docstring:
`Var(π)` assembled from the tree: the per-pair variance `θ + θ²`, plus the covariances of
the two classes weighted by their counts, all over `C²`.

Empirical status: DERIVED.  Every constant in it is proved: `E(T) = Var(T) = 1` from the
exponential clock, `Cov = 1/3` and `E(S) = 1` for sharing pairs, `Cov = 2/9` and `E(S) = 2/3`
for disjoint ones.  What is ASSUMED, as everywhere in this group, is that the holding times
are independent -- `Descent.Coalescent.Program` item 4 -- and that mutation is Poisson at rate
`θ/2` along the branches, flagged at `SegregatingSites.expectedSegregatingSites`.

definitions.name: Descent.Coalescent.clippedTransform
definitions.body: ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-∑ k ∈ range m, max (ω k) 0))
definitions.docstring:
The truncated transform, with the coordinates clipped at zero so the sequence is
decreasing everywhere rather than only almost everywhere.  Clipping changes nothing on the
full-measure set where the clock is positive (`ae_holdProduct_pos`).

definitions.name: Descent.Coalescent.chainLaw
definitions.body:
| 0 => PMF.pure [Delta n]
  | k + 1 => (chainLaw n k).bind fun l ↦
      match l with
      | [] => PMF.pure []
      | x :: rest => (jumpLaw x).map fun y ↦ y :: x :: rest
definitions.docstring:
**The law of a whole trajectory of the jump chain**, newest state at the head.

Empirical status: NOT AN EMPIRICAL CLAIM.  It is `Kernel.jumpLaw` iterated; every step is
the uniform choice among covers that K-C (1.3) forces.

equations.rhs: (chainLaw n k).bind fun l ↦ match l with
(jumpLaw x).map fun y ↦ y :: x :: rest

definitions.name: Descent.Coalescent.blockLaw
definitions.body:
(chainLaw n k).bind fun l ↦
    match l with
    | [] => PMF.pure (Delta n)
    | x :: _ => PMF.pure x
definitions.docstring:
**The law of `ℛ_k`**, the jump chain's state after `k` jumps: the head of the trajectory.

This is the object K-C (2.3) computes.  `Descent.Coalescent.JumpChain.absoluteProb` writes
down Kingman's formula for it; `blockLaw` is the law itself, so the two now have somewhere to
meet.

definitions.name: Descent.Coalescent.chainOfList
definitions.signature: {n : ℕ} (l : List (ER n)) (k : ℕ) : ER n
definitions.docstring:
A trajectory read as the chain function `Path` takes: `chainOfList l k` is the state with `k`
blocks, which on a full trajectory sits at position `k - 1`.

definitions.name: Descent.Coalescent.chainStepKernel
definitions.signature: (n : ℕ) (k : ℕ) : Kernel (Π _i : Iic k, ER n) (ER n)
definitions.ret_type: Kernel (Π _i : Iic k, ER n) (ER n)
definitions.docstring:
The jump chain presented as a family of kernels indexed by time, each ignoring all but
the current coordinate.  This is the shape Ionescu-Tulcea consumes: a kernel from the past
`(x_0, …, x_k)` to the next state, which for a Markov chain depends only on `x_k`.

definitions.name: Descent.Coalescent.chainTraj
definitions.signature: (n : ℕ) : Kernel (Π _i : Iic 0, ER n) (Π _k : ℕ, ER n)
definitions.ret_type: Kernel (Π _i : Iic 0, ER n) (Π _k : ℕ, ER n)
definitions.body: Kernel.traj (X := fun _ : ℕ ↦ ER n) (chainStepKernel n) 0
definitions.docstring:
**The law of the whole jump chain.**  Ionescu-Tulcea applied to `chainStepKernel`: a
kernel from the starting state to trajectories in `ℕ → 𝓔ₙ`.

Empirical status: NOT AN EMPIRICAL CLAIM.  It is `Kernel.jumpKernel` extended along time by a
theorem of measure theory; every modelling commitment is already in the one-step kernel, whose
docstring carries it.

definitions.name: Descent.Coalescent.chainTrajFrom
definitions.signature: (n : ℕ) (ξ : ER n) : Measure (Π _k : ℕ, ER n)
definitions.docstring: The trajectory law started at a given relation.

definitions.name: Descent.Coalescent.varTransitTime
definitions.docstring:
`Var(T_n)`, the variance of the transit time: the sum of `d_r⁻²` over the `n - 1` phases,
the variances of independent exponentials adding.

Empirical status: DERIVED given independence, which is ASSUMED and named -- see the module
docstring.  The summand `d_r⁻²` is the variance of an exponential of rate `d_r`, and that is
now computed rather than quoted: `Descent.Coalescent.HoldingSecondMoment.variance_holdTime`
integrates K-C (1.7)'s density twice and subtracts.

definitions.name: Descent.Coalescent.twoDemeHDrift
definitions.docstring: Unit-size drift on the three heterozygosity moments.

definitions.name: Descent.Coalescent.twoDemeHMigration
definitions.docstring: Symmetric unit directional migration on heterozygosities.

definitions.name: Descent.Coalescent.twoDemeYDrift
definitions.docstring: Unit-size drift on the fifteen LD coordinates.

definitions.name: Descent.Coalescent.twoDemeYRecombination
definitions.docstring: Recombination coefficient: `-rho` on `DD`, `-rho/2` on `Dz`, zero on `pi2`.

definitions.name: Descent.Coalescent.twoDemeMutationCoupling
definitions.docstring: Mutation coupling from heterozygosity into `pi2`, at normalized mutation rate one.

definitions.name: Descent.Coalescent.twoDemeYMigration
definitions.docstring: Symmetric unit directional migration on all fifteen LD moments.

definitions.name: Descent.Coalescent.publishedTwoDemeLDDrift
definitions.body:
| .h row, .h column => twoDemeHDrift row column
  | .y row, .y column => twoDemeYDrift row column
  | _, _ => 0
definitions.docstring:
Drift-only block of the coupled operator.  Mutation is kept out of this block so that
the history's mutation rate can enter the transient operator explicitly instead of being
hidden in a normalized constant.

definitions.name: Descent.Coalescent.publishedTwoDemeLDMutation
definitions.docstring: Mutation-coupling block from heterozygosity into the two-locus coordinates.

definitions.name: Descent.Coalescent.publishedTwoDemeLDBase
definitions.docstring: Constant part of the coupled operator: drift plus mutation coupling.

definitions.name: Descent.Coalescent.publishedTwoDemeLDRecombination
definitions.docstring: Recombination coefficient matrix.

definitions.name: Descent.Coalescent.publishedTwoDemeLDMigration
definitions.body:
| .h row, .h column => twoDemeHMigration row column
  | .y row, .y column => twoDemeYMigration row column
  | _, _ => 0
definitions.docstring: Symmetric migration coefficient matrix.

definitions.name: Descent.Coalescent.publishedTwoDemeLDForcing
definitions.docstring: Normalized mutation forcing for heterozygosity; LD is forced through the coupling block.

definitions.name: Descent.Coalescent.publishedTwoDemeLDForcingAtMutation
definitions.docstring:
Mutation-rate-specific forcing.  The same rate multiplies the heterozygosity influx and
the coupling that carries that influx into `pi2`; omitting either occurrence changes the
stationary floor.

definitions.name: Descent.Coalescent.publishedTwoDemeLDOperatorAtMutation
definitions.signature: (theta rho M : ℝ) : Matrix TwoDemeLDCoordinate TwoDemeLDCoordinate ℝ
definitions.body:
publishedTwoDemeLDDrift + theta • publishedTwoDemeLDMutation +
    rho • publishedTwoDemeLDRecombination + M • publishedTwoDemeLDMigration
definitions.docstring:
Concrete two-deme operator with mutation influx exposed as a genuine rate coordinate.
This is the operator form of the small floor term: it is part of the same solve as drift,
recombination, and migration, not an attenuation multiplier applied afterward.

definitions.name: Descent.Coalescent.publishedTwoDemeLDOperator
definitions.signature: (rho M : ℝ) : Matrix TwoDemeLDCoordinate TwoDemeLDCoordinate ℝ
definitions.docstring: The concrete 18-state stationary operator.

definitions.name: Descent.Coalescent.publishedTwoDemeLDCoordinateValueAtMutation
definitions.body:
cramerCoordinate (publishedTwoDemeLDOperatorAtMutation theta rho M)
    (fun row ↦ -publishedTwoDemeLDForcingAtMutation theta row) coordinate
definitions.docstring: One exact stationary coordinate with mutation influx retained in the coupled solve.

definitions.name: Descent.Coalescent.publishedTwoDemeLDCoordinateValue
definitions.body:
cramerCoordinate (publishedTwoDemeLDOperator rho M)
    (fun row ↦ -publishedTwoDemeLDForcing row) coordinate
definitions.docstring: One exact stationary coordinate.

definitions.name: Descent.Coalescent.publishedTwoDemeWithinDAtMutation
definitions.docstring: Within-source `E[D₀²]` with mutation influx retained.

definitions.name: Descent.Coalescent.publishedTwoDemeCrossDAtMutation
definitions.docstring: Cross-deme `E[D₀D₁]` with mutation influx retained.

definitions.name: Descent.Coalescent.publishedTwoDemeDCorrelationAtMutation
definitions.body:
publishedTwoDemeCrossDAtMutation theta rho M /

definitions.docstring:
Mutation-aware stationary cross-deme correlation.  The mutation term is allowed to

definitions.docstring:
The exact stationary two-deme migration--LD prediction available to downstream
constructions.  It is not a law for transient histories or multi-deme lattices.

definitions.name: Descent.Coalescent.PublishedTwoDemeOperatorNonsingular
definitions.docstring:
Nonsingularity of the concrete 18-state operator, as a named proposition.  The name is
load-bearing for the kernel: a structure whose field types carry the concrete determinant
inline exceeds the kernel's recursion budget when the structure is checked (the standing
KERNEL-PENDING failure of the c9b30da3 workstream), while a field typed by this constant is
checked without unfolding it.

definitions.name: Descent.Coalescent.PublishedTwoDemeWithinNumeratorNonzero
definitions.docstring: Nonvanishing of the within-source Cramer numerator, named for the same kernel reason.

definitions.name: Descent.Coalescent.PublishedTwoDemeLDPoint.correlation
definitions.docstring: The concrete law evaluated on its typed domain.

definitions.name: Descent.Coalescent.panmicticDCorrelation
definitions.docstring: The exact panmictic check is one because both reads are the same coordinate.

definitions.name: Descent.Coalescent.AffineLowOrderLDCoordinate
definitions.docstring:
Add a constant coordinate so mutation influx and other affine source terms evolve in the
same matrix exponential as the homogeneous moments.

definitions.docstring: Linkage disequilibrium in determinant form.

definitions.name: Descent.Coalescent.TwoLocusHaplotypeFrequencies.mixture
definitions.signature: (alpha : ℝ) (alpha_nonneg : 0 ≤ alpha) (alpha_le_one : alpha ≤ 1) (source recipient : TwoLocusHaplotypeFrequencies) : TwoLocusHaplotypeFrequencies where AB
definitions.body:
alpha * source.AB + (1 - alpha) * recipient.AB
  Ab := alpha * source.Ab + (1 - alpha) * recipient.Ab
  aB := alpha * source.aB + (1 - alpha) * recipient.aB
  ab := alpha * source.ab + (1 - alpha) * recipient.ab
  AB_nonneg := add_nonneg (mul_nonneg alpha_nonneg source.AB_nonneg)
    (mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr alpha_le_one) recipient.AB_nonneg)
  Ab_nonneg := add_nonneg (mul_nonneg alpha_nonneg source.Ab_nonneg)
    (mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr alpha_le_one) recipient.Ab_nonneg)
  aB_nonneg := add_nonneg (mul_nonneg alpha_nonneg source.aB_nonneg)
    (mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr alpha_le_one) recipient.aB_nonneg)
  ab_nonneg := add_nonneg (mul_nonneg alpha_nonneg source.ab_nonneg)
    (mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr alpha_le_one) recipient.ab_nonneg)
  total_eq_one := by
    linear_combination
      alpha * source.total_eq_one + (1 - alpha) * recipient.total_eq_one
definitions.docstring:
Haplotype-wise migration/admixture with source fraction `alpha`.  Unlike a formula
written only for marginal allele frequencies, this operation retains arbitrary linkage in
both the source and recipient populations.

definitions.name: Descent.Coalescent.TwoLocusHaplotypeFrequencies.migrationLinkageVelocity
definitions.docstring: Infinitesimal change of recipient linkage under haplotype migration from `source`.

definitions.name: Descent.Coalescent.TwoLocusHaplotypeFrequencies.linkageEquilibrium
definitions.body:
frequency.leftFrequency * frequency.rightFrequency
  Ab := frequency.leftFrequency * (1 - frequency.rightFrequency)
  aB := (1 - frequency.leftFrequency) * frequency.rightFrequency
  ab := (1 - frequency.leftFrequency) * (1 - frequency.rightFrequency)
  AB_nonneg := mul_nonneg frequency.leftFrequency_nonneg frequency.rightFrequency_nonneg
  Ab_nonneg := mul_nonneg frequency.leftFrequency_nonneg
    (sub_nonneg.mpr frequency.rightFrequency_le_one)
  aB_nonneg := mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr frequency.leftFrequency_le_one)
    frequency.rightFrequency_nonneg
  ab_nonneg := mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr frequency.leftFrequency_le_one)
    (sub_nonneg.mpr frequency.rightFrequency_le_one)
  total_eq_one := by ring
definitions.docstring:
The linkage-equilibrium haplotype distribution with exactly the same two marginal
allele frequencies as `frequency`.

definitions.name: Descent.Coalescent.TwoLocusHaplotypeFrequencies.recombinationPulse
definitions.body: mixture alpha alpha_nonneg alpha_le_one (linkageEquilibrium frequency) frequency
definitions.docstring:
An exact recombination pulse: an `alpha` fraction is redrawn from the product of the
current marginals and the remainder retains the parental haplotype.  Convexity proves that
the result remains on the haplotype simplex.

definitions.name: Descent.Coalescent.TwoLocusHaplotypeFrequencies.recombinationLinkageVelocity
definitions.docstring: Infinitesimal linkage velocity generated by recombination.

definitions.name: Descent.Coalescent.TwoLocusHaplotypeFrequencies.leftAlleleFlip
definitions.body:
frequency.aB
  Ab := frequency.ab
  aB := frequency.AB
  ab := frequency.Ab
  AB_nonneg := frequency.aB_nonneg
  Ab_nonneg := frequency.ab_nonneg
  aB_nonneg := frequency.AB_nonneg
  ab_nonneg := frequency.Ab_nonneg
  total_eq_one := by linarith [frequency.total_eq_one]
definitions.docstring: Complement the allele at the left locus while leaving the right allele unchanged.

definitions.name: Descent.Coalescent.TwoLocusHaplotypeFrequencies.rightAlleleFlip
definitions.body:
frequency.Ab
  Ab := frequency.AB
  aB := frequency.ab
  ab := frequency.aB
  AB_nonneg := frequency.Ab_nonneg
  Ab_nonneg := frequency.AB_nonneg
  aB_nonneg := frequency.ab_nonneg
  ab_nonneg := frequency.aB_nonneg
  total_eq_one := by linarith [frequency.total_eq_one]
definitions.docstring: Complement the allele at the right locus while leaving the left allele unchanged.

definitions.name: Descent.Coalescent.TwoLocusHaplotypeFrequencies.leftMutationPulse
definitions.body: mixture epsilon epsilon_nonneg epsilon_le_one (leftAlleleFlip frequency) frequency
definitions.docstring:
Exact symmetric-biallelic mutation pulse at the left locus: flip the left allele of an
`epsilon` fraction of haplotypes.

definitions.name: Descent.Coalescent.TwoLocusHaplotypeFrequencies.rightMutationPulse
definitions.body: mixture epsilon epsilon_nonneg epsilon_le_one (rightAlleleFlip frequency) frequency
definitions.docstring: Exact symmetric-biallelic mutation pulse at the right locus.

definitions.name: Descent.Coalescent.TwoLocusHaplotypeFrequencies.twoLocusMutationPulse
definitions.signature: (epsilonLeft : ℝ) (epsilonLeft_nonneg : 0 ≤ epsilonLeft) (epsilonLeft_le_one : epsilonLeft ≤ 1) (epsilonRight : ℝ) (epsilonRight_nonneg : 0 ≤ epsilonRight) (epsilonRight_le_one : epsilonRight ≤ 1) (frequency : TwoLocusHaplotypeFrequencies) : TwoLocusHaplotypeFrequencies
definitions.body:
rightMutationPulse epsilonRight epsilonRight_nonneg epsilonRight_le_one
    (leftMutationPulse epsilonLeft epsilonLeft_nonneg epsilonLeft_le_one frequency)
definitions.docstring:
Independent symmetric mutation pulses at both loci, implemented as the composition of
the two exact simplex-preserving allele-flip channels.

definitions.name: Descent.Coalescent.TwoLocusHaplotypeFrequencies.scaledMutationLeftContrastVelocity
definitions.docstring:
Scaled symmetric-mutation velocity of the left centered contrast when the rate
coordinate is `theta = 2u`.

definitions.name: Descent.Coalescent.TwoLocusHaplotypeFrequencies.scaledMutationRightContrastVelocity
definitions.docstring: Scaled symmetric-mutation velocity of the right centered contrast.

definitions.name: Descent.Coalescent.TwoLocusHaplotypeFrequencies.scaledMutationLinkageVelocity
definitions.docstring:
Scaled symmetric-mutation velocity of linkage.  Both loci mutate, so the two contrast
decay channels add and give `-2D`.

definitions.name: Descent.Coalescent.TwoLocusHaplotypeFrequencies.maximalCoupling
definitions.body:
1 / 2
  Ab := 0
  aB := 0
  ab := 1 / 2
  AB_nonneg := by norm_num
  Ab_nonneg := by norm_num
  aB_nonneg := by norm_num
  ab_nonneg := by norm_num
  total_eq_one := by norm_num
definitions.docstring: A simplex point attaining the positive endpoint of the universal linkage interval.

definitions.name: Descent.Coalescent.twoLocusHaplotypeMean
definitions.body:
frequency.AB * score .AB + frequency.Ab * score .Ab +
    frequency.aB * score .aB + frequency.ab * score .ab
definitions.docstring: Mean of a score on the four haplotypes under one haplotype-frequency simplex point.

definitions.name: Descent.Coalescent.twoLocusHaplotypeCovariance
definitions.body:
twoLocusHaplotypeMean frequency (fun haplotype ↦
      firstScore haplotype * secondScore haplotype) -
    twoLocusHaplotypeMean frequency firstScore *
      twoLocusHaplotypeMean frequency secondScore
definitions.docstring: Exact covariance of two haplotype scores under one multinomial draw.

definitions.name: Descent.Coalescent.twoLocusLeftAlleleIndicator
definitions.docstring: Indicator that a haplotype carries `A` at the left locus.

definitions.name: Descent.Coalescent.twoLocusRightAlleleIndicator
definitions.docstring: Indicator that a haplotype carries `B` at the right locus.

definitions.name: Descent.Coalescent.twoLocusLinkageGradient
definitions.docstring: Gradient of the haplotype determinant `AB*ab - Ab*aB`.

definitions.name: Descent.Coalescent.twoLocusHaplotypeIndicator
definitions.docstring: Indicator score for one named haplotype.

definitions.name: Descent.Coalescent.twoLocusLinkageDrift
definitions.docstring:
The second-order Wright--Fisher generator applied to the haplotype determinant.  The
two mixed derivatives are the covariances of the opposite haplotype pairs.

definitions.name: Descent.Coalescent.twoLocusDzObservable
definitions.docstring: Pointwise observable whose expectation is `Dz(i,j,k)`.

definitions.name: Descent.Coalescent.twoLocusLeftHeterozygosity
definitions.docstring:
Symmetric cross-deme heterozygosity at the left locus.  At one deme this is
`2 p (1-p)`, the usual haploid heterozygosity.

definitions.name: Descent.Coalescent.twoLocusRightHeterozygosity
definitions.docstring: Symmetric cross-deme heterozygosity at the right locus.

definitions.name: Descent.Coalescent.twoLocusJointHeterozygosity
definitions.body:
twoLocusLeftHeterozygosity leftFirst leftSecond *
    twoLocusRightHeterozygosity rightFirst rightSecond / 4
definitions.docstring:
The exact generalized joint-heterozygosity coordinate of the multi-population
Hill--Robertson system:

`pi2(i,j;k,l) = H_left(i,j) H_right(k,l) / 4`.

The factor `1/4` is forced by the four-lineage sampling definition and makes the
within-deme specialization exactly `p(1-p)q(1-q)`.

definitions.name: Descent.Coalescent.TwoLocusDiffusionJet.const
definitions.signature: {D : ℕ} (constant : ℝ) : TwoLocusDiffusionJet D where value _
definitions.docstring: Constant observable.

definitions.name: Descent.Coalescent.TwoLocusDiffusionJet.add
definitions.signature: {D : ℕ} (first second : TwoLocusDiffusionJet D) : TwoLocusDiffusionJet D where value state
definitions.body:
first.value state + second.value state
  driftAt deme state := first.driftAt deme state + second.driftAt deme state
  gradientAt deme state haplotype :=
    first.gradientAt deme state haplotype + second.gradientAt deme state haplotype
definitions.docstring: Addition of diffusion jets.

definitions.name: Descent.Coalescent.TwoLocusDiffusionJet.smul
definitions.signature: {D : ℕ} (scalar : ℝ) (observable : TwoLocusDiffusionJet D) : TwoLocusDiffusionJet D where value state
definitions.body:
scalar * observable.value state
  driftAt deme state := scalar * observable.driftAt deme state
  gradientAt deme state haplotype :=
    scalar * observable.gradientAt deme state haplotype
definitions.docstring: Scalar multiplication of diffusion jets.

definitions.name: Descent.Coalescent.TwoLocusDiffusionJet.mul
definitions.signature: {D : ℕ} (first second : TwoLocusDiffusionJet D) : TwoLocusDiffusionJet D where value state
definitions.body:
first.value state * second.value state
  driftAt deme state :=
    first.value state * second.driftAt deme state +
      second.value state * first.driftAt deme state +
      twoLocusHaplotypeCovariance (state deme)
        (first.gradientAt deme state) (second.gradientAt deme state)
  gradientAt deme state haplotype :=
    first.value state * second.gradientAt deme state haplotype +
      second.value state * first.gradientAt deme state haplotype
definitions.docstring:
Exact Wright--Fisher diffusion product rule.  The cross term is the multinomial
covariance of the two gradients in the drifting deme.

definitions.name: Descent.Coalescent.twoLocusLeftFrequencyJet
definitions.signature: {D : ℕ} (index : Fin D) : TwoLocusDiffusionJet D where value state
definitions.body:
(state index).leftFrequency
  driftAt _ _ := 0
  gradientAt deme _ haplotype :=
    if deme = index then twoLocusLeftAlleleIndicator haplotype else 0
definitions.docstring: Left marginal frequency in one named deme.

definitions.name: Descent.Coalescent.twoLocusRightFrequencyJet
definitions.signature: {D : ℕ} (index : Fin D) : TwoLocusDiffusionJet D where value state
definitions.body:
(state index).rightFrequency
  driftAt _ _ := 0
  gradientAt deme _ haplotype :=
    if deme = index then twoLocusRightAlleleIndicator haplotype else 0
definitions.docstring: Right marginal frequency in one named deme.

definitions.name: Descent.Coalescent.twoLocusLinkageJet
definitions.signature: {D : ℕ} (index : Fin D) : TwoLocusDiffusionJet D where value state
definitions.body:
(state index).linkage
  driftAt deme state := if deme = index then twoLocusLinkageDrift (state index) else 0
  gradientAt deme state haplotype :=
    if deme = index then twoLocusLinkageGradient (state index) haplotype else 0
definitions.docstring:
Linkage determinant in one named deme, with its drift obtained from
`twoLocusLinkageDrift_eq_neg_linkage`.

definitions.name: Descent.Coalescent.twoLocusLeftContrastJet
definitions.docstring: Centered left marginal contrast.

definitions.name: Descent.Coalescent.twoLocusRightContrastJet
definitions.docstring: Centered right marginal contrast.

definitions.name: Descent.Coalescent.twoLocusHJet
definitions.signature: {D : ℕ} (first second : Fin D) : TwoLocusDiffusionJet D
definitions.docstring: Cross-deme left heterozygosity.

definitions.name: Descent.Coalescent.twoLocusRightHJet
definitions.signature: {D : ℕ} (first second : Fin D) : TwoLocusDiffusionJet D
definitions.docstring: Cross-deme right-locus heterozygosity.

definitions.name: Descent.Coalescent.twoLocusDDJet
definitions.signature: {D : ℕ} (first second : Fin D) : TwoLocusDiffusionJet D
definitions.docstring: Cross-deme product of linkage determinants.

definitions.name: Descent.Coalescent.twoLocusDzJet
definitions.signature: {D : ℕ} (first second third : Fin D) : TwoLocusDiffusionJet D
definitions.docstring: Generalized `Dz` observable.

definitions.name: Descent.Coalescent.twoLocusPi2Jet
definitions.signature: {D : ℕ} (first second third fourth : Fin D) : TwoLocusDiffusionJet D
definitions.docstring: Generalized four-deme joint heterozygosity.

definitions.name: Descent.Coalescent.twoLocusCoordinateJet
definitions.body:
| .H first second => twoLocusHJet first second
  | .DD first second => twoLocusDDJet first second
  | .Dz first second third => twoLocusDzJet first second third
  | .pi2 first second third fourth => twoLocusPi2Jet first second third fourth
definitions.docstring: The exact diffusion jet selected by any coordinate of the closed low-order family.

definitions.name: Descent.Coalescent.twoLocusJetMoment
definitions.signature: {D : ℕ} (state : Fin D → TwoLocusHaplotypeFrequencies) : LowOrderLDCoordinate D → ℝ
definitions.docstring: Concrete low-order moment vector read from one multi-deme haplotype-simplex state.

definitions.name: Descent.Coalescent.twoLocusWeightedJetDrift
definitions.signature: {D : ℕ} (coalescence : Fin D → ℝ) (state : Fin D → TwoLocusHaplotypeFrequencies) (coordinate : LowOrderLDCoordinate D) : ℝ
definitions.body:
∑ deme, coalescence deme *
    (twoLocusCoordinateJet coordinate).driftAt deme state
definitions.docstring:
Total neutral-drift velocity constructed from the exact local simplex generators and
arbitrary deme-specific coalescence rates.

definitions.name: Descent.Coalescent.twoLocusHMutationVelocity
definitions.docstring:
Per-unit-scaled-mutation velocity of cross-deme left heterozygosity when mutation acts
on either one of its two lineage arguments.

definitions.name: Descent.Coalescent.twoLocusPi2LeftMutationVelocity
definitions.docstring:
Per-unit-scaled-mutation velocity of generalized `pi2` when mutation acts on either
left-locus lineage argument.

definitions.name: Descent.Coalescent.twoLocusPi2RightMutationVelocity
definitions.docstring:
Per-unit-scaled-mutation velocity of generalized `pi2` when mutation acts on either
right-locus lineage argument.

definitions.name: Descent.Coalescent.haplotypeLowOrderLDState
definitions.signature: {D : ℕ} {sampleSpace : Type} (expectation : Foundations.ExpFunctional sampleSpace) (haplotype : sampleSpace → Fin D → TwoLocusHaplotypeFrequencies) : AffineLowOrderLDCoordinate D → ℝ
definitions.body:
| none => 1
  | some (.H first second) => expectation (fun outcome ↦
      twoLocusLeftHeterozygosity (haplotype outcome first) (haplotype outcome second))
  | some (.DD first second) => expectation (fun outcome ↦
      (haplotype outcome first).linkage * (haplotype outcome second).linkage)
  | some (.Dz first second third) => expectation (fun outcome ↦
      twoLocusDzObservable (haplotype outcome first) (haplotype outcome second)
        (haplotype outcome third))
  | some (.pi2 first second third fourth) => expectation (fun outcome ↦
      twoLocusJointHeterozygosity (haplotype outcome first) (haplotype outcome second)
        (haplotype outcome third) (haplotype outcome fourth))
definitions.docstring:
Evaluate the complete low-order polynomial family under a positive normalized
expectation.  This is the forward semantic map from an actual haplotype law to the finite
moment vector used by the demographic operator.

equations.rhs: expectation (fun outcome ↦ twoLocusLeftHeterozygosity (haplotype outcome first) (haplotype outcome second))
expectation (fun outcome ↦ (haplotype outcome first).linkage * (haplotype outcome second).linkage)
expectation (fun outcome ↦ twoLocusDzObservable (haplotype outcome first) (haplotype outcome second) (haplotype outcome third))
expectation (fun outcome ↦ twoLocusJointHeterozygosity (haplotype outcome first) (haplotype outcome second) (haplotype outcome third) (haplotype outcome fourth))

definitions.name: Descent.Coalescent.haplotypeLowOrderLDState_realization
definitions.signature: {D : ℕ} {sampleSpace : Type} (expectation : Foundations.ExpFunctional sampleSpace) (haplotype : sampleSpace → Fin D → TwoLocusHaplotypeFrequencies) : LowOrderLDHaplotypeRealization (haplotypeLowOrderLDState expectation haplotype) where sampleSpace
definitions.body:
sampleSpace
  expectation := expectation
  haplotype := haplotype
  constant_eq := rfl
  H_eq _ _ := rfl
  DD_eq _ _ := rfl
  Dz_eq _ _ _ := rfl
  pi2_eq _ _ _ _ := rfl
definitions.docstring:
The semantic moment map is realizable by construction, so the cone is inhabited by
every genuine law rather than merely constrained by a list of equations.

definitions.name: Descent.Coalescent.haplotypeLowOrderLDState_locusExchangeableRealization
definitions.signature: {D : ℕ} {sampleSpace : Type} (expectation : Foundations.ExpFunctional sampleSpace) (haplotype : sampleSpace → Fin D → TwoLocusHaplotypeFrequencies) (locus_exchangeable : ∀ first second, expectation (fun outcome ↦ twoLocusLeftHeterozygosity (haplotype outcome first) (haplotype outcome second)) = expectation (fun outcome ↦ twoLocusRightHeterozygosity (haplotype outcome first) (haplotype outcome second))) : LocusExchangeableLowOrderLDHaplotypeRealization (haplotypeLowOrderLDState expectation haplotype) where toLowOrderLDHaplotypeRealization

args.type: ∀ first second, expectation (fun outcome ↦ twoLocusLeftHeterozygosity (haplotype outcome first) (haplotype outcome second)) = expectation (fun outcome ↦ twoLocusRightHeterozygosity (haplotype outcome first) (haplotype outcome second))

definitions.body:
haplotypeLowOrderLDState_realization expectation haplotype
  H_right_eq first second := locus_exchangeable first second
definitions.docstring:
A concrete haplotype law whose expected left and right heterozygosities agree supplies
the stronger locus-exchangeable realization required by the mutation generator.

definitions.name: Descent.Coalescent.LowOrderLDHaplotypeRealization.pulseHaplotype
definitions.signature: {D : ℕ} {state : AffineLowOrderLDCoordinate D → ℝ} (realization : LowOrderLDHaplotypeRealization state) (alpha : ℝ) (alpha_nonneg : 0 ≤ alpha) (alpha_le_one : alpha ≤ 1) (source recipient : Fin D) : realization.sampleSpace → Fin D → TwoLocusHaplotypeFrequencies
definitions.body:
fun outcome deme ↦
    if deme = recipient then
      TwoLocusHaplotypeFrequencies.mixture alpha alpha_nonneg alpha_le_one
        (realization.haplotype outcome source) (realization.haplotype outcome recipient)
    else
      realization.haplotype outcome deme
definitions.docstring:
Apply one exact deterministic migration pulse to the underlying haplotype random
variables.  Only the recipient changes; its four haplotype frequencies are mixed before any
moment is read.

definitions.name: Descent.Coalescent.LowOrderLDHaplotypeRealization.pulseState
definitions.signature: {D : ℕ} {state : AffineLowOrderLDCoordinate D → ℝ} (realization : LowOrderLDHaplotypeRealization state) (alpha : ℝ) (alpha_nonneg : 0 ≤ alpha) (alpha_le_one : alpha ≤ 1) (source recipient : Fin D) : AffineLowOrderLDCoordinate D → ℝ
definitions.body:
haplotypeLowOrderLDState realization.expectation
    (realization.pulseHaplotype alpha alpha_nonneg alpha_le_one source recipient)
definitions.docstring:
The complete low-order moment vector immediately after a migration pulse, evaluated
from the transformed haplotype law rather than from an assumed scalar retention factor.

definitions.name: Descent.Coalescent.LowOrderLDHaplotypeRealization.pulse
definitions.signature: {D : ℕ} {state : AffineLowOrderLDCoordinate D → ℝ} (realization : LowOrderLDHaplotypeRealization state) (alpha : ℝ) (alpha_nonneg : 0 ≤ alpha) (alpha_le_one : alpha ≤ 1) (source recipient : Fin D) : LowOrderLDHaplotypeRealization (realization.pulseState alpha alpha_nonneg alpha_le_one source recipient)
definitions.ret_type: LowOrderLDHaplotypeRealization (realization.pulseState alpha alpha_nonneg alpha_le_one source recipient)
definitions.body:
haplotypeLowOrderLDState_realization realization.expectation
    (realization.pulseHaplotype alpha alpha_nonneg alpha_le_one source recipient)
definitions.docstring:
A deterministic migration pulse preserves the full haplotype-realizable cone by an
explicit transformed witness.

definitions.name: Descent.Coalescent.LowOrderLDHaplotypeRealization.toDDDRealization
definitions.signature: {D : ℕ} {state : AffineLowOrderLDCoordinate D → ℝ} (realization : LowOrderLDHaplotypeRealization state) : LowOrderLDDDRealization state where sampleSpace
definitions.body:
realization.sampleSpace
  expectation := realization.expectation
  linkage := fun outcome deme ↦ (realization.haplotype outcome deme).linkage
  dd_eq := realization.DD_eq
definitions.docstring:
Forgetting allele frequencies retains a single Gram witness for the complete `DD`
block.  Thus every haplotype-realizable state automatically satisfies all PSD consequences
proved below.

definitions.name: Descent.Coalescent.lowOrderLDBasis
definitions.signature: {D : ℕ} (column : LowOrderLDCoordinate D) : LowOrderLDCoordinate D → ℝ
definitions.body: fun coordinate ↦ if coordinate = column then 1 else 0
definitions.docstring: Basis state used to read one coefficient of the concrete generator.

definitions.name: Descent.Coalescent.lowOrderLDDrift
definitions.signature: {D : ℕ} (rates : ManyDemeLDRates D) (moment : LowOrderLDCoordinate D → ℝ) : LowOrderLDCoordinate D → ℝ
definitions.body:
| .H first second =>
      if first = second then -rates.coalescence first * moment (.H first second) else 0
  | .DD first second =>
      if first = second then
        rates.coalescence first *
          (-3 * moment (.DD first first) + moment (.Dz first first first) +
            moment (.pi2 first first first first))
      else
        -(rates.coalescence first + rates.coalescence second) * moment (.DD first second)
  | .Dz first second third =>
      if first = second ∧ second = third then
        rates.coalescence first *
          (4 * moment (.DD first first) - 5 * moment (.Dz first second third))
      else if first = second then
        -3 * rates.coalescence first * moment (.Dz first second third)
      else if first = third then
        -3 * rates.coalescence first * moment (.Dz first second third)
      else if second = third then
        4 * rates.coalescence second * moment (.DD first second) -
          rates.coalescence first * moment (.Dz first second third)
      else
        -rates.coalescence first * moment (.Dz first second third)
  | .pi2 first second third fourth =>
      if first = second ∧ second = third ∧ third = fourth then
        rates.coalescence first *
          (moment (.Dz first first first) - 2 * moment (.pi2 first second third fourth))
      else if first = second ∧ second = third then
        rates.coalescence first *
          (moment (.Dz first first fourth) / 2 - moment (.pi2 first second third fourth))
      else if first = second ∧ second = fourth then
        rates.coalescence first *
          (moment (.Dz first first third) / 2 - moment (.pi2 first second third fourth))
      else if first = third ∧ third = fourth then
        rates.coalescence first *
          (moment (.Dz first second first) / 2 - moment (.pi2 first second third fourth))
      else if second = third ∧ third = fourth then
        rates.coalescence second *
          (moment (.Dz second first second) / 2 - moment (.pi2 first second third fourth))
      else if first = second ∧ third = fourth then
        -(rates.coalescence first + rates.coalescence third) *
          moment (.pi2 first second third fourth)
      else if (first = third ∧ second = fourth) ∨ (first = fourth ∧ second = third) then
        rates.coalescence first / 4 * moment (.Dz first second second) +
          rates.coalescence second / 4 * moment (.Dz second first first)
      else if first = second then
        -rates.coalescence first * moment (.pi2 first second third fourth)
      else if first = third then
        rates.coalescence first / 4 * moment (.Dz first second fourth)
      else if first = fourth then
        rates.coalescence first / 4 * moment (.Dz first second third)
      else if second = third then
        rates.coalescence second / 4 * moment (.Dz second first fourth)
      else if second = fourth then
        rates.coalescence second / 4 * moment (.Dz second first third)
      else if third = fourth then
        -rates.coalescence third * moment (.pi2 first second third fourth)
      else 0
definitions.docstring:
Drift contribution to the closed low-order system.  The cases are equality patterns of
the population indices, not separate demographic assumptions.

equations.rhs: if first = second then -rates.coalescence first * moment (.H first second) else 0

if first = second then rates.coalescence first * (-3 * moment (.DD first first) + moment (.Dz first first first) + moment (.pi2 first first first first)) else -(rates.coalescence first + rates.coalescence second) * moment (.DD first second)

if first = second ∧ second = third then rates.coalescence first * (4 * moment (.DD first first) - 5 * moment (.Dz first second third)) else if first = second then -3 * rates.coalescence first * moment (.Dz first second third) else if first = third then -3 * rates.coalescence first * moment (.Dz first second third) else if second = third then 4 * rates.coalescence second * moment (.DD first second) - rates.coalescence first * moment (.Dz first second third) else -rates.coalescence first * moment (.Dz first second third)

if first = second ∧ second = third ∧ third = fourth then rates.coalescence first * (moment (.Dz first first first) - 2 * moment (.pi2 first second third fourth)) else if first = second ∧ second = third then rates.coalescence first * (moment (.Dz first first fourth) / 2 - moment (.pi2 first second third fourth)) else if first = second ∧ second = fourth then rates.coalescence first * (moment (.Dz first first third) / 2 - moment (.pi2 first second third fourth)) else if first = third ∧ third = fourth then rates.coalescence first * (moment (.Dz first second first) / 2 - moment (.pi2 first second third fourth)) else if second = third ∧ third = fourth then rates.coalescence second * (moment (.Dz second first second) / 2 - moment (.pi2 first second third fourth)) else if first = second ∧ third = fourth then -(rates.coalescence first + rates.coalescence third) * moment (.pi2 first second third fourth) else if (first = third ∧ second = fourth) ∨ (first = fourth ∧ second = third) then rates.coalescence first / 4 * moment (.Dz first second second) + rates.coalescence second / 4 * moment (.Dz second first first) else if first = second then -rates.coalescence first * moment (.pi2 first second third fourth) else if first = third then rates.coalescence first / 4 * moment (.Dz first second fourth) else if first = fourth then rates.coalescence first / 4 * moment (.Dz first second third) else if second = third then rates.coalescence second / 4 * moment (.Dz second first fourth) else if second = fourth then rates.coalescence second / 4 * moment (.Dz second first third) else if third = fourth then -rates.coalescence third * moment (.pi2 first second third fourth) else 0

definitions.name: Descent.Coalescent.lowOrderLDMigration
definitions.signature: {D : ℕ} (rates : ManyDemeLDRates D) (moment : LowOrderLDCoordinate D → ℝ) : LowOrderLDCoordinate D → ℝ
definitions.body:
| .H first second =>
      (∑ target, rates.migration first target *
        (moment (.H target second) - moment (.H first second))) +
      (∑ target, rates.migration second target *
        (moment (.H first target) - moment (.H first second)))
  | .DD first second =>
      (∑ target, rates.migration first target *
        (moment (.DD target second) - moment (.DD first second) +
          (moment (.Dz second first first) - moment (.Dz second first target) -
            moment (.Dz second target first) + moment (.Dz second target target)) / 4)) +
      (∑ target, rates.migration second target *
        (moment (.DD first target) - moment (.DD first second) +
          (moment (.Dz first second second) - moment (.Dz first second target) -
            moment (.Dz first target second) + moment (.Dz first target target)) / 4))
  | .Dz first second third =>
      (∑ target, rates.migration first target *
        (moment (.Dz target second third) - moment (.Dz first second third) +
          4 * (moment (.pi2 first second first third) -
            moment (.pi2 first second third target) -
            moment (.pi2 second target first third) +
            moment (.pi2 second target third target)))) +
      (∑ target, rates.migration second target *
        (moment (.Dz first target third) - moment (.Dz first second third))) +
      (∑ target, rates.migration third target *
        (moment (.Dz first second target) - moment (.Dz first second third)))
  | .pi2 first second third fourth =>
      (∑ target, rates.migration first target *
        (moment (.pi2 target second third fourth) -
          moment (.pi2 first second third fourth))) +
      (∑ target, rates.migration second target *
        (moment (.pi2 first target third fourth) -
          moment (.pi2 first second third fourth))) +
      (∑ target, rates.migration third target *
        (moment (.pi2 first second target fourth) -
          moment (.pi2 first second third fourth))) +
      (∑ target, rates.migration fourth target *
        (moment (.pi2 first second third target) -
          moment (.pi2 first second third fourth)))
definitions.docstring:
Continuous migration contribution.  Each lineage index migrates separately.  The extra
`Dz` and `pi2` differences are exactly the terms created because `D` is nonlinear in
haplotype frequencies; this is where migration restores shared linkage.

equations.rhs: (∑ target, rates.migration first target * (moment (.H target second) - moment (.H first second))) + (∑ target, rates.migration second target * (moment (.H first target) - moment (.H first second)))

(∑ target, rates.migration first target * (moment (.DD target second) - moment (.DD first second) + (moment (.Dz second first first) - moment (.Dz second first target) - moment (.Dz second target first) + moment (.Dz second target target)) / 4)) + (∑ target, rates.migration second target * (moment (.DD first target) - moment (.DD first second) + (moment (.Dz first second second) - moment (.Dz first second target) - moment (.Dz first target second) + moment (.Dz first target target)) / 4))

(∑ target, rates.migration first target * (moment (.Dz target second third) - moment (.Dz first second third) + 4 * (moment (.pi2 first second first third) - moment (.pi2 first second third target) - moment (.pi2 second target first third) + moment (.pi2 second target third target)))) + (∑ target, rates.migration second target * (moment (.Dz first target third) - moment (.Dz first second third))) + (∑ target, rates.migration third target * (moment (.Dz first second target) - moment (.Dz first second third)))

(∑ target, rates.migration first target * (moment (.pi2 target second third fourth) - moment (.pi2 first second third fourth))) + (∑ target, rates.migration second target * (moment (.pi2 first target third fourth) - moment (.pi2 first second third fourth))) + (∑ target, rates.migration third target * (moment (.pi2 first second target fourth) - moment (.pi2 first second third fourth))) + (∑ target, rates.migration fourth target * (moment (.pi2 first second third target) - moment (.pi2 first second third fourth)))

definitions.name: Descent.Coalescent.lowOrderLDRecombination
definitions.signature: {D : ℕ} (rates : ManyDemeLDRates D) (moment : LowOrderLDCoordinate D → ℝ) : LowOrderLDCoordinate D → ℝ
definitions.body:
| .H _ _ => 0
  | .DD first second =>
      -(rates.recombination first + rates.recombination second) / 2 *
        moment (.DD first second)
  | .Dz first second third =>
      -rates.recombination first / 2 * moment (.Dz first second third)
  | .pi2 _ _ _ _ => 0
definitions.docstring: Recombination damps each `D` factor at half its deme-specific scaled rate.

equations.rhs: -(rates.recombination first + rates.recombination second) / 2 * moment (.DD first second)

definitions.name: Descent.Coalescent.lowOrderLDMutationCoupling
definitions.signature: {D : ℕ} (rates : ManyDemeLDRates D) (moment : LowOrderLDCoordinate D → ℝ) : LowOrderLDCoordinate D → ℝ
definitions.body:
| .pi2 first second third fourth =>
      (rates.mutation third + rates.mutation fourth) / 8 * moment (.H first second) +
      (rates.mutation first + rates.mutation second) / 8 * moment (.H third fourth)
  | _ => 0
definitions.docstring: Mutation coupling from single-locus heterozygosity into joint heterozygosity.

equations.rhs: (rates.mutation third + rates.mutation fourth) / 8 * moment (.H first second) + (rates.mutation first + rates.mutation second) / 8 * moment (.H third fourth)

definitions.name: Descent.Coalescent.lowOrderLDRecurrentMutationDamping
definitions.signature: {D : ℕ} (rates : ManyDemeLDRates D) (moment : LowOrderLDCoordinate D → ℝ) : LowOrderLDCoordinate D → ℝ
definitions.body:
| .H first second =>
      -(rates.mutation first + rates.mutation second) * moment (.H first second)
  | .DD first second =>
      -2 * (rates.mutation first + rates.mutation second) * moment (.DD first second)
  | .Dz first second third =>
      -(2 * rates.mutation first + rates.mutation second + rates.mutation third) *
        moment (.Dz first second third)
  | .pi2 first second third fourth =>
      -(rates.mutation first + rates.mutation second + rates.mutation third +
          rates.mutation fourth) * moment (.pi2 first second third fourth)
definitions.docstring:
Exact recurrent symmetric-biallelic mutation damping.

The rate coordinate is `theta = 2u`.  A centered allele contrast decays at rate `theta`,
so a within-deme linkage covariance `D` (two contrasts) decays at `2 theta`.  Counting the
contrasts in each product gives the four rows below: two `D` factors in `DD`; one `D` and two
single-locus contrasts in `Dz`; and four single-locus contrasts in `pi2`.  The `H` row is the
return-mutation correction to the affine heterozygosity influx.  This is the term absent from
the infinite-sites leading-order system.

equations.rhs: -(rates.mutation first + rates.mutation second) * moment (.H first second)
-2 * (rates.mutation first + rates.mutation second) * moment (.DD first second)
-(2 * rates.mutation first + rates.mutation second + rates.mutation third) * moment (.Dz first second third)
-(rates.mutation first + rates.mutation second + rates.mutation third + rates.mutation fourth) * moment (.pi2 first second third fourth)

definitions.signature: {D : ℕ} (rates : ManyDemeLDRates D) : LowOrderLDCoordinate D → ℝ
definitions.docstring: Affine mutation influx into the heterozygosity coordinates.

definitions.name: Descent.Coalescent.lowOrderLDHomogeneousGenerator
definitions.signature: {D : ℕ} (rates : ManyDemeLDRates D) (moment : LowOrderLDCoordinate D → ℝ) (coordinate : LowOrderLDCoordinate D) : ℝ
definitions.body:
lowOrderLDDrift rates moment coordinate + lowOrderLDMigration rates moment coordinate +
    lowOrderLDRecombination rates moment coordinate +
    lowOrderLDMutationCoupling rates moment coordinate +
    lowOrderLDRecurrentMutationDamping rates moment coordinate
definitions.docstring: The derived homogeneous generator for arbitrary deme count.

definitions.name: Descent.Coalescent.augmentedLowOrderLDGenerator
definitions.signature: {D : ℕ} (rates : ManyDemeLDRates D) : Matrix (AffineLowOrderLDCoordinate D) (AffineLowOrderLDCoordinate D) ℝ
definitions.body:
| some row, some column => lowOrderLDHomogeneousGenerator rates (lowOrderLDBasis column) row
  | some row, none => lowOrderLDMutationForcing rates row
  | none, _ => 0
definitions.docstring: Concrete constant-augmented matrix of the arbitrary-deme moment ODE.

definitions.name: Descent.Coalescent.lowOrderLDHProjectionLinearMap
definitions.signature: {D : ℕ} : (AffineLowOrderLDCoordinate D → ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] (AffinePairDivergenceCoordinate D → ℝ) where toFun state coordinate
definitions.ret_type: (AffineLowOrderLDCoordinate D → ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] (AffinePairDivergenceCoordinate D → ℝ) where toFun state coordinate
definitions.body:
match coordinate with
    | none => state none
    | some (first, second) => state (some (.H first second))
  map_add' := by
    intro left right
    funext coordinate
    cases coordinate <;> simp
  map_smul' := by
    intro scalar state
    funext coordinate
    cases coordinate <;> simp
definitions.docstring:
Linear readout retaining only the affine constant and all ordered `H` coordinates from
the complete low-order two-locus state.

definitions.name: Descent.Coalescent.lowOrderLDHProjection
definitions.docstring: Rectangular matrix selecting the closed `H` subsystem from the joint state.

definitions.name: Descent.Coalescent.lowOrderLDAffineColumnMoment
definitions.signature: {D : ℕ} (column : AffineLowOrderLDCoordinate D) : LowOrderLDCoordinate D → ℝ
definitions.body:
match column with
  | none => fun _ ↦ 0
  | some coordinate => lowOrderLDBasis coordinate
definitions.docstring: Joint moment table represented by one column of the augmented low-order system.

definitions.name: Descent.Coalescent.lowOrderLDAffineColumnConstant
definitions.docstring: Constant coefficient represented by one augmented low-order column.

definitions.name: Descent.Coalescent.oneDemeLDStationaryDenominator
definitions.body:
let c := rates.coalescence 0
  let theta := rates.mutation 0
  let rho := rates.recombination 0
  18 * c ^ 3 + 13 * c ^ 2 * rho + 108 * c ^ 2 * theta + c * rho ^ 2 +
    38 * c * theta * rho + 160 * c * theta ^ 2 + 2 * theta * rho ^ 2 +
    24 * theta ^ 2 * rho + 64 * theta ^ 3
definitions.docstring:
Positive denominator of the recurrent-biallelic one-deme stationary `DD/Dz/pi2` solve.
It is written as an expanded positive polynomial so the physical rate domain excludes a
Cramer pole without appealing to a numerical determinant.

definitions.name: Descent.Coalescent.oneDemeStationaryLowOrderLDState
definitions.body:
| none => 1
  | some (.H _ _) =>
      rates.mutation 0 / (rates.coalescence 0 + 2 * rates.mutation 0)
  | some (.DD _ _) =>
      rates.coalescence 0 * rates.mutation 0 ^ 2 *
        (10 * rates.coalescence 0 + rates.recombination 0 + 8 * rates.mutation 0) /
      (4 * (rates.coalescence 0 + 2 * rates.mutation 0) *
        oneDemeLDStationaryDenominator rates)
  | some (.Dz _ _ _) =>
      2 * rates.coalescence 0 ^ 2 * rates.mutation 0 ^ 2 /
        ((rates.coalescence 0 + 2 * rates.mutation 0) *
          oneDemeLDStationaryDenominator rates)
  | some (.pi2 _ _ _ _) =>
      rates.coalescence 0 ^ 3 * rates.mutation 0 ^ 2 /
          ((rates.coalescence 0 + 2 * rates.mutation 0) ^ 2 *
            oneDemeLDStationaryDenominator rates) +
        rates.mutation 0 ^ 2 /
          (4 * (rates.coalescence 0 + 2 * rates.mutation 0) ^ 2)
definitions.docstring:
Closed stationary solution of the four recurrent-biallelic one-deme equations.  Writing
`c = 1/(2N)`, `theta = 2u`, and `rho = 2r`, the solution is

`H = theta/(c+2theta)`,
`DD = c theta²(10c+rho+8theta)/(4(c+2theta)Q)`,
`Dz = 2c²theta²/((c+2theta)Q)`, and
`pi2 = c³theta²/((c+2theta)²Q) + theta²/(4(c+2theta)²)`,

where `Q = oneDemeLDStationaryDenominator`.  As `theta → 0`, the leading `theta²`
coefficients reduce to the former infinite-sites boundary, but this expression also retains
the return-mutation terms required by the biallelic ascertainment law.

Thus the ancestral boundary has no fitted moment table and no unchecked determinant.

equations.rhs: rates.coalescence 0 * rates.mutation 0 ^ 2 * (10 * rates.coalescence 0 + rates.recombination 0 + 8 * rates.mutation 0) / (4 * (rates.coalescence 0 + 2 * rates.mutation 0) * oneDemeLDStationaryDenominator rates)

rates.coalescence 0 ^ 3 * rates.mutation 0 ^ 2 / ((rates.coalescence 0 + 2 * rates.mutation 0) ^ 2 * oneDemeLDStationaryDenominator rates) + rates.mutation 0 ^ 2 / (4 * (rates.coalescence 0 + 2 * rates.mutation 0) ^ 2)

definitions.name: Descent.Coalescent.LowOrderLDCoordinate.collapseToOneDeme
definitions.docstring:
Collapse an arbitrary-deme coordinate to the unique coordinate of a single common
ancestral deme.

definitions.name: Descent.Coalescent.commonAncestralLowOrderLDState
definitions.body:
| none => 1
  | some coordinate =>
      oneDemeStationaryLowOrderLDState ancestralRates (some coordinate.collapseToOneDeme)
definitions.docstring:
Lift a derived one-deme equilibrium state to the instant before the first split, where
all descendant labels denote the same ancestral population.

definitions.name: Descent.Coalescent.commonAncestralLowOrderLDDDRealization
definitions.signature: {D : ℕ} (ancestralRates : ManyDemeLDRates 1) : LowOrderLDDDRealization (commonAncestralLowOrderLDState (D := D) ancestralRates) where sampleSpace
definitions.body:
Unit
  expectation := Foundations.ExpFunctional.evalAt ()
  linkage := fun _ _ ↦
    Real.sqrt (oneDemeStationaryLowOrderLDState ancestralRates (some (.DD 0 0)))
  dd_eq := by
    intro first second
    change oneDemeStationaryLowOrderLDState ancestralRates (some (.DD 0 0)) =
      Real.sqrt (oneDemeStationaryLowOrderLDState ancestralRates (some (.DD 0 0))) *
        Real.sqrt (oneDemeStationaryLowOrderLDState ancestralRates (some (.DD 0 0)))
    rw [← pow_two, Real.sq_sqrt (oneDemeStationaryLowOrderLDState_DD_nonneg ancestralRates)]
definitions.docstring:
The entire unsplit ancestral `DD` block has one explicit Gram realization: every deme
label reads the same constant linkage observable whose square is the stationary `DD` value.
This includes the zero-mutation boundary, where that observable is zero.

definitions.name: Descent.Coalescent.ManyDemeLDRates.epoch
definitions.signature: {D : ℕ} (rates : ManyDemeLDRates D) (duration : ℝ) (duration_nonneg : 0 ≤ duration) : LowOrderLDEpoch D where generator
definitions.body:
augmentedLowOrderLDGenerator rates
  duration := duration
  duration_nonneg := duration_nonneg
  constant_row := fun _ ↦ rfl
definitions.docstring: Build an epoch directly from the derived arbitrary-deme rate law.

definitions.name: Descent.Coalescent.LowOrderLDEpoch.propagator
definitions.signature: {D : ℕ} (epoch : LowOrderLDEpoch D) : Matrix (AffineLowOrderLDCoordinate D) (AffineLowOrderLDCoordinate D) ℝ
definitions.docstring: The exactly evaluable semigroup of one epoch.

definitions.name: Descent.Coalescent.LowOrderLDCoordinate.mergeSplit
definitions.signature: {D : ℕ} (parent child : Fin D) : LowOrderLDCoordinate D → LowOrderLDCoordinate D
definitions.body:
| .H first second => .H (if first = child then parent else first)
      (if second = child then parent else second)
  | .DD first second => .DD (if first = child then parent else first)
      (if second = child then parent else second)
  | .Dz first second third => .Dz (if first = child then parent else first)
      (if second = child then parent else second) (if third = child then parent else third)
  | .pi2 first second third fourth =>
      .pi2 (if first = child then parent else first)
        (if second = child then parent else second)
        (if third = child then parent else third)
        (if fourth = child then parent else fourth)
definitions.docstring: Replace every occurrence of a newly created child label by its parent label.

equations.rhs: .H (if first = child then parent else first) (if second = child then parent else second)
.DD (if first = child then parent else first) (if second = child then parent else second)
.Dz (if first = child then parent else first) (if second = child then parent else second) (if third = child then parent else third)
.pi2 (if first = child then parent else first) (if second = child then parent else second) (if third = child then parent else third) (if fourth = child then parent else fourth)

definitions.name: Descent.Coalescent.lowOrderLDSplitTransform
definitions.signature: {D : ℕ} (parent child : Fin D) : Matrix (AffineLowOrderLDCoordinate D) (AffineLowOrderLDCoordinate D) ℝ
definitions.body:
| none, none => 1
  | some row, some column => if row.mergeSplit parent child = column then 1 else 0
  | _, _ => 0
definitions.docstring:
Exact instantaneous split matrix: immediately after a split the child's haplotype
frequencies equal the parent's, so every new coordinate pulls back by label replacement.

equations.rhs: if row.mergeSplit parent child = column then 1 else 0

definitions.name: Descent.Coalescent.LowOrderLDDDRealization.split
definitions.signature: {D : ℕ} {state : AffineLowOrderLDCoordinate D → ℝ} (realization : LowOrderLDDDRealization state) (parent child : Fin D) : LowOrderLDDDRealization ((lowOrderLDSplitTransform parent child).mulVec state) where sampleSpace
definitions.ret_type: LowOrderLDDDRealization ((lowOrderLDSplitTransform parent child).mulVec state) where sampleSpace
definitions.body:
realization.sampleSpace
  expectation := realization.expectation
  linkage := fun outcome deme ↦
    realization.linkage outcome (if deme = child then parent else deme)
  dd_eq := by
    intro first second
    rw [lowOrderLDSplitTransform_mulVec]
    change state (some (.DD (if first = child then parent else first)
      (if second = child then parent else second))) = _
    exact realization.dd_eq _ _
definitions.docstring:
Deterministic population splitting preserves one common Gram realization of the entire
`DD` block: the child's linkage observable is exactly the parent's pre-split observable and
every other observable is unchanged.

definitions.name: Descent.Coalescent.LowOrderLDHaplotypeRealization.split
definitions.signature: {D : ℕ} {state : AffineLowOrderLDCoordinate D → ℝ} (realization : LowOrderLDHaplotypeRealization state) (parent child : Fin D) : LowOrderLDHaplotypeRealization ((lowOrderLDSplitTransform parent child).mulVec state) where sampleSpace
definitions.ret_type: LowOrderLDHaplotypeRealization ((lowOrderLDSplitTransform parent child).mulVec state) where sampleSpace
definitions.body:
realization.sampleSpace
  expectation := realization.expectation
  haplotype := fun outcome deme ↦
    realization.haplotype outcome (if deme = child then parent else deme)
  constant_eq := by
    rw [lowOrderLDSplitTransform_mulVec]
    exact realization.constant_eq
  H_eq := by
    intro first second
    rw [lowOrderLDSplitTransform_mulVec]
    change state (some (.H (if first = child then parent else first)
      (if second = child then parent else second))) = _
    exact realization.H_eq _ _
  DD_eq := by
    intro first second
    rw [lowOrderLDSplitTransform_mulVec]
    change state (some (.DD (if first = child then parent else first)
      (if second = child then parent else second))) = _
    exact realization.DD_eq _ _
  Dz_eq := by
    intro first second third
    rw [lowOrderLDSplitTransform_mulVec]
    change state (some (.Dz (if first = child then parent else first)
      (if second = child then parent else second)
      (if third = child then parent else third))) = _
    exact realization.Dz_eq _ _ _
  pi2_eq := by
    intro first second third fourth
    rw [lowOrderLDSplitTransform_mulVec]
    change state (some (.pi2 (if first = child then parent else first)
      (if second = child then parent else second)
      (if third = child then parent else third)
      (if fourth = child then parent else fourth))) = _
    exact realization.pi2_eq _ _ _ _
definitions.docstring:
A deterministic split preserves the full haplotype semantic cone, not only its `DD`
projection: every coordinate is obtained by replacing the child haplotype-frequency random
variable with the parent's random variable.

definitions.docstring: Present-day state after the complete ordered operator product.

definitions.name: Descent.Coalescent.cylinderSpace
definitions.docstring:
The σ-algebra on `𝓔` generated by the restrictions: the smallest one making every `ρ_n`
measurable, and so the one in which "finite-dimensional distribution" means anything.

definitions.name: Descent.Coalescent.cylinders
definitions.docstring: A cylinder set: the relations whose restriction to `{1, …, n}` is a given state.

definitions.name: Descent.Coalescent.relativeSize
definitions.docstring:
`λ(t)`, the population size `t` coalescent units in the past relative to the present, for
a population growing forwards at exponential rate `β`.

Empirical status: THIS IS THE MODEL.  Exponential growth is a modelling choice about a
history, not a derivation; `Descent.Portability.HumanDemography` is where the corpus records
which histories have been measured.

definitions.name: Descent.Coalescent.timeChange
definitions.docstring:
`τ(t) = ∫₀ᵗ ds/λ(s)`, evaluated for the exponential history: the amount of standard
coalescent time that has elapsed by real time `t`.

Empirical status: DERIVED given `relativeSize` -- `deriv_timeChange` is the statement that
this function has the derivative the integral definition requires, and the integral of a
continuous function is determined by its derivative and its value at zero, both of which are
proved below.

definitions.name: Descent.Coalescent.pairSurvival
definitions.docstring:
The probability that two lineages have not yet coalesced by real time `t`: the standard
`e^{-s}` read on the `τ` clock.

Empirical status: DERIVED given the time change -- it is `Descent.Coalescent.HoldingTime`'s
exponential survival at `d_2 = 1`, composed with `timeChange`.

definitions.name: Descent.Coalescent.parentAssignment
definitions.signature: (N k : ℕ) [NeZero N] : PMF (Fin k → Fin N)
definitions.docstring:
**The Wright-Fisher parent choice.**  Each of `k` lineages independently and uniformly
picks one of the `N` members of the previous generation.  This is the uniform probability
mass function on parent maps, and it is the ONLY probabilistic input in this file.

Empirical status: THIS IS THE MODEL, not a claim about a population.  K-G (2.2) shows the
symmetric multinomial family-size law is equivalent to this backwards prescription, and
K-G section 4 shows the same limit follows from any exchangeable family-size law with bounded
moments, with the family-size variance `σ²` rescaling time.  Whether a given
population reproduces this way is the empirical question, and `Descent.Blindness` records
which statistics could tell.

definitions.name: Descent.Coalescent.ancestralPartition
definitions.signature: {k N : ℕ} (f : Fin k → Fin N) : Setoid (Fin k)
definitions.docstring:
**The ancestral partition.**  Two lineages fall in the same block exactly when they
chose the same parent.  This is Kingman's `R_1`: the relation on `{1, …, k}` holding of
`(i, j)` when `i` and `j` have a common ancestor one generation back (K-G (2.5)-(2.6)).

Empirical status: NOT AN EMPIRICAL CLAIM.  It is the kernel of the parent map, i.e. a
definition of "common ancestor", not an assertion about one.

definitions.name: Descent.Coalescent.ancestralPartitionLaw
definitions.docstring:
**The partition-valued step.**  Pushing the mechanism forward through the ancestral
partition gives a genuine law on equivalence relations -- the object the corpus previously
lacked, and the one Kingman's whole theory is about.

Empirical status: NOT AN EMPIRICAL CLAIM.  It is the pushforward of `parentAssignment`
along `ancestralPartition`, and both of those carry that verdict for the same reason: a
kernel of a map is a definition of "common ancestor", not an assertion about one.  What
is empirically at stake is whether a population reproduces by `parentAssignment`, which
`parentAssignment`'s own docstring states and `Descent.Blindness` records the statistics
for.

definitions.name: Descent.Coalescent.noCoalescenceProb
definitions.docstring:
The probability that `k` lineages have `k` distinct parents in one Wright-Fisher
generation.

Empirical status: DERIVED, not posited -- `noCoalescenceProb_eq_card_ratio` identifies it
as the uniform measure of the injectivity event under `parentAssignment`.

definitions.name: Descent.Coalescent.pairDistinct
definitions.body:
| 0 => 1
  | s + 1 => noCoalescenceProb N 2 * pairDistinct N s
definitions.docstring:
The probability that two sampled lineages still have distinct ancestors `s` generations
back.

Empirical status: MIXED.  The per-step factor is DERIVED (`noCoalescenceProb_two`, counted
off the mechanism); the RECURSION -- multiplying one step's factor by the previous total --
is the Wright-Fisher independence-between-generations assumption of K-G (2.2), and is the
one premise this file does not derive.  The head is `MIXED` because that is the closed-
vocabulary term for a definition whose parts carry different verdicts, and because a head
that opens with lower-case prose is a head no scanner can read: the two halves below are
the two verdicts the term promises.  K-G section 4 is the statement that the conclusion
survives replacing multinomial reproduction by any exchangeable family-size law with bounded moments
and variance `σ²`, at the cost of rescaling time by `σ⁻²`.

definitions.name: Descent.Coalescent.mergeIdem
definitions.signature: {n : ℕ} (ξ : ER n) (f : Quotient ξ → Quotient ξ) : ER n
definitions.body: Setoid.ker fun x ↦ f (Quotient.mk ξ x)
definitions.docstring:
**A simultaneous multiple merger.**  `f` sends each block to the block it ends up in;
the merger relates two sample points when their blocks share a destination.

Empirical status: NOT AN EMPIRICAL CLAIM.  It is the general form of an edge in the
coalescent's transition graph -- Kingman's binary merge, Pitman's `k`-merge and
Schweinsberg's simultaneous merge are the cases where `f` has one non-trivial fibre of size
two, one of size `k`, and several respectively.

definitions.name: Descent.Coalescent.MergerShape
definitions.docstring:
A merger shape: the sizes of the groups that merge simultaneously.  Blocks not in any
group are untouched and are left implicit.

definitions.name: Descent.Coalescent.IsShape
definitions.docstring:
A shape is legitimate when every group has at least two blocks: a "group" of one is not
a merger.

definitions.name: Descent.Coalescent.shapeDrop
definitions.docstring:
**The block count a shape costs.**  Each group of size `kᵢ` leaves one block behind, so
`kᵢ - 1` are lost; summing over groups gives the drop.

definitions.name: Descent.Coalescent.IsLambdaShape
definitions.docstring:
**A `Λ`-coalescent's shapes are the single-group ones.**  Pitman's family merges one
group at a time; Schweinsberg's merges several.  The distinction is a condition on shapes,
not a different definition.

definitions.name: Descent.Coalescent.IsKingmanShape
definitions.docstring:
**Kingman's shapes are the single-group shapes of size two.**  Which is K-C (1.3) said in
this language, and makes the nesting Kingman ⊂ `Λ` ⊂ `Ξ` a chain of conditions on one index
set.

definitions.name: Descent.Conditionals.balancedBinaryOppositePhaseLaw
definitions.body:
fun _ ↦ 1 / 2
  mass_nonneg := by intro; norm_num
  mass_sum := by
    rw [binaryOneSite_univ]
    norm_num
  phase := fun _ j ↦ if j = 0 then 0 else Real.pi
definitions.docstring: Balanced binary law with opposite phases `0` and `π`.

definitions.name: Descent.Conditionals.biasedBinaryOppositePhaseLaw
definitions.body:
fun x ↦ if x 0 = 0 then 3 / 4 else 1 / 4
  mass_nonneg := by
    intro x
    split_ifs <;> norm_num
  mass_sum := by
    rw [binaryOneSite_univ]
    norm_num
  phase := fun _ j ↦ if j = 0 then 0 else Real.pi
definitions.docstring: Biased binary law on the same support and with the same opposite phases.

definitions.name: Descent.Conditionals.copiedBinaryJointExpectation
definitions.docstring:
Joint expectation for two copied binary phase factors `Y,Y`, with `Y = ±1` equally
likely.  The product is identically one.

definitions.name: Descent.Conditionals.copiedBinaryConditionalProductExpectation
definitions.docstring:
The proposed product of conditional factors for the same model.  The first factor is
`E Y = 0`; the second is `Y`, so their product has expectation zero.

definitions.name: Descent.Conditionals.FiniteBoundedDeviation.witness
definitions.body:
fun ω ↦ if ω = 0 then 1 else 0
  weight_nonneg := fun ω ↦ by by_cases h : ω = 0 <;> simp [h]
  weight_sum := by simp
  deviation := fun _ ↦ 0
  radius := 0
  radius_nonneg := le_rfl
  bound := fun _ ↦ by simp
definitions.docstring: **The class is inhabited**: a point mass, zero deviation, zero radius.

definitions.name: Descent.Conditionals.FiniteBoundedDeviation.secondMoment
definitions.docstring: The second moment of the centered fluctuation.

definitions.name: Descent.Conditionals.FiberCoupling.FullSupport
definitions.docstring:
Every atom tuple remains possible.  This is a support condition, not an independence
condition and not a small-LD condition.

definitions.name: Descent.Conditionals.FiberCoupling.CoversTuple
definitions.signature: (family : Blindness.BundleFamily d) (fiber : Fin k → ℝ) (J : FiberCoupling k d) (value : Fin k → ℝ) : Prop
definitions.body:
∃ x : Fin k → Fin d, J.mass x ≠ 0 ∧
    ∀ i, family.modulus (x i) (fiber i) = value i
definitions.docstring:
A coupled fiber covers a tuple of modulus values when a charged atom tuple realizes
those values.

definitions.name: Descent.Conditionals.FiberCoupling.ProductCovers
definitions.signature: (family : Blindness.BundleFamily d) (fiber : Fin k → ℝ) (value : Fin k → ℝ) : Prop
definitions.body: ∃ x : Fin k → Fin d, ∀ i, family.modulus (x i) (fiber i) = value i
definitions.docstring: Coverage determined from the Cartesian product of the one-slot supports.

definitions.name: Descent.Conditionals.FiberCoupling.copyWitnessFamily
definitions.body:
fun j _ ↦ if j = 0 then 1 else 0
  atomMass := fun _ _ ↦ 1 / 2
definitions.docstring: The witness family: two atoms, values `1` and `0`, hence moduli `0` and `1`.

definitions.name: Descent.Conditionals.FiberCoupling.modulusCopyCoupling
definitions.body: fun x ↦ if x 0 = x 1 then 1 / 2 else 0
definitions.docstring:
**The modulus-copy coupling**: locus two copies locus one, so only the diagonal carries
    mass. This is perfect LD, and it is the `η = 0` boundary of the floor hypothesis.

definitions.name: Descent.Conditionals.FiberCoupling.copyWitnessValue
definitions.body: fun i ↦ if i = 0 then 0 else 1
definitions.docstring: The target cell: slot one at modulus `0`, slot two at modulus `1`.

definitions.name: Descent.Conditionals.FiberCoupling.gainBounded
definitions.docstring: Row one: bounded gain. The Pisot collapse lives here.

definitions.name: Descent.Conditionals.FiberCoupling.gainLog
definitions.docstring: Row two: logarithmic gain. The heavy-tail ghost and the equicorrelated copula live here.

definitions.name: Descent.Conditionals.FiberCoupling.gainPolynomialRow
definitions.docstring:
Row three: `n^β log n`, the long-range copula row.

    Named for the **power law in `n`**, not for statistical power: this is a conditional-gain
    rate and takes no significance threshold, because none enters it. The earlier name
    `gainPower` invited exactly that misreading.

definitions.name: Descent.Conditionals.FiberCoupling.gainLinear
definitions.docstring: Row four: linear gain, the fully fresh case.

definitions.name: Descent.Conditionals.FiniteCoupledPhaseLaw.toFiberCoupling
definitions.signature: {n d : ℕ} (C : FiniteCoupledPhaseLaw n d) : FiberCoupling n d where mass
definitions.docstring: Forget phases while retaining the coupling whose support controls coverage.

definitions.name: Descent.Conditionals.ObservationModel.witness
definitions.signature: : ObservationModel Unit Unit ℝ where action
definitions.ret_type: ObservationModel Unit Unit ℝ where action
definitions.body:
fun _ θ _ ↦ θ
  nuisance := {h | ∃ c : ℝ, h = fun _ _ ↦ c}
definitions.docstring:
**The observation model is inhabited**, at the smallest configuration that makes
identification a real question: one real parameter read by one probe, seen exactly, with the
constant functions as the declared nuisance class.

A theorem quantified over an uninhabited structure is true, kernel-checked, and empty.
The nuisance class is deliberately non-trivial -- an empty class would make every model
identifiable for the wrong reason, since there would be nothing to confound with.

definitions.name: Descent.Conditionals.observable
definitions.signature: (M : ObservationModel Context Probe Param) (θ : Context → Param) (h : Context → Probe → ℝ) : Context → Probe → ℝ
definitions.body: fun x p ↦ M.action x (θ x) p + h x p
definitions.docstring: What is actually observed, given a parameter field and a nuisance.

definitions.name: Descent.Conditionals.Identifiable
definitions.body:
∀ θ θ' h h', h ∈ M.nuisance → h' ∈ M.nuisance →
    observable M θ h = observable M θ' h' → θ = θ'
definitions.docstring:
**Identifiability**: no two distinct parameter fields are observationally equivalent under
    admissible nuisances.

definitions.name: Descent.Conditionals.actionGap
definitions.signature: (M : ObservationModel Context Probe Param) (θ θ' : Context → Param) : Context → Probe → ℝ
definitions.body: fun x p ↦ M.action x (θ x) p - M.action x (θ' x) p
definitions.docstring: The observable gap between two parameter fields.

definitions.name: Descent.Conditionals.DescendsAlong

definitions.docstring:

reproduces the value of `b` on every member's fiber conditional, at every label that member
charges.  This is the property a group-level report claims.

definitions.docstring: A genome carrying two loci and a binary trait: `(u, v, y)`.

(1 / 4) * (if g.2.2 = 1 then interactionRisk theta g.1 g.2.1

The joint law whose conditional trait risk is `interactionRisk`: the two loci are independent

definitions.name: Descent.Conditionals.traitIndicator

definitions.name: Descent.Conditionals.AdmissibleInteractionParameter
definitions.docstring:
The admissible biological interaction parameters: exactly those for which every conditional
risk, and therefore every joint mass, lies in the probability simplex.

definitions.name: Descent.Conditionals.admissibleInteractionTraitLaw
definitions.docstring: The interaction family restricted to its probability-law parameter space.

definitions.name: Descent.Conditionals.ExposureStratum

The within-stratum exposure law, whose exposure probability is
`confoundedConditionalRisk`.  It is the same in every population.

definitions.name: Descent.Conditionals.confoundedExposureLaw

definitions.name: Descent.Conditionals.AdmissiblePrevalence

definitions.name: Descent.Conditionals.admissibleConfoundedExposureLaw
definitions.docstring: The confounding family restricted to genuine prevalence parameters.

definitions.name: Descent.Conditionals.exposureIndicator
definitions.docstring: The exposure indicator, whose mean is the exposure frequency.

definitions.name: Descent.Conditionals.trivialLabel
definitions.docstring:
The trivial label: the meet of the exposure label and the stratum label.  Descent along it
says the crude exposure frequency is the same in every population.

descended trait mean minus the posterior-weighted average of the component trait means.
