    prevalenceLogit (cohort.predictedRisk individual)
  finiteCohortMean fun individual ↦
    (prevalenceLogit (cohort.predictedRisk individual) - mean) ^ 2
definitions.docstring: Empirical variance of the clipped-risk logits used by the executable calibration guard.

definitions.name: Descent.Portability.BinaryRiskCohort.logisticCalibrationObjective
definitions.signature: {Individual : Type*} [Fintype Individual] (cohort : BinaryRiskCohort Individual) (parameter : ℝ × ℝ) : ℝ
definitions.body:
∑ individual, cohort.calibrationIndividualLoss individual parameter
  + parameter.2 ^ 2 / (2 * binaryCalibrationC)
definitions.docstring:
Logistic calibration objective at intercept/slope `(a,b)`.  Scikit-learn's `lbfgs`
convention leaves the intercept unpenalized and, after multiplying its mean-loss objective by
cohort size, adds `b²/(2C)` to the summed Bernoulli loss.

definitions.name: Descent.Portability.BinaryRiskCohort.logisticCalibrationFit
definitions.signature: {Individual : Type*} [Fintype Individual] (cohort : BinaryRiskCohort Individual) (domain : cohort.LogisticCalibrationDomain) : ℝ × ℝ
definitions.docstring:
Exactly characterized ridge-logistic recalibration parameters: the unique objective
minimizer, not a covariance-ratio surrogate.  Floating-point stopping tolerance is numerical
evaluation error around this operator-defined target.

definitions.name: Descent.Portability.BinaryRiskCohort.calibrationSlope
definitions.signature: {Individual : Type*} [Fintype Individual] (cohort : BinaryRiskCohort Individual) (domain : cohort.LogisticCalibrationDomain) : ℝ
definitions.docstring: Pipeline calibration slope `b` from `y ~ a + b logit(p)`.

definitions.name: Descent.Portability.BinaryRiskCohort.citlEquation
definitions.signature: {Individual : Type*} [Fintype Individual] (cohort : BinaryRiskCohort Individual) (intercept : ℝ) : ℝ
definitions.body:
finiteCohortMean (fun individual ↦
    1 / (1 + Real.exp (-(intercept + prevalenceLogit (cohort.predictedRisk individual))))) -
      finiteCohortMean cohort.outcomeValue
definitions.docstring: Root equation used by gnomon's bounded Brent solve for calibration-in-the-large.

definitions.name: Descent.Portability.BinaryRiskCohort.calibrationInTheLarge
definitions.signature: {Individual : Type*} [Fintype Individual] (cohort : BinaryRiskCohort Individual) (domain : cohort.CITLDomain) : ℝ
definitions.docstring: Exact calibration-in-the-large: the intercept-only refit with `logit(p)` as an offset.

definitions.name: Descent.Portability.DemeBinaryRiskCohorts.atDeme
definitions.signature: {D : ℕ} {design : PipelineStudyDesign D} (cohorts : DemeBinaryRiskCohorts design) (deme : Fin D) : BinaryRiskCohort (Fin (design.cohortSize deme)) where outcome
definitions.body:
cohorts.outcome deme
  score := cohorts.score deme
  predictedRisk := cohorts.predictedRisk deme
  card_pos := by simpa using design.cohortSize_pos deme
  predictedRisk_pos := cohorts.predictedRisk_pos deme
  predictedRisk_lt_one := cohorts.predictedRisk_lt_one deme
definitions.docstring: One realized deme cohort.

definitions.name: Descent.Portability.DemeBinaryRiskCohorts.pooled
definitions.signature: {D : ℕ} {design : PipelineStudyDesign D} (cohorts : DemeBinaryRiskCohorts design) : BinaryRiskCohort (Σ deme, Fin (design.cohortSize deme)) where outcome
definitions.ret_type: BinaryRiskCohort (Σ deme, Fin (design.cohortSize deme)) where outcome
definitions.body:
fun individual ↦ cohorts.outcome individual.1 individual.2
  score := fun individual ↦ cohorts.score individual.1 individual.2
  predictedRisk := fun individual ↦ cohorts.predictedRisk individual.1 individual.2
  card_pos := cohorts.pooledCard_pos
  predictedRisk_pos := fun individual ↦ cohorts.predictedRisk_pos individual.1 individual.2
  predictedRisk_lt_one := fun individual ↦
    cohorts.predictedRisk_lt_one individual.1 individual.2
definitions.docstring: The pooled realized cohort is concatenation, not an average of deme metrics.

definitions.name: Descent.Portability.DemeBinaryRiskCohorts.evaluate
definitions.signature: {D : ℕ} {design : PipelineStudyDesign D} (cohorts : DemeBinaryRiskCohorts design) : PipelineQuantity D → Option ℝ
definitions.body:
by
  classical
  exact fun quantity ↦ match quantity with
  | .observedRiskR2 (some deme) =>
      if domain : (cohorts.atDeme deme).R2Domain then
        some ((cohorts.atDeme deme).observedRiskR2 domain) else none
  | .observedRiskR2 none =>
      if domain : cohorts.pooled.R2Domain then
        some (cohorts.pooled.observedRiskR2 domain) else none
  | .withinDemeAUC deme =>
      if domain : (cohorts.atDeme deme).AUCDomain then
        some ((cohorts.atDeme deme).auc domain) else none
  | .pooledAUC =>
      if domain : cohorts.pooled.AUCDomain then some (cohorts.pooled.auc domain) else none
  | .calibrationSlope (some deme) =>
      if domain : (cohorts.atDeme deme).LogisticCalibrationDomain then
        some ((cohorts.atDeme deme).calibrationSlope domain) else none
  | .calibrationSlope none =>
      if domain : cohorts.pooled.LogisticCalibrationDomain then
        some (cohorts.pooled.calibrationSlope domain) else none
  | .calibrationInTheLarge (some deme) =>
      if domain : (cohorts.atDeme deme).CITLDomain then
        some ((cohorts.atDeme deme).calibrationInTheLarge domain) else none
  | .calibrationInTheLarge none =>
      if domain : cohorts.pooled.CITLDomain then
        some (cohorts.pooled.calibrationInTheLarge domain) else none
  | .brierScore (some deme) => some (cohorts.atDeme deme).brier
  | .brierScore none => some cohorts.pooled.brier
  | .scoreVariance (some deme) => some (cohorts.atDeme deme).scoreVariance
  | .scoreVariance none => some cohorts.pooled.scoreVariance
  | _ => none
definitions.docstring:
Evaluate every requested discrimination/calibration coordinate on a realized set of
cohorts.  Each partial metric tests its own mathematical domain, so a degenerate finite draw
returns `none` rather than being excluded from the input type or assigned a numeric sentinel.
Pooled values are recomputed on the concatenated individuals.  Biological intermediates
return `none` because they are not empirical risk-cohort metrics.

definitions.name: Descent.Portability.DemeOutcomeConfiguration
definitions.docstring: A single binary outcome assignment on the concatenated visible cohort.

definitions.name: Descent.Portability.PipelineOutcomeConfiguration
definitions.docstring: A complete finite outcome includes an explicit genome/GWAS construction-failure branch.

definitions.name: Descent.Portability.DemeRiskPredictionPanel.outcomeWeight
definitions.signature: {D : ℕ} {design : PipelineStudyDesign D} (panel : DemeRiskPredictionPanel design) (outcome : DemeOutcomeConfiguration design) : ℝ
definitions.body:
∏ individual, if outcome individual then
    panel.outcomeProbability individual.1 individual.2
  else 1 - panel.outcomeProbability individual.1 individual.2
definitions.docstring: Exact product-Bernoulli probability of one finite outcome configuration.

definitions.name: Descent.Portability.DemeRiskPredictionPanel.outcomeLaw
definitions.signature: {D : ℕ} {design : PipelineStudyDesign D} (panel : DemeRiskPredictionPanel design) : FiniteReportLaw (DemeOutcomeConfiguration design) where mass
definitions.docstring: The normalized finite law of all binary outcomes at one realized prediction panel.

definitions.name: Descent.Portability.DemeRiskPredictionPanel.withOutcome
definitions.signature: {D : ℕ} {design : PipelineStudyDesign D} (panel : DemeRiskPredictionPanel design) (outcome : DemeOutcomeConfiguration design) : DemeBinaryRiskCohorts design where outcome
definitions.body:
fun deme individual ↦ outcome ⟨deme, individual⟩
  score := panel.score
  predictedRisk := panel.predictedRisk
  predictedRisk_pos := panel.predictedRisk_pos
  predictedRisk_lt_one := panel.predictedRisk_lt_one
  pooledCard_pos := by
    have hnonempty : Nonempty (Σ deme, Fin (design.cohortSize deme)) :=
      ⟨⟨design.gwasDeme, ⟨0, design.cohortSize_pos design.gwasDeme⟩⟩⟩
    exact Fintype.card_pos_iff.mpr hnonempty
definitions.docstring: Materialize the exact empirical evaluator input for one outcome configuration.

definitions.name: Descent.Portability.DemeRiskPredictionPanel.metricDefinedMass
definitions.signature: {D : ℕ} {design : PipelineStudyDesign D} (panel : DemeRiskPredictionPanel design) (coordinate : PipelineQuantity D) : ℝ
definitions.body:
∑ outcome : DemeOutcomeConfiguration design,
    if ((panel.withOutcome outcome).evaluate coordinate).isSome then
      panel.outcomeWeight outcome else 0
definitions.docstring:
Exact probability that the finite pipeline defines a requested coordinate.  For AUC,
`R²`, and calibration this sum automatically strengthens or weakens with cohort size because
the defining case/control and nonconstant-score events are evaluated on every configuration.

definitions.name: Descent.Portability.DemeRiskPredictionPanel.weightedMetric
definitions.signature: {D : ℕ} {design : PipelineStudyDesign D} (panel : DemeRiskPredictionPanel design) (coordinate : PipelineQuantity D) : ℝ
definitions.body:
∑ outcome : DemeOutcomeConfiguration design,
    panel.outcomeWeight outcome *
      ((panel.withOutcome outcome).evaluate coordinate).getD 0
definitions.docstring: Exact unnormalized first moment of a requested finite-cohort metric.

definitions.name: Descent.Portability.RealizedPTGWASDraw.toRiskPredictionPanel
definitions.signature: {D : ℕ} {input : VisiblePipelineInput D} (draw : RealizedPTGWASDraw input) (phenotypeBaseline : PhenotypeBaseline input) (predictedRisk : ∀ deme, Fin (input.studyDesign.cohortSize deme) → ℝ) (predictedRisk_pos : ∀ deme individual, 0 < predictedRisk deme individual) (predictedRisk_lt_one : ∀ deme individual, predictedRisk deme individual < 1) : DemeRiskPredictionPanel input.studyDesign where score
definitions.body:
draw.winningScoreValue
  predictedRisk := predictedRisk
  predictedRisk_pos := predictedRisk_pos
  predictedRisk_lt_one := predictedRisk_lt_one
  outcomeProbability := (draw.phenotypeLiabilityPanel phenotypeBaseline).risk
  outcomeProbability_nonneg := fun deme individual ↦
    ((draw.phenotypeLiabilityPanel phenotypeBaseline).risk_mem_unitInterval
      deme individual).1.le
  outcomeProbability_le_one := fun deme individual ↦
    ((draw.phenotypeLiabilityPanel phenotypeBaseline).risk_mem_unitInterval
      deme individual).2.le
definitions.docstring:
Build the pre-outcome panel from one selected-score draw, an explicit phenotype-baseline
rule, and a prediction rule on that same visible cohort.  The true Bernoulli risks use the
total-liability panel and its derived global prevalence root; neither phenotype choice nor
recalibration is silently defaulted by the metric layer.

definitions.name: Descent.Portability.PredictionPipelineKernel.panelAt
definitions.signature: {Sample : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Sample] {D : ℕ} (kernel : PredictionPipelineKernel Sample D) (input : VisiblePipelineInput D) (sample : Sample) : Option (DemeRiskPredictionPanel input.studyDesign)
definitions.body:
(kernel.scoreKernel.realizedAt input sample).map fun draw ↦
    draw.toRiskPredictionPanel
      (draw.phenotypeBaselineForRung kernel.phenotypeRung
        (kernel.affineBaselineAt input sample) (kernel.randomBaselineAt input sample))
      (kernel.predictedRiskAt input sample)
      (kernel.predictedRisk_pos input sample)
      (kernel.predictedRisk_lt_one input sample)
definitions.docstring: The exact pre-outcome panel induced by one non-outcome pipeline draw.

definitions.name: Descent.Portability.PredictionPipelineKernel.outcomeLawAt
definitions.signature: {Sample : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Sample] {D : ℕ} (kernel : PredictionPipelineKernel Sample D) (input : VisiblePipelineInput D) (sample : Sample) : FiniteReportLaw (PipelineOutcomeConfiguration input.studyDesign)
definitions.body:
match kernel.panelAt input sample with
  | none => FiniteReportLaw.pointMass none
  | some panel => panel.outcomeLaw.pushforward some
definitions.docstring:
The actual conditional finite outcome law. Failed constructions concentrate on `none`;
successful constructions retain every Bernoulli configuration with its derived probability.

definitions.name: Descent.Portability.PredictionPipelineKernel.outcomeMetricAt
definitions.signature: {Sample : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Sample] {D : ℕ} (kernel : PredictionPipelineKernel Sample D) (input : VisiblePipelineInput D) (sample : Sample) (outcome : PipelineOutcomeConfiguration input.studyDesign) (coordinate : PipelineQuantity D) : Option ℝ
definitions.body:
match kernel.panelAt input sample, outcome with
  | some panel, some configuration => (panel.withOutcome configuration).evaluate coordinate
  | _, _ => none
definitions.docstring:
Evaluate the actual finite outcome. Both construction failure and metric undefinedness
remain `none`, while successful outcomes use the existing empirical cohort evaluator.

definitions.name: Descent.Portability.PredictionPipelineKernel.metricDefinedMassAt
definitions.signature: {Sample : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Sample] {D : ℕ} (kernel : PredictionPipelineKernel Sample D) (input : VisiblePipelineInput D) (sample : Sample) (coordinate : PipelineQuantity D) : ℝ
definitions.body:
match kernel.panelAt input sample with
  | none => 0
  | some panel => panel.metricDefinedMass coordinate
definitions.docstring:
Probability of a defined metric after outcomes are marginalized at one upstream draw.
A failed genome/GWAS construction has zero definedness mass. This probability is retained
through the outer integral; having any possible defined outcome does not give it unit mass.

definitions.name: Descent.Portability.PredictionPipelineKernel.weightedMetricAt
definitions.signature: {Sample : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Sample] {D : ℕ} (kernel : PredictionPipelineKernel Sample D) (input : VisiblePipelineInput D) (sample : Sample) (coordinate : PipelineQuantity D) : ℝ
definitions.body:
match kernel.panelAt input sample with
  | none => 0
  | some panel => panel.weightedMetric coordinate
definitions.docstring:
Unnormalized metric numerator at one upstream draw. A failed construction contributes
zero numerator and zero definedness mass, so it is excluded from the final conditional mean.

definitions.name: Descent.Portability.FinitePipelineKernel.outcomeKernel
definitions.signature: {Sample : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Sample] {D : ℕ} (kernel : FinitePipelineKernel Sample D) (input : VisiblePipelineInput D) : PartialMetricMixture.FiniteOutcomeKernel Sample (PipelineOutcomeConfiguration input.studyDesign) where weight
definitions.body:
fun sample ↦ (kernel.predictionKernel.outcomeLawAt input sample).mass
  weight_nonneg := fun sample ↦ (kernel.predictionKernel.outcomeLawAt input sample).mass_nonneg
  weight_sum_one := fun sample ↦ (kernel.predictionKernel.outcomeLawAt input sample).mass_sum
  weight_measurable := kernel.outcomeWeight_measurable input
definitions.docstring:
A measurable conditional kernel built from the actual outcome law, not an assumed joint

definitions.name: Descent.Portability.DemographicEvent.updateActive
definitions.signature: {demeCount : ℕ} (event : DemographicEvent demeCount) (active : Fin demeCount → Bool) : Fin demeCount → Bool
definitions.body:

  | .split _ _ _ child _ => fun deme ↦ if deme = child then true else active deme
  | _ => active
definitions.docstring: A split activates its child; all other events leave the active set unchanged.

definitions.name: Descent.Portability.demographicEventsWellFormed
definitions.signature: {demeCount : ℕ} : List (DemographicEvent demeCount) → (Fin demeCount → Bool) → Prop
definitions.body:
| [], _ => True
  | event :: remaining, active =>
      match event with
      | .split _ _ parent child _ =>
          active parent = true ∧ active child = false ∧
            demographicEventsWellFormed remaining (event.updateActive active)
      | _ => demographicEventsWellFormed remaining active
definitions.docstring:
Split chronology is valid when every parent is already active and every child is activated
exactly once.  This rules out ghost migration through future deme labels.

equations.rhs: active parent = true ∧ active child = false ∧ demographicEventsWellFormed remaining (event.updateActive active)

definitions.name: Descent.Portability.symmetricBetaMoment
definitions.body:
| 0 => 1
  | degree + 1 =>
      symmetricBetaMoment shape degree *
        (shape + degree) / (2 * shape + degree)
definitions.docstring:
Raw moments of the symmetric-beta stationary frequency law.  For positive shape this is
`Beta(shape, shape)`; at zero mutation the recursion selects the ancestral-allele boundary
mass at frequency zero.

equations.rhs: symmetricBetaMoment shape degree * (shape + degree) / (2 * shape + degree)

definitions.name: Descent.Portability.realRisingFactorial
definitions.docstring:
Real rising factorial `(shape)ₙ`, written as a finite product so its positivity and
recurrences are available without a Gamma-function continuation.

definitions.name: Descent.Portability.symmetricBetaBernsteinMoment
definitions.body:
| 0 => symmetricBetaMoment shape derived
  | ancestral + 1 =>
      symmetricBetaBernsteinMoment shape derived ancestral -
        symmetricBetaBernsteinMoment shape (derived + 1) ancestral
definitions.docstring:
One-dimensional Bernstein moment induced by the stationary moment recurrence.  The
ancestral exponent recursion is the polynomial identity
`x^d(1-x)^(a+1) = x^d(1-x)^a - x^(d+1)(1-x)^a`.

equations.rhs: symmetricBetaBernsteinMoment shape derived ancestral - symmetricBetaBernsteinMoment shape (derived + 1) ancestral

definitions.name: Descent.Portability.symmetricBetaBernsteinClosedForm
definitions.body:
realRisingFactorial shape derived * realRisingFactorial shape ancestral /
    realRisingFactorial (2 * shape) (derived + ancestral)
definitions.docstring: Closed positive quotient for a stationary beta Bernstein moment.

definitions.name: Descent.Portability.PipelineDemographicHistory.ancestralMutationShape
definitions.docstring:
The stationary symmetric-beta shape derived from raw diploid population size and the
per-generation bidirectional mutation rate: `2 u / (1 / (2 Nₑ)) = 4 Nₑ u`.

Empirical status: DERIVED -- the standard scaled mutation parameter read off the history's
own root size and rate; nothing is fitted.  Whether the ancestral population sat at the
symmetric-beta stationary law is the boundary assumption named at `ancestralLDRates`.

definitions.name: Descent.Portability.PipelineDemographicHistory.ancestralMoment
definitions.docstring:
The ancestral one-locus moments are derived from the history's own root size and mutation
rate; they are not an additional caller-supplied completion.

Empirical status: DERIVED -- symmetric-beta moments by the exact recurrence, with
`ancestralMoment_zero` and `ancestralMoment_succ` proved beside the definition; no moment
table is supplied from outside and no measurement bears on the recurrence itself.

definitions.body:
history.initialEffectiveSize
  effectiveSize_pos := history.initialEffectiveSize_pos
  migration := history.initialMigration
  migration_nonneg := history.initialMigration_nonneg
  migration_self := history.initialMigration_self
  mutationRate := history.initialMutationRate
  mutationRate_nonneg := history.initialMutationRate_nonneg
  recombinationRate := history.initialRecombinationRate
  recombinationRate_nonneg := history.initialRecombinationRate_nonneg
definitions.docstring: Initial certified rate state of a visible history.

definitions.name: Descent.Portability.PipelineRateState.toManyDemeRates
definitions.signature: {demeCount : ℕ} (state : PipelineRateState demeCount) (active : Fin demeCount → Bool) : Coalescent.ManyDemeRates demeCount where coalescence
definitions.body:
fun deme ↦ 1 / (2 * state.effectiveSize deme)
  migration := fun source target ↦
    if active source && active target then state.migration source target else 0
  forwardMutation := fun _ ↦ state.mutationRate
  backwardMutation := fun _ ↦ state.mutationRate
  coalescence_pos := fun deme ↦
    one_div_pos.mpr (mul_pos (by norm_num) (state.effectiveSize_pos deme))
  migration_nonneg := by
    intro source target
    split <;> simp_all [state.migration_nonneg]
  migration_self := by
    intro deme
    simp [state.migration_self]
  forwardMutation_nonneg := fun _ ↦ state.mutationRate_nonneg
  backwardMutation_nonneg := fun _ ↦ state.mutationRate_nonneg
definitions.docstring:
Raw-generation symmetric biallelic diffusion rates.  The coalescence coefficient is
`1/(2Nₑ)`; forward and backward mutation both use the history's declared mutation rate.

definitions.name: Descent.Portability.PipelineRateState.toManyDemeLDRates
definitions.signature: {demeCount : ℕ} (state : PipelineRateState demeCount) (separationBp : ℝ) (separationBp_nonneg : 0 ≤ separationBp) (active : Fin demeCount → Bool) : Coalescent.ManyDemeLDRates demeCount where coalescence
definitions.body:
fun deme ↦ 1 / (2 * state.effectiveSize deme)
  migration := fun source target ↦
    if active source && active target then state.migration source target else 0
  mutation := fun _ ↦ 2 * state.mutationRate
  recombination := fun _ ↦ 2 * state.recombinationRate * separationBp
  coalescence_pos := fun deme ↦
    one_div_pos.mpr (mul_pos two_pos (state.effectiveSize_pos deme))
  migration_nonneg := by
    intro source target
    split <;> simp_all [state.migration_nonneg]
  migration_self := fun deme ↦ by simp [state.migration_self]
  mutation_nonneg := fun _ ↦ mul_nonneg (by norm_num) state.mutationRate_nonneg
  recombination_nonneg := fun _ ↦
    mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) state.recombinationRate_nonneg) separationBp_nonneg
definitions.docstring:
Raw-generation rates for the closed `H/DD/Dz/pi2` operator at a physical separation.
The scaled recombination coordinate is `2 r distance`, because a within-deme `DD = E[D²]`
contains two `D` factors; mutation similarly enters the heterozygosity equation as `2 mu`.

Empirical status: DERIVED -- a unit conversion from raw per-generation parameters into the
generator's rate carrier, with the two factors of two argued above from the shape of the
moment equations rather than fitted; the generator the rates feed carries its own status in
`Coalescent.TwoLocusHistory`.

definitions.name: Descent.Portability.PipelineRateState.pairDivergenceGenerator
definitions.signature: {demeCount : ℕ} (state : PipelineRateState demeCount) (active : Fin demeCount → Bool) : Matrix (Coalescent.AffinePairDivergenceCoordinate demeCount) (Coalescent.AffinePairDivergenceCoordinate demeCount) ℝ
definitions.body:
let rates := state.toManyDemeRates active
  Coalescent.augmentedPairDivergenceGenerator rates.coalescence rates.migration
    (fun deme ↦ rates.forwardMutation deme + rates.backwardMutation deme)
definitions.docstring: The common affine pair-divergence generator exposed by both demographic compilers.

definitions.name: Descent.Portability.CommonDiffusionState.evolve
definitions.signature: {demeCount : ℕ} (common : CommonDiffusionState demeCount) (rates : PipelineRateState demeCount) (active : Fin demeCount → Bool) (separationBp : ℝ) (separationBp_nonneg : 0 ≤ separationBp) (duration : ℝ) (duration_nonneg : 0 ≤ duration) : CommonDiffusionState demeCount
definitions.body:
let marginalEpoch : Coalescent.ManyDemeMomentEpoch demeCount 2 :=
    { rates := rates.toManyDemeRates active
      duration := duration
      duration_nonneg := duration_nonneg }
  let jointEpoch := (rates.toManyDemeLDRates separationBp separationBp_nonneg active).epoch
    duration duration_nonneg
  { marginal := marginalEpoch.propagator.mulVec common.marginal
    joint := jointEpoch.propagator.mulVec common.joint
    projection_eq := by
      dsimp only [jointEpoch, Coalescent.LowOrderLDEpoch.propagator,
        Coalescent.ManyDemeLDRates.epoch]
      rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec,
        Coalescent.manyDemePairDivergenceProjection_propagator_intertwines marginalEpoch
          (fun _ ↦ rfl),
        Coalescent.lowOrderLDHProjection_propagator_intertwines
          (rates.toManyDemeLDRates separationBp separationBp_nonneg active) duration,
        rates.oneLocus_pairDivergenceGenerator_eq active,
        rates.twoLocus_pairDivergenceGenerator_eq active separationBp separationBp_nonneg,
        ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, common.projection_eq]
    marginal_constant := by
      rw [marginalEpoch.propagator_none, common.marginal_constant]
    marginal_zeroCoordinate := by
      rw [marginalEpoch.propagator_zeroCoordinate, common.marginal_zeroCoordinate]
    joint_constant := by
      rw [jointEpoch.propagator_none, common.joint_constant] }
definitions.docstring:
Evolve both sides of a common-diffusion state through one visible epoch.  The proof field
uses the two matrix-exponential intertwining theorems and the rate compiler's exact generator
identity, so no step-size or closure approximation enters.

definitions.name: Descent.Portability.CommonDiffusionState.split
definitions.signature: {demeCount : ℕ} (common : CommonDiffusionState demeCount) (parent child : Fin demeCount) (parent_ne_child : parent ≠ child) : CommonDiffusionState demeCount
definitions.body:
{ marginal := Coalescent.splitManyDemeMomentState parent child common.marginal
    joint := (Coalescent.lowOrderLDSplitTransform parent child).mulVec common.joint
    projection_eq := by
      rw [Coalescent.manyDemePairDivergenceProjection_split parent child parent_ne_child
          common.marginal (by
            simpa [Coalescent.manyDemeMomentVectorTable] using
              common.marginal_zeroCoordinate),
        Coalescent.lowOrderLDHProjection_split parent child common.joint common.joint_constant,
        common.projection_eq]
    marginal_constant := by
      rw [Coalescent.splitManyDemeMomentState_none, common.marginal_constant]
    marginal_zeroCoordinate := by
      rw [Coalescent.splitManyDemeMomentState_zeroCoordinate,
        common.marginal_zeroCoordinate]
    joint_constant := by
      rw [Coalescent.lowOrderLDSplitTransform_none, common.joint_constant] }
definitions.docstring:
Apply one valid split to both sides of a common-diffusion state.  Exact relabeling commutes
with both projections, while the reachability fields discharge the affine/padding side
conditions that a raw rectangular vector need not satisfy.

definitions.name: Descent.Portability.DemographicEvent.updateRateState
definitions.signature: {demeCount : ℕ} (event : DemographicEvent demeCount) (state : PipelineRateState demeCount) : PipelineRateState demeCount
definitions.body:
match event with
  | .split _ _ _ _ _ => state
  | .sizeChange _ _ effectiveSize effectiveSize_pos =>
      { state with effectiveSize := effectiveSize, effectiveSize_pos := effectiveSize_pos }
  | .migrationChange _ _ migration migration_nonneg migration_self =>
      { effectiveSize := state.effectiveSize
        effectiveSize_pos := state.effectiveSize_pos
        migration := migration
        migration_nonneg := migration_nonneg
        migration_self := migration_self
        mutationRate := state.mutationRate
        mutationRate_nonneg := state.mutationRate_nonneg
        recombinationRate := state.recombinationRate
        recombinationRate_nonneg := state.recombinationRate_nonneg }
  | .mutationRateChange _ _ mutationRate mutationRate_nonneg =>
      { state with
        mutationRate := mutationRate
        mutationRate_nonneg := mutationRate_nonneg }
  | .recombinationRateChange _ _ recombinationRate recombinationRate_nonneg =>
      { state with
        recombinationRate := recombinationRate
        recombinationRate_nonneg := recombinationRate_nonneg }
definitions.docstring:
Apply the parameter update carried by an event.  A split changes the moment state, not
the rate state; its instantaneous transform is emitted separately by the compiler below.

definitions.name: Descent.Portability.compileMomentEvents
definitions.signature: {demeCount : ℕ} (K : ℕ) : List (DemographicEvent demeCount) → PipelineRateState demeCount → (Fin demeCount → Bool) → CompiledMomentEvents demeCount K | [], state, active => { instructions := [], finalRateState := state, finalActive := active } | event :: remaining, state, active => let epoch : Coalescent.ManyDemeMomentEpoch demeCount K
definitions.ret_type: List (DemographicEvent demeCount) → PipelineRateState demeCount → (Fin demeCount → Bool) → CompiledMomentEvents demeCount K | [], state, active => { instructions := [], finalRateState := state, finalActive := active } | event :: remaining, state, active => let epoch : Coalescent.ManyDemeMomentEpoch demeCount K
definitions.docstring:
Compile the ordered event sequence into exact moment propagation.  Each event first evolves
under the preceding rates for its elapsed interval, then applies its instantaneous split (if
any), and finally updates the rates used by the next interval.

definitions.name: Descent.Portability.compileBiologicalMomentEvents
definitions.signature: {demeCount : ℕ} (K : ℕ) : List (DemographicEvent demeCount) → PipelineRateState demeCount → (Fin demeCount → Bool) → CompiledBiologicalMomentEvents demeCount K | [], state, active => { instructions := [], finalRateState := state, finalActive := active } | event :: remaining, state, active => let rates
definitions.ret_type: List (DemographicEvent demeCount) → PipelineRateState demeCount → (Fin demeCount → Bool) → CompiledBiologicalMomentEvents demeCount K | [], state, active => { instructions := [], finalRateState := state, finalActive := active } | event :: remaining, state, active => let rates
definitions.body:
state.toManyDemeRates active
      let evolve : Coalescent.BiologicalManyDemeInstruction demeCount K :=
        .evolve rates event.elapsed event.elapsed_nonneg (fun _ ↦ rfl)
      let front : List (Coalescent.BiologicalManyDemeInstruction demeCount K) :=
        match event with
        | .split _ _ parent child distinct => [.evolve rates event.elapsed
            event.elapsed_nonneg (fun _ ↦ rfl), .split parent child distinct]
        | _ => [evolve]
      let tail := compileBiologicalMomentEvents K remaining
        (event.updateRateState state) (event.updateActive active)
      { instructions := front ++ tail.instructions
        finalRateState := tail.finalRateState
        finalActive := tail.finalActive }
definitions.docstring:
Compile an arbitrary visible history directly into the exact compact positive-dual
language.  Symmetric mutation and distinct split labels are carried as proofs in every
instruction, so the history-wide intertwining theorem applies without an external premise.

definitions.name: Descent.Portability.compileLowOrderLDEvents
definitions.signature: {demeCount : ℕ} (separationBp : ℝ) (separationBp_nonneg : 0 ≤ separationBp) : List (DemographicEvent demeCount) → PipelineRateState demeCount → (Fin demeCount → Bool) → CompiledLowOrderLDEvents demeCount | [], state, active => { instructions := [], finalRateState := state, finalActive := active } | event :: remaining, state, active => let epoch
definitions.ret_type: List (DemographicEvent demeCount) → PipelineRateState demeCount → (Fin demeCount → Bool) → CompiledLowOrderLDEvents demeCount | [], state, active => { instructions := [], finalRateState := state, finalActive := active } | event :: remaining, state, active => let epoch
definitions.body:
(state.toManyDemeLDRates separationBp separationBp_nonneg active).epoch
        event.elapsed event.elapsed_nonneg
      let front : List (Coalescent.LowOrderLDInstruction demeCount) :=
        match event with
        | .split _ _ parent child _ =>
            [.evolve epoch, Coalescent.LowOrderLDInstruction.split parent child]
        | _ => [.evolve epoch]
      let tail := compileLowOrderLDEvents separationBp separationBp_nonneg remaining
        (event.updateRateState state) (event.updateActive active)
      { instructions := front ++ tail.instructions
        finalRateState := tail.finalRateState
        finalActive := tail.finalActive }
definitions.docstring:
Compile the same ordered history into the derived arbitrary-deme two-locus
generator.  Unlike a scalar distance recurrence, every epoch propagates the complete closed
moment state and every split applies the exact label pullback.

Empirical status: DERIVED -- a structural recursion turning the visible event list into
epoch and split instructions; it invents no rates and drops no event, and the composed
prediction it feeds is the untested composite named in `Coalescent.TwoLocusHistory`'s
module status.

definitions.name: Descent.Portability.runCommonDiffusionEvents
definitions.signature: {demeCount : ℕ} (separationBp : ℝ) (separationBp_nonneg : 0 ≤ separationBp) : List (DemographicEvent demeCount) → PipelineRateState demeCount → (Fin demeCount → Bool) → CommonDiffusionState demeCount → CommonDiffusionEventRun demeCount | [], rates, active, common => { state := common, finalRateState := rates, finalActive := active } | event :: remaining, rates, active, common => let evolved
definitions.ret_type: List (DemographicEvent demeCount) → PipelineRateState demeCount → (Fin demeCount → Bool) → CommonDiffusionState demeCount → CommonDiffusionEventRun demeCount | [], rates, active, common => { state := common, finalRateState := rates, finalActive := active } | event :: remaining, rates, active, common => let evolved
definitions.body:
common.evolve rates active separationBp separationBp_nonneg
        event.elapsed event.elapsed_nonneg
      let afterEvent := match event with
        | .split _ _ parent child parent_ne_child =>
            evolved.split parent child parent_ne_child
        | _ => evolved
      runCommonDiffusionEvents separationBp separationBp_nonneg remaining
        (event.updateRateState rates) (event.updateActive active) afterEvent
definitions.docstring:
Direct synchronized execution of an arbitrary finite event list.  Each event evolves both
states under the preceding rates, applies the exact split pullback when present, and then
updates the rate/active carriers for the recursive suffix.

definitions.name: Descent.Portability.PipelineDemographicHistory.oneLocusMomentInstructions
definitions.signature: {demeCount : ℕ} (history : PipelineDemographicHistory demeCount) (K : ℕ) : List (Coalescent.ManyDemeMomentInstruction demeCount K)
definitions.body:
let compiled := compileMomentEvents K history.events history.initialRateState
    (initialDemeActive history.events)
  let finalEpoch : Coalescent.ManyDemeMomentEpoch demeCount K :=
    { rates := compiled.finalRateState.toManyDemeRates compiled.finalActive
      duration := history.finalElapsed
      duration_nonneg := history.finalElapsed_nonneg }
  compiled.instructions ++ [.evolve finalEpoch]
definitions.docstring:
Exact one-locus moment instructions for the whole visible event history.  Recombination
updates are retained in the rate state for the two-locus compiler; they correctly have no
effect on this one-locus generator.

definitions.name: Descent.Portability.PipelineDemographicHistory.biologicalMomentInstructions
definitions.signature: {demeCount : ℕ} (history : PipelineDemographicHistory demeCount) (K : ℕ) : List (Coalescent.BiologicalManyDemeInstruction demeCount K)
definitions.body:
let compiled := compileBiologicalMomentEvents K history.events history.initialRateState
    (initialDemeActive history.events)
  let rates := compiled.finalRateState.toManyDemeRates compiled.finalActive
  compiled.instructions ++ [.evolve rates history.finalElapsed history.finalElapsed_nonneg
    (fun _ ↦ rfl)]
definitions.docstring:
Exact compact instructions for the whole visible history.  This is the same event/rate
compilation as `oneLocusMomentInstructions`, but its carrier has no rectangular padding and
each epoch is paired with the positive killed dual proved in `StructuredPresentDay`.

definitions.name: Descent.Portability.PipelineDemographicHistory.biologicalAncestralMomentState
definitions.signature: {demeCount : ℕ} (history : PipelineDemographicHistory demeCount) (K : ℕ) : Coalescent.BiologicalManyDemeMomentCoordinate demeCount K → ℝ
definitions.docstring: Common-ancestor moment state on the compact biological carrier.

definitions.name: Descent.Portability.PipelineDemographicHistory.presentBiologicalMomentState
definitions.signature: {demeCount : ℕ} (history : PipelineDemographicHistory demeCount) (K : ℕ) : Coalescent.BiologicalManyDemeMomentCoordinate demeCount K → ℝ
definitions.docstring: Exact present compact moment state for the complete visible history.

definitions.name: Descent.Portability.PipelineDemographicHistory.presentBiologicalKilledDualState
definitions.signature: {demeCount : ℕ} (history : PipelineDemographicHistory demeCount) (K : ℕ) : Coalescent.BiologicalManyDemeKilledDualCoordinate demeCount K → ℝ
definitions.docstring:
Exact positive Bernstein state after the complete visible history, obtained entirely on
the compact killed-dual carrier.

definitions.name: Descent.Portability.PipelineDemographicHistory.ancestralLDRates
definitions.signature: {demeCount : ℕ} (history : PipelineDemographicHistory demeCount) (separationBp : ℝ) (separationBp_nonneg : 0 ≤ separationBp) : Coalescent.ManyDemeLDRates 1 where coalescence
definitions.body:
fun _ ↦ 1 / (2 * history.initialEffectiveSize history.ancestralDeme)
  migration := fun _ _ ↦ 0
  mutation := fun _ ↦ 2 * history.initialMutationRate
  recombination := fun _ ↦ 2 * history.initialRecombinationRate * separationBp
  coalescence_pos := fun _ ↦ one_div_pos.mpr
    (mul_pos (by norm_num) (history.initialEffectiveSize_pos history.ancestralDeme))
  migration_nonneg := fun _ _ ↦ le_rfl
  migration_self := fun _ ↦ rfl
  mutation_nonneg := fun _ ↦ mul_nonneg (by norm_num) history.initialMutationRate_nonneg
  recombination_nonneg := fun _ ↦
    mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) history.initialRecombinationRate_nonneg)
      separationBp_nonneg
definitions.docstring:
Constant ancestral one-deme rates implied by the visible history.  The ancestral
population is assumed to have occupied its initial epoch long enough to reach the stationary
low-order law; this is the same equilibrium boundary condition used by coalescent genome
simulation rather than an extra fitted moment table.

Empirical status: DERIVED, with one named assumption -- the rates are the root epoch's own
parameters in generator units, and the stationarity of the ancestral boundary is an
assumption this docstring states rather than hides; it is the boundary condition coalescent
simulators impose, so a battery comparing the composed pipeline against `msprime` shares it
rather than testing it.

definitions.name: Descent.Portability.PipelineDemographicHistory.initialCommonDiffusionState
definitions.signature: {demeCount : ℕ} (history : PipelineDemographicHistory demeCount) (separationBp : ℝ) (separationBp_nonneg : 0 ≤ separationBp) : CommonDiffusionState demeCount
definitions.body:
{ marginal := Coalescent.commonAncestorManyDemeMomentState history.ancestralMoment
    joint := Coalescent.commonAncestralLowOrderLDState
      (history.ancestralLDRates separationBp separationBp_nonneg)
    projection_eq := by
      rw [Coalescent.manyDemePairDivergenceProjection_commonAncestor,
        Coalescent.lowOrderLDHProjection_commonAncestral]
      funext coordinate
      cases coordinate with
      | none => rfl
      | some pair =>
          exact history.ancestralHeterozygosity_eq_lowOrderH separationBp
            separationBp_nonneg
    marginal_constant := rfl
    marginal_zeroCoordinate := by
      simp [Coalescent.commonAncestorManyDemeMomentState,
        Coalescent.ManyDemeMomentCoordinate.degree]
    joint_constant := rfl }
definitions.docstring:
The two concrete compilers begin in one common projected state.  This packages the
symmetric-beta/recurrent-two-locus boundary identity together with the affine reachability
invariants required by every later split.

definitions.name: Descent.Portability.PipelineDemographicHistory.presentCommonDiffusionState
definitions.signature: {demeCount : ℕ} (history : PipelineDemographicHistory demeCount) (separationBp : ℝ) (separationBp_nonneg : 0 ≤ separationBp) : CommonDiffusionState demeCount
definitions.body:
let run := runCommonDiffusionEvents separationBp separationBp_nonneg history.events
    history.initialRateState (initialDemeActive history.events)
    (history.initialCommonDiffusionState separationBp separationBp_nonneg)
  run.state.evolve run.finalRateState run.finalActive separationBp separationBp_nonneg
    history.finalElapsed history.finalElapsed_nonneg
definitions.docstring: Synchronized present-day state after the complete event list and terminal epoch.

definitions.name: Descent.Portability.PipelineDemographicHistory.lowOrderLDHistory
definitions.signature: {demeCount : ℕ} (history : PipelineDemographicHistory demeCount) (separationBp : ℝ) (separationBp_nonneg : 0 ≤ separationBp) : Coalescent.LowOrderLDHistory demeCount
definitions.body:
let compiled := compileLowOrderLDEvents separationBp separationBp_nonneg history.events
    history.initialRateState (initialDemeActive history.events)
  let finalEpoch := (compiled.finalRateState.toManyDemeLDRates
    separationBp separationBp_nonneg compiled.finalActive).epoch
      history.finalElapsed history.finalElapsed_nonneg
  { initial := Coalescent.commonAncestralLowOrderLDState
      (history.ancestralLDRates separationBp separationBp_nonneg)
    initial_constant := rfl
    instructions := compiled.instructions ++ [.evolve finalEpoch] }
definitions.docstring:
Complete concrete two-locus history at one physical marker separation.

Empirical status: DERIVED -- the ancestral boundary, the compiled instruction list, and the
final epoch assembled into one `Coalescent.LowOrderLDHistory`; each part carries its own
status and this composition adds no new quantity.  The composed present-day prediction is
the untested composite named in `Coalescent.TwoLocusHistory`'s module status.

definitions.name: Descent.Portability.PipelineDemographicHistory.twoLocusMoments
definitions.docstring:
The arbitrary-deme, arbitrary-event two-locus moment family constructed from the visible
demographic history.  This is the concrete missing bridge from history to `DD/Dz/pi2`; marker
separation is typed nonnegative and all rate changes are compiled into the epoch product.

definitions.name: Descent.Portability.PipelineDemographicHistory.presentMomentState
definitions.signature: {demeCount : ℕ} (history : PipelineDemographicHistory demeCount) (K : ℕ) : Coalescent.AffineManyDemeMomentCoordinate demeCount K → ℝ
definitions.docstring: Complete present-day finite one-locus moment state at a requested truncation degree.

definitions.name: Descent.Portability.PipelineDemographicHistory.oneLocusMoment
definitions.signature: {demeCount : ℕ} (history : PipelineDemographicHistory demeCount) (K : ℕ) (exponent : Fin demeCount → ℕ) : ℝ
definitions.body:
if ∀ deme, exponent deme = 0 then 1
  else
    Coalescent.manyDemeMomentVectorTable K
      (fun coordinate ↦ history.presentMomentState K (some coordinate)) exponent
definitions.docstring:
Exact present-day mixed one-locus moment produced by the visible event history.  The
matrix dimension is finite for every requested degree, and every epoch is a matrix
exponential; no closure or fitted attenuation enters.

definitions.name: Descent.Portability.PipelineDemographicHistory.pairMoment
definitions.signature: {demeCount : ℕ} (history : PipelineDemographicHistory demeCount) (K : ℕ) (train target : Fin demeCount) (sourceDegree targetDegree : ℕ) : ℝ
definitions.body:
history.oneLocusMoment K
    (Coalescent.pairExponent train target sourceDegree targetDegree)
definitions.docstring: Exact train-target mixed frequency moment from the arbitrary-deme history.

definitions.name: Descent.Portability.PipelineDemographicHistory.jointSampleCount
definitions.signature: {demeCount : ℕ} (history : PipelineDemographicHistory demeCount) (train target : Fin demeCount) (ns nt sourceCount targetCount : ℕ) : ℝ
definitions.body:
if sourceCount ≤ ns ∧ targetCount ≤ nt then
    (Nat.choose ns sourceCount : ℝ) * (Nat.choose nt targetCount : ℝ) *
      (∑ a ∈ Finset.range (ns - sourceCount + 1),
        ∑ b ∈ Finset.range (nt - targetCount + 1),
          (Nat.choose (ns - sourceCount) a : ℝ) *
          (Nat.choose (nt - targetCount) b : ℝ) * (-1 : ℝ) ^ (a + b) *
          history.pairMoment (ns + nt) train target
            (sourceCount + a) (targetCount + b))
  else 0
definitions.docstring:
Exact joint allele-count law for any train-target pair and cohort sizes.  Sample size
enters both the propagated moment degree `ns + nt` and this Bernstein event polynomial.

definitions.name: Descent.Portability.ManyDemeSampleCount
definitions.docstring:
One allele-count cell for a many-deme sample layout.  The dependent finite type makes an
out-of-range count unrepresentable.

definitions.name: Descent.Portability.ManyDemeBernsteinRemainder
definitions.signature: {demeCount : ℕ} (sampleSize : Fin demeCount → ℕ) (count : ManyDemeSampleCount sampleSize)
definitions.docstring: The number of complement factors remaining after fixing a many-deme count cell.

definitions.name: Descent.Portability.manyDemeTotalSampleSize
definitions.docstring: Total haplotype count in a many-deme panel.

definitions.name: Descent.Portability.ManyDemeSampleCount.total
definitions.signature: {demeCount : ℕ} {sampleSize : Fin demeCount → ℕ} (count : ManyDemeSampleCount sampleSize) : ℕ
definitions.docstring: Total derived-allele count in one many-deme sample cell.

definitions.name: Descent.Portability.manyDemeExponentDegree
definitions.docstring: Total degree of a many-deme probe monomial.

definitions.name: Descent.Portability.manyDemeSampleCountAlternatingPolynomial
definitions.signature: {demeCount : ℕ} (sampleSize : Fin demeCount → ℕ) (count : ManyDemeSampleCount sampleSize) (probeExponent : Fin demeCount → ℕ) : MvPolynomial (Fin demeCount) ℝ
definitions.body:
by
  classical
  exact MvPolynomial.C (∏ deme,
      (Nat.choose (sampleSize deme) (count deme) : ℝ)) *
    ∑ remainder : ManyDemeBernsteinRemainder sampleSize count,
      MvPolynomial.C ((-1 : ℝ) ^ (∑ deme, (remainder deme : ℕ)) *
        ∏ deme, (Nat.choose (sampleSize deme - count deme) (remainder deme) : ℝ)) *
      ∏ deme, MvPolynomial.X deme ^
        ((count deme : ℕ) + (remainder deme : ℕ) + probeExponent deme)
definitions.docstring: Polynomial represented by the existing alternating moment expansion for one count cell.

definitions.name: Descent.Portability.PipelineDemographicHistory.manyDemeSampleCountMomentMass
definitions.signature: {demeCount : ℕ} (history : PipelineDemographicHistory demeCount) (sampleSize : Fin demeCount → ℕ) (count : ManyDemeSampleCount sampleSize) (probeExponent : Fin demeCount → ℕ) : ℝ
definitions.body:
by
  classical
  exact
    (∏ deme, (Nat.choose (sampleSize deme) (count deme) : ℝ)) *
      ∑ remainder : ManyDemeBernsteinRemainder sampleSize count,
        (-1 : ℝ) ^ (∑ deme, (remainder deme : ℕ)) *
          (∏ deme,
            (Nat.choose (sampleSize deme - count deme) (remainder deme) : ℝ)) *
          history.oneLocusMoment
            (manyDemeTotalSampleSize sampleSize + manyDemeExponentDegree probeExponent)
            (fun deme ↦ (count deme : ℕ) + (remainder deme : ℕ) + probeExponent deme)
definitions.docstring:
Exact joint count-cell mass multiplied by an arbitrary latent-frequency monomial.

For count cell `c`, sample layout `n`, and probe exponent `q`, this is

`E[(∏ p_d^(q_d)) (∏ choose(n_d,c_d) p_d^(c_d) (1-p_d)^(n_d-c_d))]`.

Every complement power is expanded by the finite binomial theorem, so the result is one
finite sum of propagated moments at degree `Σ n_d + Σ q_d`.  Adding probe lineages before
conditioning is essential: reusing the ascertaining sample's empirical frequency would
compute a different, selection-biased statistic.

definitions.name: Descent.Portability.manyDemeSampleCountMomentProbe
definitions.signature: {demeCount : ℕ} (sampleSize : Fin demeCount → ℕ) (count : ManyDemeSampleCount sampleSize) (probeExponent : Fin demeCount → ℕ) : Coalescent.AffineManyDemeMomentCoordinate demeCount (manyDemeTotalSampleSize sampleSize + manyDemeExponentDegree probeExponent) → ℝ
definitions.ret_type: Coalescent.AffineManyDemeMomentCoordinate demeCount (manyDemeTotalSampleSize sampleSize + manyDemeExponentDegree probeExponent) → ℝ
definitions.body:
by
  classical
  let K := manyDemeTotalSampleSize sampleSize + manyDemeExponentDegree probeExponent
  exact (∏ deme, (Nat.choose (sampleSize deme) (count deme) : ℝ)) •
    ∑ remainder : ManyDemeBernsteinRemainder sampleSize count,
      ((-1 : ℝ) ^ (∑ deme, (remainder deme : ℕ)) *
        (∏ deme,
          (Nat.choose (sampleSize deme - count deme) (remainder deme) : ℝ))) •
        Coalescent.manyDemeMomentReadoutProbe K
          (fun deme ↦ (count deme : ℕ) + (remainder deme : ℕ) + probeExponent deme)
definitions.docstring:
Terminal coefficient vector for one many-deme sample-count cell with an additional
frequency monomial.  It is the exact Bernstein polynomial expressed in the augmented moment
basis, before any demographic propagation is performed.

definitions.name: Descent.Portability.PooledMAFThreshold.Accepts
definitions.body:
threshold.numerator * totalCount ≤
    threshold.denominator * min derivedCount (totalCount - derivedCount)
definitions.docstring:
Whether a pooled derived count passes a rational MAF threshold.  Cross multiplication
avoids floating-point rounding and treats either allele orientation identically.

definitions.name: Descent.Portability.gnomonCausalMAFThreshold
definitions.body:
1
  denominator := 100
  denominator_pos := by norm_num
  twice_numerator_le_denominator := by norm_num
definitions.docstring:
The executable causal reservoir's declared one-percent pooled-MAF threshold, represented
exactly as `1/100`.

definitions.name: Descent.Portability.PipelineDemographicHistory.pooledMAFProbeMass
definitions.signature: {demeCount : ℕ} (history : PipelineDemographicHistory demeCount) (sampleSize : Fin demeCount → ℕ) (threshold : PooledMAFThreshold) (probeExponent : Fin demeCount → ℕ) : ℝ
definitions.body:
by
  classical
  exact ∑ count : ManyDemeSampleCount sampleSize,
    if threshold.Accepts (manyDemeTotalSampleSize sampleSize) count.total then
      history.manyDemeSampleCountMomentMass sampleSize count probeExponent
    else 0
definitions.docstring:
Unnormalized probe-moment mass of a pooled-MAF ascertainment event.  The sum ranges over
the complete Cartesian sample-count grid for every finite number of demes; no pairwise
projection can replace this event because the acceptance predicate couples all coordinates.

definitions.name: Descent.Portability.pooledMAFTerminalProbe
definitions.signature: {demeCount : ℕ} (sampleSize : Fin demeCount → ℕ) (threshold : PooledMAFThreshold) (probeExponent : Fin demeCount → ℕ) : Coalescent.AffineManyDemeMomentCoordinate demeCount (manyDemeTotalSampleSize sampleSize + manyDemeExponentDegree probeExponent) → ℝ
definitions.ret_type: Coalescent.AffineManyDemeMomentCoordinate demeCount (manyDemeTotalSampleSize sampleSize + manyDemeExponentDegree probeExponent) → ℝ
definitions.body:
by
  classical
  exact ∑ count : ManyDemeSampleCount sampleSize,
    if threshold.Accepts (manyDemeTotalSampleSize sampleSize) count.total then
      manyDemeSampleCountMomentProbe sampleSize count probeExponent
    else 0
definitions.docstring:
One terminal vector for the complete pooled-MAF event and requested probe monomial.
All accepted count cells are combined before demographic propagation.

definitions.name: Descent.Portability.manyDemeSampleCountKilledDualCoordinate
definitions.signature: {demeCount : ℕ} (sampleSize : Fin demeCount → ℕ) (count : ManyDemeSampleCount sampleSize) (probeExponent : Fin demeCount → ℕ) : Coalescent.ManyDemeKilledDualCoordinate demeCount (manyDemeTotalSampleSize sampleSize + manyDemeExponentDegree probeExponent)
definitions.body:
by
  classical
  let K := manyDemeTotalSampleSize sampleSize + manyDemeExponentDegree probeExponent
  refine (fun deme ↦ ⟨(count deme : ℕ) + probeExponent deme, ?_⟩,
    fun deme ↦ ⟨sampleSize deme - count deme, ?_⟩)
  · have count_le : (count deme : ℕ) ≤ sampleSize deme := by
      have := (count deme).isLt
      omega
    have sample_le : sampleSize deme ≤ manyDemeTotalSampleSize sampleSize :=
      Finset.single_le_sum (fun other _ ↦ Nat.zero_le (sampleSize other))
        (Finset.mem_univ deme)
    have probe_le : probeExponent deme ≤ manyDemeExponentDegree probeExponent :=
      Finset.single_le_sum (fun other _ ↦ Nat.zero_le (probeExponent other))
        (Finset.mem_univ deme)
    omega
  · have sample_le : sampleSize deme ≤ manyDemeTotalSampleSize sampleSize :=
      Finset.single_le_sum (fun other _ ↦ Nat.zero_le (sampleSize other))
        (Finset.mem_univ deme)
    omega
definitions.docstring:
The unique positive-dual lineage configuration for one pooled sample-count cell and an
additional latent-frequency probe.  Its total lineage degree is exactly the panel size plus
the probe degree, so every coordinate is constructively inside the finite carrier.

definitions.name: Descent.Portability.pooledMAFKilledDualTerminalVector
definitions.signature: {demeCount : ℕ} (sampleSize : Fin demeCount → ℕ) (threshold : PooledMAFThreshold) (probeExponent : Fin demeCount → ℕ) : Coalescent.ManyDemeKilledDualCoordinate demeCount (manyDemeTotalSampleSize sampleSize + manyDemeExponentDegree probeExponent) → ℝ
definitions.ret_type: Coalescent.ManyDemeKilledDualCoordinate demeCount (manyDemeTotalSampleSize sampleSize + manyDemeExponentDegree probeExponent) → ℝ
definitions.body:
by
  classical
  exact ∑ count : ManyDemeSampleCount sampleSize,
    if threshold.Accepts (manyDemeTotalSampleSize sampleSize) count.total then
      fun coordinate ↦
        (∏ deme, (Nat.choose (sampleSize deme) (count deme) : ℝ)) *
          if coordinate = manyDemeSampleCountKilledDualCoordinate sampleSize count probeExponent
            then 1 else 0
    else 0
definitions.docstring:
Sparse nonnegative terminal vector for the complete pooled-MAF event in the positive
killed-dual basis.  Each accepted count cell contributes one configuration with its exact
multinomial multiplicity; no alternating complement expansion occurs.

definitions.name: Descent.Portability.manyDemeSampleCountBiologicalKilledDualCoordinate
definitions.signature: {demeCount : ℕ} (sampleSize : Fin demeCount → ℕ) (count : ManyDemeSampleCount sampleSize) (probeExponent : Fin demeCount → ℕ) : Coalescent.BiologicalManyDemeKilledDualCoordinate demeCount (manyDemeTotalSampleSize sampleSize + manyDemeExponentDegree probeExponent)
definitions.docstring: Every pooled count-cell coordinate lies in the compact biological killed-dual carrier.

definitions.name: Descent.Portability.pooledMAFBiologicalKilledDualTerminalVector
definitions.signature: {demeCount : ℕ} (sampleSize : Fin demeCount → ℕ) (threshold : PooledMAFThreshold) (probeExponent : Fin demeCount → ℕ) : Coalescent.BiologicalManyDemeKilledDualCoordinate demeCount (manyDemeTotalSampleSize sampleSize + manyDemeExponentDegree probeExponent) → ℝ
definitions.body:
by
  classical
  exact ∑ count : ManyDemeSampleCount sampleSize,
    if threshold.Accepts (manyDemeTotalSampleSize sampleSize) count.total then
      fun coordinate ↦
        (∏ deme, (Nat.choose (sampleSize deme) (count deme) : ℝ)) *
          if coordinate = manyDemeSampleCountBiologicalKilledDualCoordinate
              sampleSize count probeExponent then 1 else 0
    else 0
definitions.docstring: Sparse nonnegative pooled-MAF terminal vector directly on the compact biological carrier.

definitions.name: Descent.Portability.pooledMAFPositiveBernsteinPolynomial
definitions.signature: {demeCount : ℕ} (sampleSize : Fin demeCount → ℕ) (threshold : PooledMAFThreshold) (probeExponent : Fin demeCount → ℕ) : MvPolynomial (Fin demeCount) ℝ
definitions.body:
by
  classical
  exact ∑ count : ManyDemeSampleCount sampleSize,
    if threshold.Accepts (manyDemeTotalSampleSize sampleSize) count.total then
      MvPolynomial.C (∏ deme,
        (Nat.choose (sampleSize deme) (count deme) : ℝ)) *
        Coalescent.manyDemeBernsteinPolynomial
          (fun deme ↦ (count deme : ℕ) + probeExponent deme)
          (fun deme ↦ sampleSize deme - count deme)
    else 0
definitions.docstring: Positive Bernstein polynomial for the pooled-MAF event and latent probe.

definitions.name: Descent.Portability.pooledMAFAlternatingPolynomial
definitions.signature: {demeCount : ℕ} (sampleSize : Fin demeCount → ℕ) (threshold : PooledMAFThreshold) (probeExponent : Fin demeCount → ℕ) : MvPolynomial (Fin demeCount) ℝ
definitions.body:
by
  classical
  exact ∑ count : ManyDemeSampleCount sampleSize,
    if threshold.Accepts (manyDemeTotalSampleSize sampleSize) count.total then
      manyDemeSampleCountAlternatingPolynomial sampleSize count probeExponent
    else 0
definitions.docstring:
Polynomial obtained by summing the existing alternating moment expansion over the same
accepted pooled count cells.

definitions.name: Descent.Portability.PipelineDemographicHistory.pooledMAFProbeMassViaPositiveDual
definitions.signature: {demeCount : ℕ} (history : PipelineDemographicHistory demeCount) (sampleSize : Fin demeCount → ℕ) (threshold : PooledMAFThreshold) (probeExponent : Fin demeCount → ℕ) : ℝ
definitions.body:
let K := manyDemeTotalSampleSize sampleSize + manyDemeExponentDegree probeExponent
  pooledMAFBiologicalKilledDualTerminalVector sampleSize threshold probeExponent ⬝ᵥ
    history.presentBiologicalKilledDualState K
definitions.docstring: Exact pooled-MAF mass evaluated wholly on the compact positive-dual state.

definitions.name: Descent.Portability.PipelineDemographicHistory.pooledMAFProbeMassViaDual
definitions.signature: {demeCount : ℕ} (history : PipelineDemographicHistory demeCount) (sampleSize : Fin demeCount → ℕ) (threshold : PooledMAFThreshold) (probeExponent : Fin demeCount → ℕ) : ℝ
definitions.body:
(Coalescent.manyDemeMomentHistoryDualPropagator
    (history.oneLocusMomentInstructions
      (manyDemeTotalSampleSize sampleSize +
        manyDemeExponentDegree probeExponent))).mulVec
      (pooledMAFTerminalProbe sampleSize threshold probeExponent) ⬝ᵥ
    Coalescent.commonAncestorManyDemeMomentState history.ancestralMoment
definitions.docstring: Backward-operator presentation of one pooled-MAF probe mass.

definitions.name: Descent.Portability.PipelineDemographicHistory.pooledMAFProbeMassCertifiedApproximation
definitions.signature: {demeCount : ℕ} (history : PipelineDemographicHistory demeCount) (sampleSize : Fin demeCount → ℕ) (threshold : PooledMAFThreshold) (probeExponent : Fin demeCount → ℕ) (termOrder : Coalescent.ManyDemeMomentEpoch demeCount (manyDemeTotalSampleSize sampleSize + manyDemeExponentDegree probeExponent) → ℕ) : ℝ

args.type: Coalescent.ManyDemeMomentEpoch demeCount (manyDemeTotalSampleSize sampleSize + manyDemeExponentDegree probeExponent) → ℕ

definitions.body:
let K := manyDemeTotalSampleSize sampleSize + manyDemeExponentDegree probeExponent
  let certified := Coalescent.certifyManyDemeMomentHistory termOrder
    (history.oneLocusMomentInstructions K)
  (Coalescent.certifiedManyDemeMomentHistoryApproximation certified).mulVec
      (pooledMAFTerminalProbe sampleSize threshold probeExponent) ⬝ᵥ
    Coalescent.commonAncestorManyDemeMomentState history.ancestralMoment
definitions.docstring:
Finite certified approximation to one pooled-MAF probe mass.  The caller may assign a
different Taylor order to every demographic epoch; splits remain exact sparse maps.

definitions.name: Descent.Portability.PipelineDemographicHistory.pooledMAFProbeMassCertifiedError
definitions.signature: {demeCount : ℕ} (history : PipelineDemographicHistory demeCount) (sampleSize : Fin demeCount → ℕ) (threshold : PooledMAFThreshold) (probeExponent : Fin demeCount → ℕ) (termOrder : Coalescent.ManyDemeMomentEpoch demeCount (manyDemeTotalSampleSize sampleSize + manyDemeExponentDegree probeExponent) → ℕ) : ℝ

args.type: Coalescent.ManyDemeMomentEpoch demeCount (manyDemeTotalSampleSize sampleSize + manyDemeExponentDegree probeExponent) → ℕ

definitions.body:
let K := manyDemeTotalSampleSize sampleSize + manyDemeExponentDegree probeExponent
  let certified := Coalescent.certifyManyDemeMomentHistory termOrder
    (history.oneLocusMomentInstructions K)
  Coalescent.certifiedManyDemeMomentHistoryErrorBound certified *
      ‖pooledMAFTerminalProbe sampleSize threshold probeExponent‖ *
    ∑ coordinate : Coalescent.AffineManyDemeMomentCoordinate demeCount K,
      |Coalescent.commonAncestorManyDemeMomentState history.ancestralMoment coordinate|
definitions.docstring: Proven absolute-error radius for the finite pooled-MAF probe evaluation.

definitions.name: Descent.Portability.PipelineDemographicHistory.momentGivenPooledMAF
definitions.signature: {demeCount : ℕ} (history : PipelineDemographicHistory demeCount) (sampleSize : Fin demeCount → ℕ) (threshold : PooledMAFThreshold) (probeExponent : Fin demeCount → ℕ) : Option ℝ
definitions.body:
let denominator := history.pooledMAFProbeMass sampleSize threshold (fun _ ↦ 0)
  if 0 < denominator then
    some (history.pooledMAFProbeMass sampleSize threshold probeExponent / denominator)
  else none
definitions.docstring:
Exact arbitrary-order many-deme frequency moment conditional on a pooled sample passing
the MAF window.  `none` means the ascertainment event has zero mass.  This operator is finite
for every finite sample layout and exponent and is therefore exactly evaluable without a
frequency grid, density closure, fitted constant, or large-cohort limit.

definitions.name: Descent.Portability.PipelineDemographicHistory.targetErosion
definitions.signature: {demeCount : ℕ} (history : PipelineDemographicHistory demeCount) (train target : Fin demeCount) (ns nt : ℕ) : Option ℝ
definitions.body: Coalescent.targetErosionEvent (history.jointSampleCount train target ns nt) ns nt
definitions.docstring:
Exact cohort-size-aware target erosion derived directly from the visible demographic
history, rather than from a time-shift surrogate.

definitions.name: Descent.Portability.PipelineDemographicHistory.sourcePolymorphicTargetFactorialMoment
definitions.signature: {demeCount : ℕ} (history : PipelineDemographicHistory demeCount) (train target : Fin demeCount) (ns nt order : ℕ) : Option ℝ
definitions.body:
Coalescent.targetFactorialMomentGivenSourcePolymorphic
    (history.jointSampleCount train target ns nt) ns nt order
definitions.docstring:
Exact factorial moment of the target allele frequency after source-sample ascertainment.
Both the ascertainment cohort and target evaluation cohort are compiled into the joint
Bernstein law.  No population-frequency plug-in or large-sample limit appears.

definitions.name: Descent.Portability.PipelineDemographicHistory.sourcePolymorphicTargetHeterozygosity
definitions.signature: {demeCount : ℕ} (history : PipelineDemographicHistory demeCount) (train target : Fin demeCount) (ns nt : ℕ) : Option ℝ
definitions.body:
Coalescent.targetHeterozygosityGivenSourcePolymorphic
    (history.jointSampleCount train target ns nt) ns nt
definitions.docstring:
Exact target heterozygosity conditional on the source sample being polymorphic.  This is
the source-polymorphic tag-spectrum coordinate needed to construct target genotype variance;
target fixation probability is only one boundary event of the same joint law.  The distinct
pooled-MAF causal-panel event is constructed separately.

definitions.name: Descent.Portability.PipelineStudyDesign.gwasHaplotypeCount
definitions.docstring:
Haploid count corresponding to the diploid GWAS cohort.

Empirical status: NOT AN EMPIRICAL CLAIM -- the diploid-to-haploid factor of two, a ploidy
convention and not a population assertion.

definitions.name: Descent.Portability.PipelineStudyDesign.evaluationHaplotypeCount
definitions.signature: {demeCount : ℕ} (design : PipelineStudyDesign demeCount) (deme : Fin demeCount) : ℕ
definitions.docstring:
Haploid count corresponding to one diploid evaluation cohort.

Empirical status: NOT AN EMPIRICAL CLAIM -- the same ploidy convention as
`gwasHaplotypeCount`.

definitions.name: Descent.Portability.PipelineStudyDesign.pooledCohortSize
definitions.docstring:
The pooled evaluation cohort is concatenation of the deme cohorts.  Its size is derived,
not an independently supplied constant that could disagree with the evaluator.

definitions.name: Descent.Portability.PipelineStudyDesign.panelAscertainmentHaplotypeCount
definitions.signature: {demeCount : ℕ} (design : PipelineStudyDesign demeCount) : Fin demeCount → ℕ
definitions.docstring:
Haplotype layout used by the visible contract's pooled marker ascertainment.  It is
derived from the named per-deme cohort sizes rather than introduced as another free panel.

definitions.name: Descent.Portability.VisiblePipelineInput.pooledCommonVariantMoment
definitions.signature: {demeCount : ℕ} (input : VisiblePipelineInput demeCount) (exponent : Fin demeCount → ℕ) : Option ℝ
definitions.docstring:
Exact arbitrary-order joint frequency moment in the visible contract's causal-marker
reservoir, conditional on the pooled one-percent MAF event.  In particular, exponents through
degree four feed the ascertained variance and finite-panel Jensen laws.

definitions.name: Descent.Portability.VisiblePipelineInput.pooledCommonVariantAlleleMoment
definitions.signature: {demeCount : ℕ} (input : VisiblePipelineInput demeCount) (deme : Fin demeCount) (order : ℕ) : Option ℝ
definitions.docstring: One-deme marginal moment in the pooled common-variant reservoir.

definitions.name: Descent.Portability.VisiblePipelineInput.pooledCommonVariantPairMoment
definitions.signature: {demeCount : ℕ} (input : VisiblePipelineInput demeCount) (first second : Fin demeCount) (firstOrder secondOrder : ℕ) : Option ℝ
definitions.docstring:
Two-deme joint moment in the pooled common-variant reservoir.  This single definition
supplies every degree-two through degree-four cross-deme coordinate required by the
drift-heterogeneity law.

definitions.name: Descent.Portability.VisiblePipelineInput.pooledCommonVariantHeterozygosity
definitions.signature: {demeCount : ℕ} (input : VisiblePipelineInput demeCount) (deme : Fin demeCount) : Option ℝ
definitions.body:
(input.pooledCommonVariantAlleleMoment deme 1).bind fun first ↦
    (input.pooledCommonVariantAlleleMoment deme 2).map fun second ↦
      2 * (first - second)
definitions.docstring: Exact common-variant heterozygosity in one deme after the pooled sample-MAF event.

definitions.name: Descent.Portability.VisiblePipelineInput.pooledCommonVariantHeterozygosityProduct
definitions.signature: {demeCount : ℕ} (input : VisiblePipelineInput demeCount) (first second : Fin demeCount) : Option ℝ
definitions.body:
(input.pooledCommonVariantPairMoment first second 1 1).bind fun moment11 ↦
    (input.pooledCommonVariantPairMoment first second 2 1).bind fun moment21 ↦
      (input.pooledCommonVariantPairMoment first second 1 2).bind fun moment12 ↦
        (input.pooledCommonVariantPairMoment first second 2 2).map fun moment22 ↦
          4 * (moment11 - moment21 - moment12 + moment22)
definitions.docstring:
Exact fourth-order product of per-locus heterozygosities in two demes after pooled-MAF
ascertainment:

`E[H_i H_j | A] = 4(E[p_i p_j|A] - E[p_i² p_j|A]
                         - E[p_i p_j²|A] + E[p_i² p_j²|A])`.

At `i = j` this is the heterozygosity second moment used in the ascertained `CV²`; off the
diagonal it is the cross-deme moment used in the finite-panel correlation correction.

definitions.name: Descent.Portability.VisiblePipelineInput.pooledCommonVariantHeterozygosityCV2
definitions.signature: {demeCount : ℕ} (input : VisiblePipelineInput demeCount) (deme : Fin demeCount) : Option ℝ
definitions.body:
(input.pooledCommonVariantHeterozygosity deme).bind fun mean ↦
    (input.pooledCommonVariantHeterozygosityProduct deme deme).bind fun secondMoment ↦
      if mean ≠ 0 then some (secondMoment / mean ^ 2 - 1) else none
definitions.docstring:
Exact ascertained per-locus heterozygosity coefficient of variation squared,
`E[H_d²|A] / E[H_d|A]² - 1`.  A zero conditional mean has no normalized scatter and is
reported as `none`.

definitions.name: Descent.Portability.VisiblePipelineInput.pooledCommonVariantHeterozygosityExcessCorrelation
definitions.signature: {demeCount : ℕ} (input : VisiblePipelineInput demeCount) (first second : Fin demeCount) : Option ℝ
definitions.body:
(input.pooledCommonVariantHeterozygosity first).bind fun firstMean ↦
    (input.pooledCommonVariantHeterozygosity second).bind fun secondMean ↦
      (input.pooledCommonVariantHeterozygosityProduct first second).bind fun productMoment ↦
        if firstMean * secondMean ≠ 0 then
          some (productMoment / (firstMean * secondMean) - 1)
        else none
definitions.docstring:
Exact excess cross-deme heterozygosity product,
`E[H_i H_j|A] / (E[H_i|A] E[H_j|A]) - 1`.  This is the `rho_ij` coordinate in the
finite-panel Jensen law, derived from degree-four pooled-ascertained moments rather than
fitted from portability measurements.

definitions.name: Descent.Portability.VisiblePipelineInput.ascertainedTagErosion
definitions.signature: {demeCount : ℕ} (input : VisiblePipelineInput demeCount) (target : Fin demeCount) : Option ℝ
definitions.docstring:
Exact ascertained-tag erosion at the study's actual source and target cohort sizes.  The
result is `none` exactly when the source-polymorphic conditioning event has zero mass.

definitions.name: Descent.Portability.VisiblePipelineInput.sourcePolymorphicTargetFactorialMoment
definitions.signature: {demeCount : ℕ} (input : VisiblePipelineInput demeCount) (target : Fin demeCount) (order : ℕ) : Option ℝ
definitions.docstring:
Exact target frequency factorial moment after source-polymorphism ascertainment at the
study's actual cohort sizes.  Orders one and two supply the tag-spectrum coordinates used by
heterozygosity and genotype variance.

definitions.name: Descent.Portability.VisiblePipelineInput.sourcePolymorphicTargetHeterozygosity
definitions.signature: {demeCount : ℕ} (input : VisiblePipelineInput demeCount) (target : Fin demeCount) : Option ℝ
definitions.docstring:
Exact source-polymorphism-conditioned target heterozygosity for every deme.  Unlike
segregation retention, this retains the entire interior count spectrum and therefore
determines the marginal tag-genotype variance scale required upstream of a `DemeScoreLaw`.

definitions.name: Descent.Portability.VisiblePipelineInput.unascertainedLDCorrelationSqOn
definitions.signature: {demeCount : ℕ} (input : VisiblePipelineInput demeCount) (separation : Coalescent.MarkerSeparationBp) (target : Fin demeCount) (domain : input.demography.twoLocusMoments.LDNormalizationDomain separation input.studyDesign.gwasDeme target) : ℝ
definitions.docstring:
Squared normalized cross-deme `DD` for the unascertained two-locus moment field, read
after the complete demographic operator product.

This quantity is intentionally named for what it is.  It is not the linkage factor of the
deployed GWAS score: the latter conditions on marker ascertainment, association estimates,
threshold selection, and clumping.  Those operations live in `RealizedPTGWASDraw` and are
marginalized only through `VariableMarkerPTGWASKernel`.

Empirical status: DERIVED -- `unascertainedLDCorrelationSqOn_eq` proves this quotient is the
squared normalized `DD` correlation.

definitions.name: Descent.Portability.VisiblePipelineInput.unascertainedLDCorrelationSq
definitions.signature: {demeCount : ℕ} (input : VisiblePipelineInput demeCount) (separation : Coalescent.MarkerSeparationBp) (target : Fin demeCount) : Option ℝ
definitions.body:
by
  classical
  exact if domain : input.demography.twoLocusMoments.LDNormalizationDomain separation
        input.studyDesign.gwasDeme target then
      some (input.unascertainedLDCorrelationSqOn separation target domain)
    else none
definitions.docstring:
Exact input-only unascertained `DD` readout.  The normalization domain is decided from the composed
moments rather than supplied as an extra argument.  `none` covers a zero within-deme `DD`
denominator; failure of a separate Cauchy--Schwarz certificate no longer suppresses an
otherwise exactly evaluable operator quotient.

hypotheses: moments.DD rho source source = moments.DD rho target target
moments.H hetRho source source = moments.H hetRho target target

Descent.Coalescent.DemographicTwoLocusMo: moments.DD rho source source = moments.DD rho target target
moments.H hetRho source source = moments.H hetRho target target

definitions.name: Descent.Portability.PipelineDemographicHistory.withinHeterozygosity
definitions.signature: {demeCount : ℕ} (history : PipelineDemographicHistory demeCount) (deme : Fin demeCount) : ℝ
definitions.docstring: Expected within-deme heterozygosity from the exact propagated first two moments.

definitions.name: Descent.Portability.PipelineDemographicHistory.betweenDivergence
definitions.signature: {demeCount : ℕ} (history : PipelineDemographicHistory demeCount) (first second : Fin demeCount) : ℝ
definitions.body:
history.oneLocusMoment 2 (Coalescent.oneDemeExponent first 1) +
  history.oneLocusMoment 2 (Coalescent.oneDemeExponent second 1) -
    2 * history.pairMoment 2 first second 1 1
definitions.docstring: Expected pairwise allelic divergence between two demes.

definitions.name: Descent.Portability.PipelineDemographicHistory.CommonDiffusionProjection
definitions.body:
∀ separation first second,
    history.twoLocusMoments.H separation first second =
      history.betweenDivergence first second
definitions.docstring:
Equality proposition between the marginal frequency-divergence coordinate used by finite
ascertainment and the `H` coordinate propagated inside the joint linkage operator.  The
theorem immediately below proves it for every typed visible history.

definitions.name: Descent.Portability.PipelineDemographicHistory.hudsonFst
definitions.signature: {demeCount : ℕ} (history : PipelineDemographicHistory demeCount) (first second : Fin demeCount) (_ : history.HudsonFstDomain first second) : ℝ
definitions.body:
1 - ((history.withinHeterozygosity first + history.withinHeterozygosity second) / 2) /
    history.betweenDivergence first second
definitions.docstring:
Exact Hudson differentiation coordinate from the propagated demographic moments.

Empirical status: DERIVED -- Hudson's ratio-of-averages built from the pipeline's exact
propagated moments, with the between-pair divergence in the denominator; the convention
ledger entry for this declaration records why it is Hudson and not Nei, and the typed
`HudsonFstDomain` hypothesis excludes the zero-divergence pole instead of clamping it.

definitions.name: Descent.Portability.EvaluatedPopulation
definitions.docstring: A population coordinate is either one deme or the pooled population.

definitions.name: Descent.Portability.PipelineOutput
definitions.docstring:
The endpoint report on the unrestricted finite-cohort domain.  `none` is an actual
undefined metric, not a numeric default; `some value` carries every defined biological
intermediate and evaluation coordinate.

definitions.name: Descent.Portability.PipelineCompletionLaw
definitions.docstring:
The type of a candidate exact expected semantic map.  `Completion` means only residual
state not probabilistically determined by the visible input; simulator draws already integrated
into the expectation do not belong there.

definitions.name: Descent.Portability.HasExactPipelineReadout
definitions.signature: {demeCount : ℕ} {Completion : Type*} (law : PipelineCompletionLaw demeCount Completion) : Prop
definitions.docstring:
The proposition that the actual completed semantic map factors exactly through the visible
endpoint input.

definitions.name: Descent.Portability.NumericPipelineCompletionLaw
definitions.docstring:
Real-valued completion laws remain available for coordinates restricted to a domain where
they are defined; only these ordered scalar fibers admit the core sharp-envelope theory.

definitions.name: Descent.Portability.PipelineSharpEnvelope
definitions.docstring: Sharp numeric fibers are deliberately separate from the unrestricted partial endpoint.

definitions.name: Descent.Portability.PipelineRandomSemantics.expectedOutput
definitions.signature: {demeCount : ℕ} {Sample : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Sample] (semantics : PipelineRandomSemantics demeCount Sample) : VisiblePipelineInput demeCount → PipelineOutput demeCount
definitions.body:
fun input coordinate ↦
    some (∫ sample, semantics.realizedValue input sample coordinate ∂semantics.drawLaw input)
definitions.docstring: The exact expected report after all input-determined simulator draws are marginalized.

definitions.name: Descent.Portability.PipelineRandomSemantics.expectedCompletionLaw
definitions.signature: {demeCount : ℕ} {Sample : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Sample] (semantics : PipelineRandomSemantics demeCount Sample) : PipelineCompletionLaw demeCount PUnit where value
definitions.body: fun input _completion coordinate ↦ semantics.expectedOutput input coordinate
definitions.docstring: View the marginalized semantics as a completion law with no residual hidden state.

definitions.name: Descent.Portability.PartialPipelineRandomSemantics.definedProbability
definitions.signature: {demeCount : ℕ} {Sample : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Sample] (semantics : PartialPipelineRandomSemantics demeCount Sample) (input : VisiblePipelineInput demeCount) (coordinate : PipelineQuantity demeCount) : ℝ
definitions.body:
(semantics.drawLaw input
    {sample | semantics.defined input sample coordinate = true}).toReal
definitions.docstring: Probability that one finite pipeline realization defines a requested metric.

definitions.name: Descent.Portability.PartialPipelineRandomSemantics.expectedOutput
definitions.signature: {demeCount : ℕ} {Sample : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Sample] (semantics : PartialPipelineRandomSemantics demeCount Sample) : VisiblePipelineInput demeCount → PipelineOutput demeCount
definitions.body:
fun input coordinate ↦
    let mass := semantics.definedProbability input coordinate
    if mass = 0 then none else
      some ((∫ sample, (if semantics.defined input sample coordinate then
        semantics.realizedValue input sample coordinate else 0) ∂semantics.drawLaw input) / mass)
definitions.docstring:
Exact conditional mean over the realizations on which the pipeline reports the metric.
This is the population target of a skip-undefined Monte Carlo average.  If the metric is never
defined, the result remains `none`.

definitions.name: Descent.Portability.PartialPipelineRandomSemantics.expectedCompletionLaw
definitions.signature: {demeCount : ℕ} {Sample : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Sample] (semantics : PartialPipelineRandomSemantics demeCount Sample) : PipelineCompletionLaw demeCount PUnit where value
definitions.body: fun input _completion coordinate ↦ semantics.expectedOutput input coordinate
definitions.docstring:
The partial conditional expectation has no residual completion coordinate once the entire
input-determined draw law is integrated.

definitions.name: Descent.Portability.PipelineStudyDesign.residualVariance
definitions.docstring:
Environmental variance implied by a unit-variance genetic liability and the visible
narrow-sense heritability: `h² = 1 / (1 + Vₑ)`.

definitions.name: Descent.Portability.PipelineStudyDesign.residualSD
definitions.signature: {demeCount : ℕ} (design : PipelineStudyDesign demeCount) : PositiveScale where value
definitions.docstring:
Environmental standard deviation derived from the visible heritability, not supplied as
a second phenotype parameter.

definitions.name: Descent.Portability.FiniteLiabilityPanel.demeMean
definitions.signature: {demeCount : ℕ} {design : PipelineStudyDesign demeCount} (panel : FiniteLiabilityPanel design) (deme : Fin demeCount) : ℝ
